amount_text: $1B in Meta's equity offering (with NVIDIA's $3B, $4B combined)
title_en: AMD invests $1B in Meta's share offering
title_zh: AMD 向 Meta 股票发行投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: AMD said it will invest $1B in Meta's equity offering on the same day as NVIDIA's $3B, as part of Meta's ~$95B AI financing plan.
summary_zh: AMD 宣布将在 Meta 的股票发行中投资 10 亿美元，与英伟达的 30 亿美元同日公布，属于 Meta 约 950 亿美元 AI 融资计划的一部分。

amount_text: $3B in Meta's equity offering (part of Meta's ~$95B financing plan announced 26 Oct 2026)
title_en: NVIDIA invests $3B in Meta's share offering, expands Muse partnership
title_zh: 英伟达向 Meta 股票发行投资 30 亿美元，扩大 Muse 合作
summary_en: NVIDIA said it will invest $3B in Meta's equity offering, part of Meta's ~$95B AI financing plan, and the two will expand work on Meta's Muse models; Meta will widen its use of NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform and Vera CPUs.
summary_zh: 英伟达宣布将在 Meta 的股票发行中投资 30 亿美元（属于 Meta 约 950 亿美元的 AI 融资计划），双方扩大在 Muse 模型上的合作；Meta 将扩大使用英伟达 Vera Rubin 平台和 Vera CPU。

amount_text: Not disclosed; "multi-gigawatt scale" of Vera Rubin systems
title_en: Oracle expands Nvidia deal to multi-gigawatt Vera Rubin superclusters
title_zh: 甲骨文将英伟达合作扩大至数吉瓦级 Vera Rubin 超级集群
summary_en: Oracle and Nvidia said Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's AI superclusters will grow to multi-gigawatt scale on Nvidia's Vera Rubin servers, some using Oracle's own Acceleron networking; the value was not disclosed. Oracle also said it will offer Google TPUs and Cerebras and SambaNova inference chips from 2027.
summary_zh: 甲骨文与英伟达宣布，甲骨文云基础设施的 AI 超级集群将基于英伟达 Vera Rubin 服务器扩展至数吉瓦规模，部分系统采用甲骨文自研的 Acceleron 网络芯片，金额未披露。甲骨文还表示将从 2027 年起提供谷歌 TPU 以及 Cerebras、SambaNova 的推理芯片。

amount_text: "Valued at $2.0+ billion" per Verizon's Q3 2026 release; term not disclosed
title_en: AWS signs $2B+ AI infrastructure deal with Verizon
title_zh: AWS 与威瑞森签署逾 20 亿美元 AI 基础设施协议
summary_en: Verizon said with its Q3 2026 results that it signed an agreement with AWS valued at more than $2B, a commercial framework to scale distributed compute for AI workloads, expanding the November 2025 deal under which Verizon builds long-haul fibre between AWS data centres.
summary_zh: 威瑞森在 2026 年第三季度财报中表示，已与 AWS 签署价值逾 20 亿美元的协议，为 AI 工作负载扩展分布式算力建立商业框架，是对 2025 年 11 月双方协议（威瑞森为 AWS 数据中心之间铺设长途光纤）的扩大。

subkind: five-year AI equipment leases (TPU racks, via Broadcom-arranged SPVs)
amount_text: ~$161.2B of non-cancelable five-year equipment leases with Broadcom per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026), booked as finance leases; lessors are Broadcom-arranged SPVs financed by Apollo/Blackstone ($35B) and the $63B bank/Blackstone package (separate debt edges); may overlap with the 2025 Ironwood rack orders
term: Five-year leases, cancelable only on default
title_en: Anthropic's S-1 shows ~$161B of Broadcom chip-equipment leases
title_zh: Anthropic 招股书显示约 1612 亿美元博通芯片设备租赁
summary_en: Anthropic's IPO filing lists about $161.2B of five-year, non-cancelable leases of Broadcom-built AI equipment, its largest stated compute commitment, ahead of Google (~$114.5B) and Amazon (~$110B). The racks are bought by special-purpose vehicles funded with private credit and bank debt and leased to Anthropic, with Broadcom backstopping residual values.
summary_zh: Anthropic 的上市申请文件列出约 1612 亿美元、为期五年且不可撤销的博通 AI 设备租赁，是其披露的最大算力承诺，超过谷歌（约 1145 亿美元）和亚马逊（约 1100 亿美元）。这些机架由特殊目的实体以私募信贷和银行贷款购买后租给 Anthropic，博通为残值提供兜底。

amount_text: A$4.25B (~US$2.98B); SMBC lead global coordinator (with HSBC and UOB), 32 lenders in all
title_en: SMBC-led banks lend AirTrunk A$4.25B green loan for Sydney SYD3 campus
title_zh: 三井住友银行牵头向 AirTrunk 提供 42.5 亿澳元绿色贷款，用于悉尼 SYD3 园区
summary_en: Blackstone-owned AirTrunk secured an A$4.25B (~US$3B) green loan from 32 lenders, led by SMBC, HSBC and UOB, to keep building its 400 MW-plus SYD3 hyperscale campus in Western Sydney, due by mid-2028. It lifts AirTrunk's committed debt to about A$38.4B.
summary_zh: 黑石旗下 AirTrunk 从以三井住友银行、汇丰和大华银行牵头的 32 家贷款机构获得 42.5 亿澳元（约 30 亿美元）绿色贷款，用于继续建设西悉尼逾 400 兆瓦的 SYD3 超大规模园区，预计 2028 年中完工。AirTrunk 已承诺债务融资总额因此升至约 384 亿澳元。

amount_text: ~$43.5B first lien (about 69% of the $63B total), per two sources cited by Reuters; arranged by Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley for syndication
title_en: Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley arrange ~$43.5B first lien for Anthropic chip SPV
title_zh: 美国银行、花旗和摩根士丹利为 Anthropic 芯片 SPV 安排约 435 亿美元第一留置权贷款
summary_en: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien debt of a $63B financing for a newly formed SPV that buys Broadcom AI accelerators and networking gear and leases them to Anthropic, with Broadcom giving residual value support. The WSJ reported that Broadcom agreed to higher rates and more loss protection after some banks wavered.
summary_zh: 美国银行、花旗和摩根士丹利正为一笔 630 亿美元融资安排第一留置权债务：新设特殊目的实体用这笔资金购买博通 AI 加速器和网络设备并租给 Anthropic，博通提供余值担保支持。据《华尔街日报》报道，在部分银行动摇后，博通同意提高利率并加强损失保护。

amount_text: Second-lien amount not disclosed; the $63B total minus the reported ~$43.5B first lien leaves ~$19.5B (early October reports: $18B junior tranche, ~$9B from Blackstone funds)
title_en: Blackstone provides second-lien debt in $63B Anthropic chip financing
title_zh: 黑石在 Anthropic 630 亿美元芯片融资中提供第二留置权债务
summary_en: Blackstone is the sole provider of the committed second-lien tranche of the $63B financing for a new SPV that buys Broadcom AI accelerators and networking gear and leases them to Anthropic, Reuters reported on 26 October 2026. Banks hold the larger first lien (separate edge).
summary_zh: 据路透社 2026 年 10 月 26 日报道，黑石是这笔 630 亿美元融资中已承诺第二留置权档的唯一提供方；新设特殊目的实体用这笔资金购买博通 AI 加速器和网络设备并租给 Anthropic。规模更大的第一留置权由银行提供（另列一条）。

amount_text: Maximum potential liability ~$43B undiscounted once all racks are deployed (Broadcom 8-K): 72.5% of outstanding lease amounts minus the racks' sale value. Supports the $63B financing (separate edges for the bank first lien and Blackstone second lien); this replaces the earlier reported 'up to $42B' Broadcom financing commitment
term: Falls as Anthropic pays its leases; deliveries from 2027
title_en: Broadcom backs Anthropic chip-lease financing with up to $43B residual value support
title_zh: 博通为 Anthropic 芯片租赁融资提供最高 430 亿美元余值担保支持
summary_en: On 26 October 2026 Broadcom agreed to give residual value support to a newly formed backstop vehicle in the $63B financing of Broadcom AI racks leased to Anthropic (the obligor); if Anthropic defaults, Broadcom covers the gap between 72.5% of the lease balance and what the racks fetch, up to ~$43B. Earlier reports (1 October) described this as Broadcom lending Anthropic up to $42B with the right to designate financing partners.
summary_zh: 2026 年 10 月 26 日，博通同意在为 Anthropic（付款义务人）租赁博通 AI 机架而安排的 630 亿美元融资中，向新设立的兜底实体提供余值担保支持：若 Anthropic 违约，博通补足租赁余额的 72.5% 与机架处置价值之间的差额，最高约 430 亿美元。10 月 1 日的早期报道称博通将向 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元融资并可指定融资伙伴。

subkind: 144A notes funding a GPU lessor (A2 mezzanine tranche)
amount_text: $4B of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche of the 144A notes that fund the Apollo-managed lessor behind the ~$40B SpaceX GPU lease (Bloomberg); size of the whole note programme not stated
term: Notes fund ~5-5.25-year GPU leases starting H1 2027
title_en: PIMCO buys $4B of notes funding SpaceX's Apollo GPU lessor
title_zh: PIMCO 认购 40 亿美元票据，为 SpaceX 的阿波罗 GPU 出租实体融资
summary_en: Bloomberg reported that PIMCO bought $4B of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche of the 144A notes issued by the Apollo-managed entity that buys Nvidia chips and servers and leases them to SpaceX (xAI) under the ~$40B GPU financing disclosed on 26 October 2026. The lease itself is spacex-apollo-2026-10-gpu-finance-lease.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，PIMCO（品浩）认购了 40 亿美元的 A2（夹层）档 144A 票据，发行方是阿波罗管理的实体，该实体购买英伟达芯片和服务器并租给 SpaceX（xAI），对应 2026 年 10 月 26 日披露的约 400 亿美元 GPU 融资。租约本身另列为一条租赁边。

subkind: share offering (forward sale) and mandatory convertible preferred
amount_text: $25.0B Class A common (40M shares at $625, forward sale settling by Nov 2027) + $12.5B 6.50% Series A mandatory convertible preferred; up to ~$43.0B with underwriters' options; priced 2026-10-26
term: Preferred converts in Aug 2029; forward sale settles on or before 2027-11-19
title_en: Meta's $37.5B share and mandatory convertible offerings
title_zh: Meta 发行 375 亿美元普通股与强制可转换优先股
summary_en: Meta priced $25 billion of Class A common stock sold through forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs and $12.5 billion of 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred stock, to fund its AI build-out; Reuters described the wider plan as about $95 billion. NVIDIA ($3 billion) and AMD ($1 billion) said they would invest in the offering (separate edges).
summary_zh: Meta 定价发行 250 亿美元 A 类普通股（通过与摩根士丹利、高盛的远期出售协议）及 125 亿美元、股息率 6.50% 的强制可转换优先股，为 AI 基础设施建设融资；路透社称整体融资计划约 950 亿美元。英伟达（30 亿美元）和 AMD（10 亿美元）表示将参与认购（另列）。

amount_text: ~$40B binding commitment; Apollo-managed entity buys the chips and servers and leases them to SpaceX on ~5-5.25-year leases; closing expected by year-end 2026
term: Leases start H1 2027 as each tranche is delivered; ~5-5.25 years
title_en: SpaceX (xAI) signs $40B Apollo-led GPU lease financing
title_zh: SpaceX（xAI）签署阿波罗牵头的 400 亿美元 GPU 租赁融资
summary_en: SpaceX, xAI's parent, disclosed in a regulatory filing a binding commitment of about $40B under which an Apollo-managed entity buys Nvidia AI chips and data-centre equipment and leases them to SpaceX; it called it the largest committed GPU financing. The lessor funds itself with 144A notes; Bloomberg reported PIMCO bought a $4B slice of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche (its own edge, pimco-apollo-spacex-gpu-lessor-2026-10-a2-notes).
summary_zh: xAI 母公司 SpaceX 在监管文件中披露约 400 亿美元的有约束力承诺：由阿波罗管理的实体购买英伟达 AI 芯片和数据中心设备并租给 SpaceX，租期约 5 至 5.25 年，SpaceX 称其为最大的已承诺 GPU 融资。出租方通过 144A 票据融资；据彭博报道，PIMCO（品浩）认购了其中 A2（夹层）档 40 亿美元（另列为一条债务边）。

amount_text: $3.5B facility (amount drawn not disclosed); Term SOFR + 2.75%, stepping up to a maximum of 3.50%
title_en: Citi provides Nebius a $3.5B senior secured facility
title_zh: 花旗向 Nebius 提供 35 亿美元优先担保贷款
summary_en: Nebius entered a $3.5B, 364-day senior secured facility with Citi as lead arranger and agent, to fund data-centre development, GPU purchases and general purposes. Management said larger asset-backed loans against its contracts may follow.
summary_zh: Nebius 与花旗（牵头安排行及代理行）签订 35 亿美元、期限 364 天的优先担保贷款，用于数据中心建设、采购 GPU 及一般用途。管理层表示，未来可能以客户合同为抵押进行规模更大的资产支持融资。

amount_text: ~¥100B (reported as ~$14-15B) per Reuters and Bloomberg sources, upsized from ¥50B and ¥80B targets; DeepSeek, Tencent and CATL have not confirmed the terms, so the figure is a report, not a disclosure
title_en: DeepSeek raises ~¥100B (~$15B) led by Tencent and CATL (reported)
title_zh: DeepSeek 据报完成约 1000 亿元人民币（约 150 亿美元）融资，腾讯与宁德时代为最大投资方
summary_en: Reuters and Bloomberg reported that DeepSeek, until now funded only by its parent High-Flyer, completed its first outside round of about ¥100B, with Tencent and CATL as the largest investors at a pre-money valuation reported near ¥500B; the target had risen from ¥50B to ¥80B to ¥100B during October 2026, and CITIC Securities is reportedly preparing a STAR Market listing. None of the parties has commented, so the investors' individual amounts are not modelled.
summary_zh: 路透社和彭博报道，此前仅由母公司幻方量化出资的 DeepSeek 完成首轮外部融资约 1000 亿元人民币，腾讯和宁德时代为最大投资方，投前估值据报约 5000 亿元人民币；2026 年 10 月间融资目标由 500 亿元人民币升至 800 亿元再到 1000 亿元，据报中信证券正筹备其科创板上市。各方均未置评，因此未单独列出各投资方金额。

amount_text: $1.3B for packaging capacity in South Korea (Amkor's announcement as reported; NVIDIA's release confirms the Korea expansion but gives no amount); Amkor puts its multi-year NVIDIA agreements at $3B in all, after the $1.5B Arizona deal of Jul 2026
title_en: NVIDIA prepays Amkor $1.3B for advanced-packaging capacity in Korea
title_zh: 英伟达向安靠预付 13 亿美元锁定韩国先进封装产能
summary_en: Amkor signed a new $1.3 billion agreement with NVIDIA, paid as prepayments, to add advanced-packaging capacity in South Korea, part of the supply-chain expansion NVIDIA announced at GTC on 21 October 2026.
summary_zh: 安靠与英伟达签订新的 13 亿美元协议，以预付款形式锁定韩国先进封装新增产能，属英伟达 2026 年 10 月 21 日在 GTC 上宣布的供应链扩产计划。

amount_text: $1.1B capacity-reservation advance per NVIDIA; KYEC's own disclosure allows up to NT$45B (~$1.4B) of prepayments for its US testing plant (subsidiary AeternZ), agreement signed 2026-10-13
title_en: NVIDIA advances KYEC $1.1B to reserve chip-testing capacity
title_zh: 英伟达向京元电子预付 11 亿美元锁定芯片测试产能
summary_en: NVIDIA gave King Yuan Electronics (KYEC) a $1.1 billion capacity-reservation advance to support new US testing facilities and equipment, with high-volume production targeted for April 2027.
summary_zh: 英伟达向京元电子（KYEC）提供 11 亿美元产能预留预付款，支持其在美国新建测试厂及设备，目标 2027 年 4 月量产。

amount_text: PPA value not disclosed; AEP plans to invest about $4B in the 702 MW Cheyenne Fuel Cell project (Bloom fuel cells, ~$2.65B purchase disclosed by AEP in Jan 2026)
term: 20 years; full operation expected by end of 2028
title_en: Google 20-year power purchase agreement with AEP's Cheyenne fuel-cell plant
title_zh: 谷歌与 AEP 夏延燃料电池电厂的 20 年购电协议
summary_en: Google will buy the output of Cheyenne Fuel Cell, a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell plant near Cheyenne, Wyoming, under a 20-year power purchase agreement; AEP owns about 92% (funds advised by Basalt the rest) and plans to invest about $4B. The plant serves Google's planned Cheyenne data-centre campus.
summary_zh: 谷歌将根据 20 年购电协议，购买怀俄明州夏延附近 702 兆瓦 Bloom 燃料电池电厂 Cheyenne Fuel Cell 的全部电力；AEP 持股约 92%（其余由 Basalt 管理的基金持有），计划投资约 40 亿美元。该电厂为谷歌规划中的夏延数据中心园区供电。

amount_text: $850M 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032-11-01, issued 2026-10-16 (initial purchasers hold a 13-day option for $150M more; exercise not yet reported)
title_en: Cipher Digital $850M convertible notes for Barber Lake
title_zh: Cipher Digital 发行 8.5 亿美元可转换票据，投向 Barber Lake
summary_en: Cipher Digital (formerly Cipher Mining) priced $850 million of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032; after capped calls, proceeds fund its additional equity in the Barber Lake AI campus (leased to Fluidstack and AWS) and HPC build-out.
summary_zh: Cipher Digital（原 Cipher Mining）定价发行 8.5 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换优先票据；扣除上限看涨期权成本后，资金用于追加 Barber Lake AI 园区（租给 Fluidstack 和 AWS）的股权投入及高性能计算建设。

amount_text: ~$5.7B: $1.3B 2036 + $0.5B 2046 USD notes and CNY 26B (CNY 20B 10-yr, 6B 30-yr) dim sum notes; >$23B orders
title_en: Tencent ~$5.7B bond sale amid AI spending
title_zh: 腾讯约 57 亿美元发债应对 AI 支出
summary_en: Tencent raised about $5.7B in dollar and offshore yuan bonds, four months after its June deal, with orders above four times the size. Its first-half 2026 capex more than doubled to CNY 96.3B.
summary_zh: 腾讯在 6 月发债四个月后再发行约 57 亿美元的美元及离岸人民币债券，认购超过四倍。其 2026 年上半年资本开支翻倍至 963 亿元人民币。

amount_text: Not disclosed; 3,590 MW in total: 20-year PPA for 890 MW of new uprate capacity (Constellation investing >$4.3B) plus a 15-year deal for 2,700 MW of existing PJM output
term: 20 years (890 MW uprates, first in 2028, all by 2032) and 15 years (2,700 MW)
title_en: Google nuclear power agreements with Constellation (3.6 GW)
title_zh: 谷歌与 Constellation 的核电购电协议（3.6 吉瓦）
summary_en: Google signed a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 MW of new output from uprates at 11 Constellation reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, which Constellation says means more than $4.3B of investment, plus a separate 15-year agreement for 2,700 MW of existing Constellation generation in PJM. The price Google pays was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 谷歌与 Constellation 签署 20 年购电协议，购买其在伊利诺伊、宾夕法尼亚和新泽西 11 台反应堆增容改造带来的 890 兆瓦新增电力（Constellation 称将为此投资逾 43 亿美元），另签 15 年协议购买其在 PJM 电网的 2,700 兆瓦现有电力。谷歌支付的价格未披露。

subkind: senior secured fixed-rate delayed-draw GPU loan
amount_text: $1.008B senior secured delayed-draw term loan; 6.78% fixed; final maturity 2033-05-30; Baa1 (Moody's) / A (low) (Morningstar DBRS); JPMorgan sole coordinating lead arranger, structuring agent and bookrunner
term: matures 2033-05-30; delayed draw tied to cluster commissioning
title_en: Lambda $1.008B senior secured fixed-rate GPU loan
title_zh: Lambda 10.08 亿美元优先担保固定利率 GPU 贷款
summary_en: Lambda closed a $1.008 billion senior secured fixed-rate delayed-draw loan, secured by the GPU servers it funds and by contracted cash flows from two hyperscale customers, with JPMorgan as sole lead arranger; Lambda calls it its second institutional credit facility after the $926M syndicated term loan that closed on 27 August 2026. Bloomberg's 28 August report of a JPMorgan-arranged ~$1B private debt raise (separate edge) may describe the run-up to this financing.
summary_zh: Lambda 完成 10.08 亿美元优先担保固定利率延迟提款贷款，以所购 GPU 服务器及两家超大规模客户的合同现金流为抵押，摩根大通为独家牵头安排行；Lambda 称这是继 2026 年 8 月 27 日完成的 9.26 亿美元银团定期贷款之后的第二笔机构信贷。彭博 8 月 28 日关于摩根大通安排约 10 亿美元私募债务的报道（另见单独条目）可能指的是同一笔融资的筹备阶段。

amount_text: ~$7B over 5 years for ~100,000 AI chips, ~30% paid upfront, per FT (not confirmed by either company)
title_en: Tencent leases 100,000 AI chips from Oracle for ~$7B
title_zh: 腾讯以约 70 亿美元向甲骨文租用 10 万颗 AI 芯片
summary_en: The Financial Times reported that Tencent agreed a five-year, roughly $7B deal to rent about 100,000 advanced AI chips in Oracle data centres in Southeast Asia, with about 30% paid upfront. Neither company confirmed it.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，腾讯与甲骨文达成为期五年、价值约 70 亿美元的协议，在甲骨文东南亚数据中心租用约 10 万颗先进 AI 芯片，约 30% 预付。双方均未确认。

amount_text: $1B combined: $500M from Samsung Electronics and $500M from five affiliates
title_en: Samsung commits $1B to KKR-led Helix
title_zh: 三星向 KKR 牵头的 Helix 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: Samsung Electronics and five affiliates agreed to invest a combined $1B in Helix Digital Infrastructure, the KKR-led AI infrastructure platform backed by Nvidia.
summary_zh: 三星电子及五家关联公司同意合计向 KKR 牵头、英伟达支持的 AI 基础设施平台 Helix 数字基础设施投资 10 亿美元（三星电子 5 亿美元，五家关联公司合计 5 亿美元）。

amount_text: ~$3B of equity per a person familiar with the terms (Reuters, 2026-09-24); not confirmed by Blue Owl
term: Oracle-leased campus in Doña Ana County, New Mexico
title_en: Blue Owl's ~$3B equity in Oracle's Project Jupiter campus
title_zh: Blue Owl 在甲骨文 Project Jupiter 园区约 30 亿美元股权投资
summary_en: Blue Owl, owner of developer STACK Infrastructure, has about $3B of equity in Project Jupiter, the AI campus in New Mexico built for Oracle and OpenAI. In September 2026 Oracle sent a force majeure notice over delays securing power; Blue Owl said the notice does not change the financial commitments.
summary_zh: 开发商 STACK Infrastructure 的母公司 Blue Owl 在新墨西哥州为甲骨文和 OpenAI 建设的 Project Jupiter AI 园区持有约 30 亿美元股权（知情人士透露，Blue Owl 未确认）。2026 年 9 月甲骨文因供电延误发出不可抗力通知；Blue Owl 称该通知不改变资金承诺。

amount_text: ~$1.1B five-year notes (reports range $1.1-1.15B), priced at 98.5 to yield 9.25%; S&P BB- on the notes; Goldman Sachs led
title_en: $1.1B junk bonds for Blue Owl-backed CoreWeave data centre
title_zh: Blue Owl 支持的 CoreWeave 数据中心发行 11 亿美元垃圾债
summary_en: A project company backed by Blue Owl affiliates and developed with PowerHouse Data Centers sold about $1.1B of five-year junk bonds to build the 76 MW Digital Drive campus near Richmond, Virginia, fully leased to CoreWeave; the 9.25% yield was about 2.7 points above similarly rated debt.
summary_zh: 由 Blue Owl 关联方支持、PowerHouse 数据中心参与开发的项目公司发行约 11 亿美元五年期垃圾债，用于建设弗吉尼亚州里士满附近、全部租给 CoreWeave 的 76 兆瓦 Digital Drive 园区；9.25% 的收益率比同评级债券高约 2.7 个百分点。

amount_text: ~$11.1B: $10B in three USD tranches (8.625%–9.75%) + €1B in two EUR tranches; reported as the largest high-yield corporate bond sale ever
title_en: SoftBank ~$11B junk bond sale to fund OpenAI payment
title_zh: 软银发行约 111 亿美元高收益债以支付 OpenAI 投资款
summary_en: SoftBank sold about $11.1B of dollar and euro high-yield bonds, rated BB+ by Fitch, to help fund its next $10B OpenAI payment, after an April 2026 $3.6B bond partly used to repay OpenAI-related bridge loans.
summary_zh: 软银发行约 111 亿美元美元及欧元高收益债（惠誉 BB+），用于支付下一笔 100 亿美元 OpenAI 投资款；此前其 2026 年 4 月发行的 36 亿美元债券部分用于偿还与 OpenAI 相关的过桥贷款。

amount_text: $2.94B over 15 years (per Bloomberg, from the bond marketing)
title_en: CoreWeave 15-year, $2.94B lease of Richmond Digital Drive campus
title_zh: CoreWeave 以 29.4 亿美元租用里士满 Digital Drive 园区 15 年
summary_en: CoreWeave leases all 76 MW of IT capacity at the Digital Drive campus near Richmond, Virginia, under a 15-year contract worth $2.94B; its rent services the project's $1.1B junk bonds.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 以价值 29.4 亿美元的 15 年合同租下弗吉尼亚州里士满附近 Digital Drive 园区全部 76 兆瓦 IT 容量；租金用于偿付该项目 11 亿美元垃圾债。

amount_text: $25B after a $5B upsize in Sept 2026 (was $8.5B 2023, $13.5B 2024, $20B 2025); ~SOFR+225bp; matures Sept 2027; lenders not named
title_en: SoftBank $25B margin loan backed by Arm shares
title_zh: 软银以 Arm 股份质押的 250 亿美元保证金贷款
summary_en: SoftBank raised its Arm-share-backed margin loan for the third time, to $25B, to help fund its roughly $65B of OpenAI commitments; $20B had been drawn as of December 2025.
summary_zh: 软银第三次上调以 Arm 股份质押的保证金贷款至 250 亿美元，以支持其约 650 亿美元的 OpenAI 投资承诺；截至 2025 年 12 月已提取 200 亿美元。

amount_text: $4.2B 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033 (upsized $3.7B plus the $500M option, exercised in full); ~$566M spent on capped calls
title_en: CoreWeave $4.2B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 42 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $3.7B of 2.875% convertible notes due 2033, its third convertible offering in under a year; with the initial purchasers' $500M option exercised, $4.2B closed on 22 September 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价扩容后的 37 亿美元、票息 2.875%、2033 年到期可转换票据，为其不到一年内第三只可转债；初始购买方全额行使 5 亿美元超额配售选择权后，于 2026 年 9 月 22 日完成 42 亿美元发行。

amount_text: $3.9B anticipated Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation; Crusoe announced the initial closing on 17 Sep 2026, so the final size may differ
title_en: Crusoe $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B valuation
title_zh: Crusoe 39 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值 309 亿美元
summary_en: Crusoe announced the initial closing of an anticipated $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation, co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners with Founders Fund, GIC, Nvidia, QIA, Radical Ventures and TPG, to fund large campuses such as Abilene, modular Crusoe Spark data centres and its cloud; it came ten months after a $1.38B round at a $10B valuation.
summary_zh: Crusoe 宣布完成预计 39 亿美元 F 轮融资的首次交割，投后估值 309 亿美元，由 Atreides Management、穆巴达拉资本和 Valor Equity Partners 联合领投，Founders Fund、GIC、英伟达、卡塔尔投资局、Radical Ventures 和 TPG 参投，资金用于阿比林等大型园区、模块化 Crusoe Spark 数据中心及其云业务；距上一轮 13.8 亿美元、估值 100 亿美元的融资仅十个月。

subkind: backup generator supply agreement with warrant
amount_text: $2.4B of initial deliveries in 2027-2028; warrant vesting tied to up to $8B of payments (a ceiling)
term: long-term supply; initial deliveries 2027-2028; warrant exercisable to 2033
title_en: Amazon backup-generator supply agreement with Generac
title_zh: 亚马逊与 Generac 的备用发电机供货协议
summary_en: Amazon signed a long-term supply agreement with Generac for backup generators for its data centres, with initial deliveries of $2.4B expected in 2027 and 2028. Generac issued Amazon a warrant for up to 1.69 million shares at about $200.93, vesting as Amazon's generator payments rise toward $8B.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与 Generac 签署长期供货协议，为其数据中心采购备用发电机，首批交付预计 2027 至 2028 年共 24 亿美元。Generac 向亚马逊发行认股权证，可按约 200.93 美元认购最多 169 万股，随亚马逊发电机付款累计至最高 80 亿美元分批归属。

amount_text: ~$22B being lined up by 10 banks, Goldman Sachs lead (with SMBC, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Bank of Nova Scotia; Bloomberg); separate $1B revolver not counted; not confirmed closed
title_en: Goldman-led banks line up $22B chip loan for Blackstone-Google Crux AI
title_zh: 高盛牵头的银行为黑石与谷歌的 Crux AI 安排 220 亿美元芯片贷款
summary_en: A group of 10 banks led by Goldman Sachs is lining up about $22B of debt for Crux AI to buy Google TPUs, secured on the chips and customer contracts, Bloomberg reported; the banks are working to syndicate it and closing was not confirmed.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，高盛牵头的 10 家银行正为 Crux AI 安排约 220 亿美元债务用于购买谷歌 TPU，以芯片和客户合同作抵押，并寻求银团分销；该融资是否已完成尚未得到确认。

amount_text: $19.9B net proceeds from at-the-market common stock issuance in the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026 (per 10-Q); programme size not checked; announced date is the 10-Q filing
title_en: Oracle raises $19.9B of new equity through an at-the-market programme
title_zh: 甲骨文通过按市价发行计划募集 199 亿美元股本
summary_en: Oracle's 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 August 2026 shows about $19.9B of net proceeds from common stock issued through its at-the-market programme, as it funds AI data-centre buildout.
summary_zh: 甲骨文截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度报告显示，通过按市价发行（ATM）计划发行普通股，净募资约 199 亿美元，用于 AI 数据中心建设。

amount_text: Up to $3.1B senior term loan; Citi, ING, Natixis CIB, QNB and UOB as lead arrangers and underwriters; launched to syndication in late October 2026
title_en: Zankore $3.1B senior term loan
title_zh: Zankore 31 亿美元优先定期贷款
summary_en: Zankore, the Indonesian AI cloud backed by Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, Ooredoo, Nvidia and Nokia, signed a senior term loan of up to $3.1B underwritten by Citi, ING, Natixis CIB, QNB and UOB to buy and deploy Nvidia GPUs, starting with 100 MW toward a 1 GW AI factory. Reports say Nvidia supports the deal through a revenue-sharing and credit-support model; the banks launched it to syndication in late October.
summary_zh: 由 Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison、Ooredoo、英伟达和诺基亚支持的印尼 AI 云公司 Zankore 签署最高 31 亿美元优先定期贷款，由花旗、ING、法国外贸银行、卡塔尔国家银行和大华银行承销，用于采购和部署英伟达 GPU，首期 100 兆瓦，目标 1 吉瓦 AI 工厂。据报道英伟达以收入分成和信用支持方式为交易提供支撑；银行已于 10 月下旬启动银团分销。

title_en: Amazon's debut £4.25B sterling bond sale
title_zh: 亚马逊首次发行 42.5 亿英镑英镑债
summary_en: Amazon priced its first sterling bonds, £4.25B in four tranches due 2029-2045, after euro, Swiss franc and Canadian dollar deals earlier in 2026, to fund its AI build-out; settlement was about 14 September 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊首次发行英镑债券，分四档共 42.5 亿英镑（约 57.6 亿美元），2029 至 2045 年到期，此前 2026 年已发行欧元、瑞士法郎和加元债券，用于支持 AI 建设；约于 2026 年 9 月 14 日交割。

amount_text: €3B (~$3.5B per Crunchbase) at >€21B post-money; led by Samsung Electronics, co-led by EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity
title_en: Mistral AI raises €3B Series D led by Samsung
title_zh: Mistral AI 完成三星领投的 30 亿欧元 D 轮
summary_en: Mistral AI raised €3B in a Series D at a post-money valuation above €21B, led by Samsung Electronics with EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity as co-leads.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元，由三星电子领投、EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 与 PSG Equity 联合领投。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the €3B Series D (round total is a separate edge)
title_en: Samsung leads Mistral AI's Series D
title_zh: 三星领投 Mistral AI D 轮
summary_en: Samsung Electronics was lead investor in Mistral AI's €3B Series D; its individual amount was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 三星电子领投 Mistral AI 30 亿欧元 D 轮，具体金额未披露。

amount_text: $29.6B from 28 banks, Citigroup and JPMorgan as lead coordinators (edge points at Citi; JPMorgan named here); upsized from a $20B target; opening margin SOFR+68bp (vs ~85bp on the 2024 loan); 15 Chinese banks took $18.9B (64%); signed mid-September 2026
term: 3 years, with options to extend 2 more years
title_en: ByteDance $29.6B syndicated loan led by Citi and JPMorgan
title_zh: 花旗与摩根大通牵头为字节跳动安排 296 亿美元银团贷款
summary_en: ByteDance raised a $29.6B unsecured offshore loan coordinated by Citigroup and JPMorgan, up from a $20B target. Sources said the money would mainly fund AI plans and projects outside China; at the time of reporting it was set to be signed shortly. Bloomberg reported on 14 September 2026 that the loan had been signed with 28 banks: 15 Chinese lenders (ICBC $3B, Bank of China $2.5B, CCB $1.5B) provided $18.9B, HSBC and two other foreign banks $1.5B each.
summary_zh: 字节跳动获得由花旗和摩根大通统筹的 296 亿美元无抵押境外银团贷款，较 200 亿美元的目标上调。知情人士称资金主要用于 AI 相关计划及海外项目；报道时贷款即将签署。 彭博 2026 年 9 月 14 日报道，该贷款已与 28 家银行签署：15 家中资银行（工行 30 亿、中行 25 亿、建行 15 亿美元）合计出资 189 亿美元，汇丰等三家外资银行各出资 15 亿美元。

amount_text: ~$13B over five years (Bloomberg, people familiar); not confirmed by either company
title_en: Jane Street's ~$13B five-year cloud compute contract with Crusoe
title_zh: Jane Street 与 Crusoe 签订约 130 亿美元、为期五年的云算力合同
summary_en: Bloomberg reported that Crusoe signed a deal worth about $13 billion over five years to supply the trading firm Jane Street with GPU cloud capacity, its largest cloud contract; neither company confirmed it.
summary_zh: 彭博社报道，Crusoe 与交易公司 Jane Street 签订为期五年、价值约 130 亿美元的 GPU 云算力合同，为其最大的云合同；双方均未证实。

amount_text: $12.9B: about $11.9B to Hugging Face investors plus up to $1B of stock incentives for staff (as reported); pending regulatory review
title_en: NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face
title_zh: 英伟达收购 Hugging Face
summary_en: After The Information reported the deal in late August 2026, Nvidia confirmed it is buying the AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9B, roughly $11.9B to investors plus up to $1B in stock incentives for employees. In late October Reuters reported that the US Justice Department is asking questions about the deal.
summary_zh: The Information 于 2026 年 8 月下旬率先报道后，英伟达确认以 129 亿美元收购 AI 模型平台 Hugging Face，其中约 119 亿美元支付给投资者，另有最多 10 亿美元股票激励给员工。10 月下旬路透社报道美国司法部正在就该交易进行问询。

amount_text: $1.5B led by Jane Street at a valuation above $18B (Forbes, citing sources; not announced by the company)
title_en: Fluidstack raises $1.5B led by Jane Street at $18B+
title_zh: Fluidstack 获 Jane Street 领投 15 亿美元融资，估值逾 180 亿美元
summary_en: Forbes reported that Fluidstack closed a $1.5B round led by quant firm Jane Street at a valuation above $18B, more than double its $7.5B mark earlier in 2026; Bloomberg had reported talks in April.
summary_zh: 据《福布斯》报道，Fluidstack 完成由量化机构 Jane Street 领投的 15 亿美元融资，估值逾 180 亿美元，较 2026 年早些时候的 75 亿美元翻倍有余；彭博社曾于 4 月报道相关谈判。

amount_text: ~$35B, ~350 MW at Hut 8's Nueces County, Texas site (WSJ/Reuters); not confirmed by Anthropic, Lambda or Hut 8
title_en: Anthropic commits ~$41.3B to Lambda cloud compute
title_zh: Anthropic 向 Lambda 承诺约 413 亿美元云算力
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 shows three 2026 agreements with Nvidia-backed Lambda for Nvidia GPU compute worth about $41.3B over terms into 2034. The largest, signed in August (~$34.9B), is the roughly $35B deal for about 350 MW at a Hut 8 site in Texas first reported by the WSJ and Reuters; either side may end it if Lambda does not secure the facility lease in time.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》和路透社报道，Anthropic 与英伟达支持的 Lambda 签署约 350 亿美元协议，使用 Hut 8 位于得州的约 350 兆瓦容量，据报道由英伟达持有该数据中心租约。相关公司未予置评。

subkind: GPU-backed term loan and senior secured notes
amount_text: $2.4B: $1.2B senior secured term loan + $1.2B senior secured notes, led by Blue Owl-managed funds, drawn in tranches
title_en: Blue Owl leads $2.4B GPU financing for IREN
title_zh: Blue Owl 牵头为 IREN 提供 24 亿美元 GPU 融资
summary_en: Blue Owl-managed funds led a $2.4B compute-equipment financing for IREN, split between a term loan and secured notes, to buy Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs for IREN's Mackenzie campus in British Columbia.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 管理的基金牵头为 IREN 提供 24 亿美元算力设备融资（定期贷款与优先担保票据各 12 亿美元），用于购买部署在不列颠哥伦比亚省 Mackenzie 园区的英伟达 Blackwell Ultra GPU。

amount_text: ~$1B reported by Bloomberg on 2026-08-28; not counted: this is the run-up report to the $1.008B JPMorgan loan that closed 2026-10-01 (jpmorgan-lambda-2026-10-fixed-rate-gpu-loan), which carries the amount
title_en: Lambda ~$1B private debt for GPUs leased to Microsoft
title_zh: Lambda 约 10 亿美元私募债务用于租给微软的 GPU
summary_en: Lambda raised about $1B of short-dated private debt, arranged by JPMorgan, to buy Nvidia GPUs that Microsoft will lease. Lambda's October 2026 release describes the $1.008B JPMorgan facility as its second institutional loan after the August term loan, so this report and that loan are treated as one deal and the amount is counted once, on the October edge.
summary_zh: Lambda 通过摩根大通安排约 10 亿美元短期私募债务，用于采购将租给微软的英伟达 GPU。 Lambda 在 2026 年 10 月的公告中称 10.08 亿美元的摩根大通贷款是继 8 月定期贷款之后的第二笔机构融资，因此本条报道与该贷款视为同一笔交易，金额仅计入 10 月的边。

amount_text: Up to ~$44.6B over terms into 2033 under the August 2026 Nscale Services Agreements, fees accruing only as capacity is delivered and accepted (Anthropic S-1); reported as $45B over 6 years for ~460 MW at the Monarch campus, West Virginia. A second ~$45B deal was reported in talks (Oct 2026)
term: Into 2033; Vera Rubin capacity from late 2027
title_en: Anthropic $45B compute rental from Nscale
title_zh: Anthropic 向 Nscale 租用 450 亿美元算力
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 says it agreed in August 2026 to spend up to about $44.6B with Nscale subsidiaries for NVIDIA GPU compute over terms into 2033, paying only as capacity is delivered; Nscale must use best efforts to line up financing for the GPUs and data centre in time. Bloomberg had reported the deal as $45B for about 460 MW at Nscale's West Virginia campus, and in October 2026 reported talks on a second deal of roughly the same size.
summary_zh: Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，其于 2026 年 8 月与 Nscale 旗下子公司签约，在延续至 2033 年的期限内斥资最多约 446 亿美元租用英伟达 GPU 算力，仅在算力交付后付费；Nscale 须尽力按期为 GPU 和数据中心筹得融资。彭博此前报道该交易为 450 亿美元、约 460 兆瓦（西弗吉尼亚园区），并于 2026 年 10 月报道双方正洽谈规模相近的第二笔交易。

subkind: senior secured revolving credit and letter-of-credit facilities
amount_text: $600M of committed senior secured facilities: $100M revolver (Adjusted Term SOFR + 1.75%, 3-year) + $500M letter-of-credit facility; JPMorgan administrative and collateral agent, Morgan Stanley lead-left arranger, commitments split equally among Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and TD; undrawn at closing; credit agreement dated 2026-08-25, 8-K filed 2026-08-27
term: revolver matures 3 years from closing (extendable to 4 at the company's election)
title_en: Core Scientific $600M senior secured revolver and letter-of-credit facilities
title_zh: Core Scientific 6 亿美元优先担保循环信贷及信用证额度
summary_en: Core Scientific entered a senior secured credit agreement on 25 August 2026 with JPMorgan as agent: a $100 million revolver for working capital and a $500 million letter-of-credit facility to back utility and project obligations, secured by a first lien on substantially all assets; nothing was drawn at closing and the company expects it to free about $300 million of restricted cash. This is a new facility, distinct from the $1.0 billion March 2026 bridge that was repaid in May.
summary_zh: Core Scientific 于 2026 年 8 月 25 日与作为代理行的摩根大通签署优先担保信贷协议：1 亿美元循环信贷用于营运资金，5 亿美元信用证额度用于支持电力及项目义务，以几乎全部资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押；交割时未提款，公司预计可释放约 3 亿美元受限现金。这是一笔新额度，与 2026 年 3 月、已于 5 月偿还的 10 亿美元过桥贷款无关。

amount_text: HK$80.0B gross (~$10.2B), net ~HK$79.7B: 710,000,000 new shares at HK$112.70, announced 23-24 Aug 2026 and completed 26 Aug 2026; 100% of net proceeds for AI (~60% global computing infrastructure, ~40% hyperscale AI data centres and cloud upgrades)
title_en: Alibaba raises HK$80B (~$10.2B) in share placement for AI
title_zh: 阿里巴巴配售新股募资 800 亿港元（约 102 亿美元）投入 AI
summary_en: Alibaba placed 710 million new Hong Kong shares at HK$112.70 to non-US investors, its first placement since its 2019 Hong Kong listing and the largest on the exchange, raising HK$80B; it said all net proceeds go to full-stack AI, about 60% to global computing infrastructure and 40% to hyperscale AI data centres and cloud upgrades. The shares fell about 10% on the pricing; the placing closed on 26 August 2026.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴以每股 112.70 港元向非美国投资者配售 7.1 亿股新股，是其 2019 年港股上市以来首次配股，也是港交所最大规模配售，募资 800 亿港元；公司称全部净额用于全栈 AI，约六成投向全球算力基础设施，约四成用于超大规模 AI 数据中心和云升级。定价后股价下跌约 10%；配售于 2026 年 8 月 26 日完成。

amount_text: A$5.5B in 4 tranches (3, 5, 10 and 20 years; 3-year priced +65bp, 20-year 6.9% coupon); ≈ US$3.9B at an approximate 0.71 USD/AUD rate; >A$18B of orders; priced 2026-08-19
title_en: Alphabet A$5.5B debut kangaroo bond (≈ US$3.9B), largest Australian corporate bond
title_zh: Alphabet 首次发行 55 亿澳元袋鼠债券（约 39 亿美元），澳大利亚最大公司债
summary_en: Alphabet raised A$5.5 billion in its first Australian-dollar bond on 19 August 2026, the largest corporate bond in the Australian market, in four tranches of 3 to 20 years with ANZ, Deutsche Bank, RBC and TD as joint lead managers; orders exceeded A$18 billion and the deal funds its AI build-out.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 8 月 19 日首次发行澳元债券，募集 55 亿澳元，为澳大利亚市场最大的公司债，共 4 档、期限 3 至 20 年，由澳新银行、德意志银行、加拿大皇家银行和道明证券联合牵头；认购超过 180 亿澳元，资金用于 AI 基础设施建设。

title_en: Nebius $5B convertible notes
title_zh: Nebius 发行 50 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Nebius priced an upsized $5.0B two-part convertible offering, its third in a year, taking its convertible issuance since Sept 2025 to $11.75B.
summary_zh: Nebius 定价扩容后的 50 亿美元两档可转换票据，为一年内第三次，使其自 2025 年 9 月以来可转债发行总额达 117.5 亿美元。

amount_text: ~$1.3B mezzanine loan led by Eagle Point Credit Management, part of a ~$16B project-finance package (≈$15B senior debt led by Morgan Stanley, reported to be guaranteed by Google); pricing undisclosed
title_en: Eagle Point $1.3B private-credit loan for Nexus Data Centers' Anthropic-anchored Texas campus
title_zh: Eagle Point 向 Nexus Data Centers 提供 13 亿美元私募信贷，用于以 Anthropic 为主租户的得州园区
summary_en: Eagle Point Credit Management led a roughly $1.3 billion mezzanine loan to Nexus Data Centers for its campus in Hubbard, Texas, where Anthropic is to be the primary tenant; the loan sits below about $15 billion of bank senior debt in a ~$16 billion project financing, according to Bloomberg.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，Eagle Point Credit Management 牵头向 Nexus Data Centers 提供约 13 亿美元夹层贷款，用于其位于得州 Hubbard、以 Anthropic 为主租户的园区；该贷款在约 160 亿美元项目融资中位列约 150 亿美元银行优先债务之后。

amount_text: Up to $105B (WSJ had reported talks of ~$250B); OpenAI must reimburse Nvidia for any payout
title_en: Nvidia guarantees up to $105B of OpenAI's Ohio lease payments to SB Energy
title_zh: 英伟达为 OpenAI 向 SB Energy 支付的俄亥俄园区租金提供最高 1050 亿美元担保
summary_en: Nvidia guaranteed up to $105B of OpenAI's lease and power payments to SoftBank's SB Energy for the PORTS-Pike campus in Piketon, Ohio (initially 4.25 GW from 2028), payable only if OpenAI defaults; OpenAI is the obligor. Nvidia is also investing $1.5B in SB Energy.
summary_zh: 英伟达为 OpenAI 向软银旗下 SB Energy 租用俄亥俄州派克顿 PORTS-Pike 园区（2028 年起首期 4.25 吉瓦）应付的租金和电费提供最高 1050 亿美元担保，仅在 OpenAI 违约时触发，付款义务人为 OpenAI；英伟达另向 SB Energy 投资 15 亿美元。

title_en: AMD $4.75B senior notes
title_zh: AMD 发行 47.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: AMD sold $4.75B of senior unsecured notes in four tranches due 2029-2036 (priced 13 August, closed 17 August 2026), underwritten by Barclays, BofA, Citi, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo, for general corporate purposes including repaying debt.
summary_zh: AMD 发行四档共 47.5 亿美元无担保优先票据，2029 至 2036 年到期（2026 年 8 月 13 日定价、8 月 17 日交割），由巴克莱、美国银行、花旗、摩根大通、摩根士丹利和富国银行承销，用于一般公司用途，包括偿还债务。

amount_text: $926M (marketed at $917M); SOFR+3%, issued at 99.5; matures 2030-12-31; Baa2
title_en: Lambda $926M GPU loan backed by Nvidia lease-back
title_zh: Lambda 获 9.26 亿美元 GPU 贷款（以英伟达回租合同支撑）
summary_en: Morgan Stanley led a $926M term loan, secured by GPU servers and their cash flows, to fund the hardware Nvidia rents back from Lambda under a ~$1.5B four-year lease, a widely noted circular arrangement.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利牵头 9.26 亿美元定期贷款，以 GPU 服务器及其现金流为抵押，为英伟达以约 15 亿美元、四年期从 Lambda 回租的硬件融资，被普遍视为循环交易。

amount_text: $20B: 210,526,315 shares at $95 (upsized from $15B); underwriters' option for 31.6M more shares
title_en: Intel raises $20B in upsized share sale
title_zh: 英特尔增发股票募资 200 亿美元
summary_en: Intel priced $20B of new common stock at $95 a share, upsized from $15B; the offering was expected to close on 12 August 2026.
summary_zh: 英特尔以每股 95 美元定价增发 200 亿美元新股（原计划 150 亿美元），预计 2026 年 8 月 12 日交割。

amount_text: ~$9.1B expected contract revenue over 20 years to June 2048 (~$16.1B if both five-year extensions are exercised); tenant named by Bloomberg, not by Riot
term: 20 years; 96 MW from Dec 2027, full 191 MW from Jun 2028
title_en: Riot leases 191 MW at Rockdale to a frontier AI lab, reported to be Anthropic (~$9.1B)
title_zh: Riot 将 Rockdale 191 兆瓦租给前沿 AI 实验室（据报为 Anthropic，约 91 亿美元）
summary_en: Riot Platforms signed a 20-year lease of 191 MW of critical IT capacity at its Rockdale, Texas site with what it called a leading frontier AI lab, worth about $9.1 billion; Bloomberg reported the tenant is Anthropic. Morgan Stanley provides a $573 million interim loan for the build-out.
summary_zh: Riot Platforms 与一家“领先的前沿 AI 实验室”签订得州 Rockdale 园区 191 兆瓦关键 IT 容量、为期 20 年的租约，价值约 91 亿美元；彭博社报道租户为 Anthropic。摩根士丹利为建设提供 5.73 亿美元过桥贷款。

amount_text: $2.6B, ~5-year maturity; JPMorgan and MUFG joint lead arrangers
title_en: CoreWeave $2.6B DDTL 5.5 loan
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 26 亿美元 DDTL 5.5 贷款
summary_en: CoreWeave closed another $2.6B delayed-draw loan whose ~5-year term outlasts the ~3-year customer contracts behind it, letting it finance shorter deals.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 再获 26 亿美元延迟提款贷款，约 5 年期限长于其背后约 3 年的客户合同，使其能为较短期合同融资。

amount_text: Up to $573.0M delayed-draw term loan to Riot DC Logistics; SOFR + 2.75%; matures 2026-12-31; non-recourse to Riot parent
title_en: Morgan Stanley $573M loan for Riot's 191 MW Rockdale AI build
title_zh: 摩根士丹利向 Riot 提供 5.73 亿美元贷款，建设 Rockdale 191 兆瓦 AI 数据中心
summary_en: Lenders led by Morgan Stanley Senior Funding gave Riot's subsidiary Riot DC Logistics a senior secured delayed-draw term loan of up to $573 million to buy long-lead equipment for the 191 MW data centre at Rockdale, Texas, leased to a frontier AI lab reported to be Anthropic. The loan is secured on the project companies only and matures at the end of 2026.
summary_zh: 以摩根士丹利为行政代理的银团向 Riot 子公司 Riot DC Logistics 提供最高 5.73 亿美元的优先担保延迟提款定期贷款，用于采购得州 Rockdale 191 兆瓦数据中心的长交期设备；该设施租给一家前沿 AI 实验室（据报为 Anthropic）。贷款仅以项目公司资产担保，2026 年底到期。

amount_text: US$2B (~A$2.8B) equity at a post-money valuation above US$10.5B; Coatue and NVIDIA (follow-on), Blackstone-managed funds and Jane Street (new); individual amounts undisclosed
title_en: Firmus raises $2B equity at $10.5B+ valuation
title_zh: Firmus 完成 20 亿美元股权融资，估值逾 105 亿美元
summary_en: Australian AI-factory builder Firmus raised US$2B of equity from Coatue, NVIDIA, Blackstone funds and Jane Street, valuing it above US$10.5B, to build Project Southgate in Australia and expand across Asia-Pacific; it follows a US$10B Blackstone-led debt facility in February.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚 AI 工厂建设商 Firmus 从 Coatue、英伟达、黑石旗下基金和 Jane Street 获得 20 亿美元股权融资，投后估值逾 105 亿美元，用于建设澳大利亚 Project Southgate 并向亚太扩张；此前 2 月已获黑石牵头的 100 亿美元债务融资。

amount_text: $25B in 10 tranches (two floating, eight fixed at 4.500%-6.500%), due 2028-2066; ~$115B peak orders; settled ~10 Aug 2026
title_en: Alphabet $25B bond sale
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: After lifting 2026 capex to as much as $205B, Alphabet sold $25B of bonds in up to 10 tranches, drawing about $115B of peak orders.
summary_zh: Alphabet 将 2026 年资本开支上调至最高 2050 亿美元后，分至多 10 个期限发行 250 亿美元债券，峰值订单约 1150 亿美元。

amount_text: $10B two-year loan; lenders Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Mizuho Securities, Apollo, SMBC; SoftBank guarantee
title_en: SoftBank $10B loan backed by its OpenAI stake
title_zh: 软银以 OpenAI 股份质押获 100 亿美元贷款
summary_en: SoftBank signed a two-year $10B margin loan secured by its OpenAI shares, disclosed in its quarterly report; Bloomberg reported on 2026-08-28 that it was seeking a second $10B loan against the same stake.
summary_zh: 软银签署以其 OpenAI 股份为抵押的两年期 100 亿美元保证金贷款，并在季报中披露；彭博 2026 年 8 月 28 日报道其正以同一股份寻求第二笔 100 亿美元贷款。

amount_text: ~$10B over six years (Bloomberg); Volta did not name the customer and Anthropic declined to comment
title_en: Anthropic's ~$10B compute deal with Volta
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Volta 约 100 亿美元的算力合同
summary_en: Volta, an Nvidia-backed AI cloud start-up founded in January 2026 by former Brookfield executives, announced a six-year, ~$10 billion compute partnership with an unnamed AI lab that Bloomberg reported is Anthropic. The capacity runs on Nvidia Vera Rubin systems at Bitdeer's Tydal campus in Norway, which Volta leases (separate edge).
summary_zh: 由前布鲁克菲尔德高管于 2026 年 1 月创立、获英伟达支持的 AI 云初创公司 Volta 宣布与一家未具名 AI 实验室签订为期六年、约 100 亿美元的算力合作，彭博社报道该客户为 Anthropic。算力部署于 Volta 向比特小鹿租用的挪威 Tydal 园区（另列），采用英伟达 Vera Rubin 系统。

amount_text: ~$4.7B over the 16-year base term for 121 MW IT; ~$8.0B with an 8-year renewal; tenant may terminate without fee at year 10
title_en: Volta leases 121 MW at Bitdeer's Tydal, Norway campus (~$4.7B)
title_zh: Volta 租用 Bitdeer 挪威 Tydal 园区 121 兆瓦（约 47 亿美元）
summary_en: Volta, an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, signed a 16-year colocation lease for 121 MW of IT capacity at Bitdeer's Tydal campus in Norway, worth about $4.7B; Bitdeer says the end customer is a leading AI lab, which Bloomberg reported is Anthropic (not confirmed by the companies).
summary_zh: 英伟达云合作伙伴 Volta 与 Bitdeer 签订 16 年托管租约，租用其挪威 Tydal 园区 121 兆瓦 IT 容量，价值约 47 亿美元；Bitdeer 称最终客户为一家领先的 AI 实验室，彭博报道为 Anthropic（公司未证实）。

subkind: construction financing (bank bridge loan and related facilities)
amount_text: $15.6B construction financing per Evercore (adviser to Nexus); reported as ~$15B from a bank group led by Morgan Stanley (bridge to be refinanced) alongside a $1.3B Eagle Point mezzanine loan; split not disclosed
title_en: Morgan Stanley-led $15.6B financing for Nexus's Anthropic campus in Texas
title_zh: 摩根士丹利牵头为 Nexus 租给 Anthropic 的得州园区提供 156 亿美元融资
summary_en: Nexus Data Centers raised about $15.6 billion of construction financing, led by a Morgan Stanley bank group, for its inaugural data-centre and gas-power campus in Hubbard, Texas, which WSJ and CNBC reported is leased to Anthropic with Google guaranteeing lease and power payments. Evercore, Nexus's adviser, listed the financing among its Q3 2026 deals.
summary_zh: Nexus Data Centers 为其首个位于得州哈伯德、配套天然气电厂的数据中心园区筹得约 156 亿美元建设融资，由摩根士丹利牵头的银团提供；据《华尔街日报》和 CNBC 报道，该园区租给 Anthropic，谷歌为租金及电费提供担保。Nexus 的财务顾问 Evercore 在其 2026 年三季度业绩中列出了这笔融资。

amount_text: $3.5B at $35B post-money; National AI Industry Investment Fund among leads; Alibaba participated
title_en: Moonshot AI raises $3.5B at $35B valuation
title_zh: 月之暗面以 350 亿美元估值融资 35 亿美元
summary_en: Moonshot AI reportedly raised $3.5B, well above its $1-2B target, at a $35B valuation after its Kimi K3 model; China's state-backed National AI Industry Investment Fund was among the leads and existing investors including Alibaba took part. Moonshot did not comment.
summary_zh: 据报道，月之暗面凭借 Kimi K3 模型融资 35 亿美元，远超 10-20 亿美元的目标，估值 350 亿美元；国家人工智能产业投资基金为领投方之一，阿里巴巴等老股东参与。月之暗面未置评。

amount_text: $3.507B 9.875% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 99.5% by Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC
title_en: Galaxy $3.5B notes for CoreWeave's Helios Phase II
title_zh: Galaxy 为 CoreWeave 租用的 Helios 二期发行 35 亿美元票据
summary_en: Galaxy's subsidiary Galaxy Helios Data Centers II sold $3.507B of 9.875% senior secured notes due 2031 to build two buildings with 260 MW of critical IT capacity at Helios, leased to CoreWeave.
summary_zh: Galaxy 子公司 Galaxy Helios Data Centers II 发行 35.07 亿美元、票息 9.875%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于在 Helios 园区建设两栋共 260 兆瓦关键 IT 容量的楼宇，租户为 CoreWeave。

subkind: GPU and data-centre equipment SPV (usage fees)
amount_text: Brookfield to invest up to $9B (~KRW 12T) through an SPV ('Asset Co.') that owns the GPUs and data-centre equipment; NAVER Cloud pays usage-based fees (amount undisclosed, no committed total), guaranteed by Naver for up to 8 years; agreement signed 2026-10-27
term: GAK Sejong site 55 MW in H1 2027, 200 MW by 2028
title_en: Brookfield to fund up to $9B of compute for Naver's AI factory
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德为 NAVER AI 工厂提供最高 90 亿美元算力融资
summary_en: Naver disclosed on 27 October 2026 that it signed the agreement under which a Brookfield SPV, tentatively called Asset Co., invests up to $9B in GPUs and data centres for Naver's AI factory in Sejong and supplies the compute to NAVER Cloud for usage fees; Naver guarantees its subsidiary's fee obligations for up to eight years. The signing meets the condition for Nvidia's $1B investment in Naver.
summary_zh: NAVER 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日披露，已与布鲁克菲尔德签署协议：布鲁克菲尔德设立的特殊目的实体（暂名 Asset Co.）投入最高 90 亿美元（约 12 万亿韩元）购置 GPU 和数据中心，为 NAVER 位于世宗的 AI 工厂提供算力，由 NAVER Cloud 按使用量付费；NAVER 为子公司的付费义务提供最长八年的担保。此次签约满足了英伟达向 NAVER 投资 10 亿美元的前提条件。

amount_text: Not counted: non-binding MOU, not placed orders; Samsung estimates >$200B of collaboration over five years through 2030
title_en: Broadcom and Samsung sign $200B memory and foundry MOU
title_zh: 博通与三星签署 2000 亿美元存储与代工合作备忘录
summary_en: Samsung and Broadcom signed an MOU under which Samsung would supply HBM4 and HBM4E and build Broadcom products on 2nm and smaller processes at Pyeongtaek, valued by Samsung at more than $200B over five years; it is a statement of intent rather than a binding contract. The $200B estimate is not counted as an order total.
summary_zh: 三星与博通签署谅解备忘录，三星将供应 HBM4/HBM4E，并在平泽以 2 纳米及更先进工艺代工博通产品，三星估计五年合作规模超过 2000 亿美元；该备忘录为意向而非具约束力的合同。 2000 亿美元为三星估算，不计入订单金额。

amount_text: $1B strategic equity investment; its precondition (the Brookfield financing) was met on 2026-10-27; share issuance pending, after which Nvidia becomes Naver's third-largest shareholder
title_en: Nvidia to invest $1B in Naver's AI factory buildout
title_zh: 英伟达拟为 NAVER 的 AI 工厂建设投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: In the joint release with Brookfield, Nvidia said it will invest $1B in Naver toward the roughly $10B expansion of Naver's GAK Sejong AI factory from 55 MW to 200 MW. Naver's signing of the Brookfield deal on 27 October 2026 met the condition for the investment; once the new shares are issued Nvidia becomes Naver's third-largest shareholder.
summary_zh: 在与布鲁克菲尔德的联合新闻稿中，英伟达表示将向 NAVER 投资 10 亿美元，用于 NAVER 世宗 GAK AI 工厂从 55 兆瓦扩建至 200 兆瓦（总投资约 100 亿美元）。NAVER 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日与布鲁克菲尔德签约，满足了这笔投资的前提条件；新股发行后英伟达将成为 NAVER 第三大股东。

subkind: multi-year HBM supply and co-development partnership (letters of intent)
amount_text: Undisclosed for memory; Nvidia and SK Group put the wider partnership (memory plus AI data centres) at more than $500B over five years, via letters of intent without a breakdown
title_en: Nvidia multi-year HBM supply partnership with SK hynix
title_zh: 英伟达与 SK 海力士的多年期 HBM 供应合作
summary_en: Nvidia and SK Group announced an expanded partnership that secures SK hynix HBM for Vera Rubin and joint development of next-generation memory; the more-than-$500B headline also covers data-centre construction, rests on non-binding letters of intent and is not a firm order.
summary_zh: 英伟达与 SK 集团宣布扩大合作，锁定 SK 海力士为 Vera Rubin 供应 HBM 并共同开发下一代存储；所称逾 5000 亿美元规模还包含数据中心建设，基于非约束性意向书，并非确定订单。

to_name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso JV)
amount_text: $12.3B single tranche due 2048, price talk ~T+287.5bp; one report puts the final size at ~$12.5B
title_en: $12.3B SPV bonds for Meta's El Paso campus
title_zh: 123 亿美元 SPV 债券支持 Meta 埃尔帕索园区
summary_en: Sopaipilla Investor, an 80% BlackRock (GIP and HPS) / 20% Meta vehicle, sold about $12.3B of notes due 2048 via JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley to fund Meta's ~1 GW El Paso, Texas campus off Meta's balance sheet, copying the Hyperion structure.
summary_zh: Sopaipilla Investor（贝莱德旗下 GIP 与 HPS 持股 80%、Meta 持股 20%）经摩根大通和摩根士丹利发行约 123 亿美元 2048 年到期票据，为 Meta 位于得州埃尔帕索、约 1 吉瓦的园区进行表外融资，结构复制 Hyperion 模式。

to_name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso JV)
amount_text: Rent undisclosed
title_en: Meta leases El Paso campus from BlackRock JV
title_zh: Meta 向贝莱德合资公司租用埃尔帕索园区
summary_en: Meta is the developer, operator and sole tenant of the El Paso campus owned by the Sopaipilla joint venture; its lease payments service the SPV bonds.
summary_zh: Meta 是 Sopaipilla 合资公司所持埃尔帕索园区的开发商、运营商和唯一租户，其租金用于偿付该 SPV 的债券。

amount_text: $1.5B multi-year agreement, paid as prepayments, for advanced packaging and test capacity in the US (Arizona)
title_en: NVIDIA's $1.5B packaging prepayment to Amkor (Arizona)
title_zh: 英伟达向安靠预付 15 亿美元锁定美国（亚利桑那）封装产能
summary_en: Amkor and NVIDIA signed a $1.5 billion multi-year agreement for advanced packaging and test, funded by NVIDIA prepayments that support Amkor's US expansion in Arizona. A second, $1.3 billion agreement for Korea followed in October (separate edge).
summary_zh: 安靠与英伟达签订 15 亿美元多年期先进封装与测试协议，由英伟达以预付款形式支付，支持安靠在亚利桑那的美国扩产；10 月又签订 13 亿美元的韩国产能协议（另列一条）。

amount_text: Up to $5.0B of Anthropic Class N common stock, which Anthropic can draw in increments as AMD GPU delivery and deployment milestones are met (first milestone expected in 2027); after the IPO priced at the 30-day average share price (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: AMD to invest up to $5B in Anthropic
title_zh: AMD 向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元
summary_en: Under the July 2026 hardware supply agreement, AMD committed to buy up to $5B of Anthropic's Class N common stock, available to Anthropic in steps as AMD GPU capacity is delivered and deployed, the first expected in 2027 (Anthropic S-1). A circular structure: the chip supplier funds its customer.
summary_zh: 根据 2026 年 7 月的硬件供应协议，AMD 承诺购买最多 50 亿美元的 Anthropic N 类普通股，Anthropic 可随 AMD GPU 交付和部署里程碑分步提取，首个里程碑预计在 2027 年达成（Anthropic S-1）。这是芯片供应商出资支持客户的循环结构。

amount_text: No fixed dollar commitment; Anthropic's S-1 expects more than $20B of spending if it procures the full initial tranche (calendar 2027), with an option for roughly as much again; up to 2 GW of MI450-series (MI455X) Helios racks
title_en: Anthropic deal for up to 2 GW of AMD MI450 GPUs
title_zh: Anthropic 采购最多 2 吉瓦 AMD MI450 GPU
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to deploy up to 2 GW of AMD Helios racks with Instinct MI455X GPUs and EPYC Venice CPUs, with the first gigawatt from the first half of 2027. Its S-1 says the agreement sets no fixed dollar amount but it expects to spend more than $20B on the initial tranche, non-cancelable by Anthropic except for AMD's uncured breach.
summary_zh: Anthropic 同意部署最多 2 吉瓦搭载 Instinct MI455X GPU 和 EPYC Venice CPU 的 AMD Helios 机架，首个吉瓦于 2027 年上半年开始部署。其 S-1 称协议未设固定金额，但预计首批采购支出将超过 200 亿美元；除 AMD 未补救的重大违约外，Anthropic 不可撤销该协议。

amount_text: "Multibillion-dollar", exact value undisclosed; no new equity stake
title_en: Microsoft's multibillion-dollar compute deal with Mistral AI
title_zh: 微软与 Mistral AI 签订数十亿美元算力协议
summary_en: Microsoft committed multibillion dollars to Mistral's European GPU capacity (thousands of Nvidia Vera Rubin chips) without a new equity stake; Azure customers gain access to Mistral's French data centres and Mistral models join Microsoft Foundry.
summary_zh: 微软承诺向 Mistral 的欧洲 GPU 算力（数千颗英伟达 Vera Rubin 芯片）投入数十亿美元，不新增股权；Azure 客户可使用 Mistral 的法国数据中心，Mistral 模型同时上架微软 Foundry。

amount_text: ~$9.8B base contract value over the 15-year initial term for 352 MW critical IT (Beacon Point Phase 2); up to ~$25.1B with three 5-year renewals; campus total $19.6B base / ~$50.2B with renewals; tenant named by the FT, not by Hut 8
title_en: Hut 8's second 352 MW Beacon Point lease, same tenant reported to be NVIDIA (~$9.8B)
title_zh: Hut 8 签订 Beacon Point 第二份 352 兆瓦租约，同一租户据报为英伟达（约 98 亿美元）
summary_en: Hut 8 signed a second 15-year lease with the same high-investment-grade tenant for another 352 MW of critical IT capacity at Beacon Point, Texas, worth about $9.8 billion and fully contracting the ~1 GW campus ($19.6 billion across both leases); the Financial Times reported the tenant is NVIDIA, which has not confirmed it. Delivery is expected from Q2 2028.
summary_zh: Hut 8 与同一家高投资级租户再签一份 15 年租约，出租得州 Beacon Point 园区另外 352 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，价值约 98 亿美元，使约 1 吉瓦的园区全部签约（两份租约合计 196 亿美元）；《金融时报》报道租户为英伟达，英伟达未予证实。预计 2028 年二季度起交付。

amount_text: $830M Series A at a $7.5B valuation, led by Situational Awareness; closed January 2026, announced 20 July 2026
title_en: Fluidstack raises $830M Series A at $7.5B
title_zh: Fluidstack 完成 8.3 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值 75 亿美元
summary_en: Fluidstack, which builds AI data centres for Anthropic and Google-backed sites, said it raised $830M in a Series A led by Situational Awareness at a $7.5B valuation; the round closed in January 2026.
summary_zh: 为 Anthropic 及谷歌兜底项目建设 AI 数据中心的 Fluidstack 宣布完成由 Situational Awareness 领投的 8.3 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值 75 亿美元，该轮已于 2026 年 1 月完成。

amount_text: HK$9.54B gross (~US$1.22B at ~HK$7.8/US$): 35.6M new Class A shares at HK$268; issued with HK$6.5B (~US$0.83B) zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027, ~HK$16B in total
title_en: MiniMax share placement
title_zh: MiniMax 配售新股
summary_en: MiniMax placed 35.6 million new shares with at least six independent investors at HK$268 each, raising about HK$9.54B, alongside HK$6.5B of zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027 (about HK$16B in all, through Morgan Stanley and UBS). The money goes to AI infrastructure, model R&D and its global rollout.
summary_zh: MiniMax 以每股 268 港元向不少于六名独立投资者配售 3,560 万股新股，募资约 95.4 亿港元，同时发行 65 亿港元 2027 年到期零息可转债（合计约 160 亿港元，由摩根士丹利和瑞银承办）。资金用于 AI 基础设施、模型研发和全球推广。

subkind: US listing of new shares (Nasdaq ADS offering)
amount_text: US$26.5B: 177.9M ADS at $149 (each ADS = one-tenth of a common share)
title_en: SK hynix raises $26.5B in record US listing
title_zh: SK 海力士赴美上市募资 265 亿美元，创纪录
summary_en: SK hynix sold 177.9 million American depositary shares at $149 for its Nasdaq listing (ticker SKHY), raising about $26.5B; settlement was expected around 14 July 2026.
summary_zh: SK 海力士以每份 149 美元发行 1.779 亿份美国存托股（ADS）并在纳斯达克上市（代码 SKHY），募资约 265 亿美元；预计 2026 年 7 月 14 日前后交割。

amount_text: $520M credit line; pricing, collateral and maturity not disclosed
title_en: Bank of America extends OpenAI a $520M credit line
title_zh: 美国银行向 OpenAI 提供 5.2 亿美元授信
summary_en: Bank of America gave OpenAI a $520M credit line, its first loan to the company and a reversal after it earlier declined a request, as OpenAI prepares for a possible IPO. Reported by Reuters and Bloomberg citing people familiar.
summary_zh: 美国银行向 OpenAI 提供 5.2 亿美元授信额度，这是其向该公司发放的首笔贷款，此前该行曾拒绝过相关请求；OpenAI 正为可能的上市做准备。路透社和彭博社援引知情人士报道。

title_en: Amazon $25B bond sale as demand cools
title_zh: 亚马逊在需求降温中发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Amazon sold another $25B of bonds after a C$14B Canadian deal in June; peak orders (~$62B) were half those of its March sale. Amazon told underwriters it plans no more debt in 2026.
summary_zh: 继 6 月发行 140 亿加元债券后，亚马逊再发 250 亿美元债券；认购峰值约 620 亿美元，仅为 3 月的一半。亚马逊告知承销商 2026 年内不再发债。

amount_text: ~$19B of contracted lease revenue over a 20-year initial term (value with extensions not disclosed)
term: 20-year initial term; first capacity 2H 2027, full 401 MW by early 2028
title_en: Anthropic leases ~401 MW at TeraWulf's Kentucky campus (~$19B)
title_zh: Anthropic 租用 TeraWulf 肯塔基园区约 401 兆瓦（约 190 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf signed a 20-year lease with Anthropic for about 401 MW of critical IT load at the Justified Data campus in Hawesville, Kentucky, worth about $19 billion over the initial term. First capacity is due in the second half of 2027, the full 401 MW by early 2028.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 与 Anthropic 签订为期 20 年的租约，出租肯塔基州 Hawesville 的 Justified Data 园区约 401 兆瓦关键 IT 负载，初始期限内租金收入约 190 亿美元；首批容量 2027 年下半年交付，2028 年初全部 401 兆瓦到位。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no financial terms published
title_en: Apple extends Broadcom chip deal through 2031
title_zh: 苹果与博通芯片合作延长至 2031 年
summary_en: Broadcom disclosed in a securities filing that it will keep developing and supplying custom chips to Apple through 2031; analysts put Apple at about 20% of Broadcom's revenue.
summary_zh: 博通在证券文件中披露，将继续为苹果开发和供应定制芯片至 2031 年；分析师称苹果约占博通营收两成。

amount_text: ~$530M for TeraWulf's entire 50.1% stake in the Abernathy JV (FS CS I LLC), paid by Fluidstack and other purchasers in three instalments ($250M, $150M by 2026-12-31, ~$130M by 2027-04-30)
title_en: Fluidstack and partners buy TeraWulf's Abernathy JV stake (~$530M)
title_zh: Fluidstack 等买方收购 TeraWulf 所持 Abernathy 合资股权（约 5.3 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf agreed to sell its entire 50.1% stake in the Abernathy, Texas joint venture to Fluidstack and other purchasers for about $530 million, paid in instalments through April 2027, leaving Fluidstack's side in control of the 168 MW campus; TeraWulf said it will redeploy the cash into wholly owned sites.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 同意以约 5.3 亿美元将其所持得州 Abernathy 合资公司 50.1% 股权全部出售给 Fluidstack 及其他买方，分期支付至 2027 年 4 月，此后 168 兆瓦园区由 Fluidstack 一方控制；TeraWulf 称将把资金投入全资项目。

amount_text: Framework raised from $5B to $25B; $20B increment counted here (the original $5B is a separate edge)
title_en: Brookfield expands Bloom Energy partnership to $25B
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德将与 Bloom Energy 的合作扩大至 250 亿美元
summary_en: Brookfield raised its framework to finance Bloom Energy fuel-cell power projects for AI infrastructure fivefold, from $5B to $25B, under its AI Infrastructure Fund.
summary_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德通过其 AI 基础设施基金，将为 Bloom Energy 燃料电池电力项目融资的框架从 50 亿美元扩大五倍至 250 亿美元。

amount_text: $25B in five tranches (2031–2056), coupons 5.35%–6.65%; ~$89B orders; Baa1/BBB+/BBB
title_en: SpaceX (xAI parent) $25B debut bond
title_zh: SpaceX（xAI 母公司）首发 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Less than two weeks after its IPO, SpaceX, now xAI's parent, sold $25B of investment-grade bonds to repay the $20B bridge loan, paying about 40bp more than similarly rated issuers.
summary_zh: 上市不到两周，已成为 xAI 母公司的 SpaceX 发行 250 亿美元投资级债券以偿还 200 亿美元过桥贷款，利差比同评级发行人高约 40 个基点。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 20-year PPA for up to ~2.67 GW from Chevron's Project Kilby gas plant (plant cost estimated at ~$7B; final investment decision expected by end-2026)
title_en: Microsoft's 20-year power deal with Chevron for a West Texas AI campus
title_zh: 微软与雪佛龙签订 20 年购电协议，为西得州 AI 园区供电
summary_en: Chevron signed a 20-year power purchase agreement to supply Microsoft's data-centre campus near Pecos, West Texas, from Project Kilby, an off-grid gas plant in Reeves County developed with Engine No. 1 that ramps up to about 2.67 GW, with first power by 2028. Terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙与微软签订为期 20 年的购电协议，由其与 Engine No. 1 在里夫斯县开发的离网燃气电厂 Kilby 项目为微软位于西得州佩科斯附近的数据中心园区供电，装机逐步增至约 2.67 吉瓦，2028 年前首次供电。条款未披露。

amount_text: $25B in 7 tranches: $3.5B 4.250% Notes due 2028; $3.5B 4.350% Notes due 2029; $4B 4.500% Notes due 2031; $3.5B 4.750% Notes due 2033; $4B 4.950% Notes due 2036; $3B 5.550% Notes due 2046; $3.5B 5.625% Notes due 2056
title_en: NVIDIA $25B notes offering
title_zh: 英伟达发行 250 亿美元票据
summary_en: NVIDIA sold $25B of notes in 7 tranches due 2028–2056, according to its 424B5 prospectus filed on 2026-06-17.
summary_zh: 根据 2026 年 6 月 17 日提交的 424B5 发行说明书，英伟达发行 250 亿美元票据，共 7 档，2028–2056 年到期。

amount_text: $1.25B 9.625% senior notes due 2032 + €2B 8.500% senior notes due 2032 (combined US-dollar total not disclosed by the company; launched as a ~$3.5B offering)
title_en: CoreWeave $1.25B + €2B senior notes due 2032
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 12.5 亿美元及 20 亿欧元 2032 年到期优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced $1.25B of 9.625% and €2B of 8.500% senior unsecured notes due 2032, closed on 18 June 2026, for general corporate purposes including repaying debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价 12.5 亿美元、票息 9.625% 及 20 亿欧元、票息 8.500%、2032 年到期的无担保优先票据，于 2026 年 6 月 18 日完成，用于一般企业用途（包括偿还债务）。

amount_text: >$10B committed in total by founding investors KKR, Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia and Vistra (split undisclosed)
title_en: KKR launches Helix AI infrastructure platform with $10B+
title_zh: KKR 以逾 100 亿美元启动 Helix AI 基础设施平台
summary_en: KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure, led by former AWS CEO Adam Selipsky, with more than $10B committed by KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia (technology partner) and Vistra (preferred power provider) to build data centres, power and fibre.
summary_zh: KKR 启动由前 AWS 首席执行官 Adam Selipsky 领导的 Helix 数字基础设施，KKR、科威特投资局、英伟达（技术伙伴）和 Vistra（首选电力供应商）承诺逾 100 亿美元，用于建设数据中心、电力和光纤。

amount_text: $85.7B total IPO proceeds: 555,555,555 Class A shares at $135 (~$75B, priced 11 Jun 2026) plus the 83.3M-share over-allotment option exercised in full (~638.9M shares in all; SpaceX, 15 Jun 2026)
title_en: SpaceX raises $85.7B in record IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 完成创纪录 IPO，募资 857 亿美元
summary_en: SpaceX, which absorbed xAI in February 2026, sold 555.6 million Class A shares at $135 in the largest IPO on record and listed on Nasdaq as SPCX on 12 June 2026; underwriters led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley exercised the 83.3 million-share over-allotment in full, lifting total proceeds to $85.7B. The cash funds, among other things, the xAI/Colossus compute build-out rented to Anthropic and Google.
summary_zh: 2026 年 2 月合并 xAI 后的 SpaceX 以每股 135 美元发行 5.556 亿股 A 类股，完成史上最大 IPO，6 月 12 日以 SPCX 代码在纳斯达克上市；由高盛和摩根士丹利牵头的承销商全额行使 8330 万股超额配售选择权，使总募资额增至 857 亿美元。资金用途包括向 Anthropic 和谷歌出租算力的 xAI/Colossus 算力建设。

to_name: AI XPV (Broadcom chip-lease SPV for Anthropic)
amount_text: $35B initial capital solution led by Apollo funds with Blackstone and other banks; about half reportedly syndicated; multi-year draw schedule
title_en: Apollo and Blackstone lend $35B to Broadcom's chip SPV for Anthropic
title_zh: 阿波罗与黑石向博通为 Anthropic 设立的芯片 SPV 贷款 350 亿美元
summary_en: Apollo led, with Blackstone and other banks, a $35B initial financing for Broadcom's AI XPV platform, an SPV that buys Google-designed TPUs and leases them to Anthropic, with lease payments repaying the debt. Broadcom covers shortfalls to the senior A1/A2 notes if Anthropic stops paying and the chips cannot be sold for enough.
summary_zh: 阿波罗牵头、黑石及其他银行参与，为博通 AI XPV 平台提供 350 亿美元首期融资；该特殊目的实体购买谷歌设计的 TPU 并租给 Anthropic，以租金偿债。若 Anthropic 停付且出售芯片不足以偿还，博通负责补足优先级 A1/A2 票据的缺口。

amount_text: $1.59B 7.000% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at par by APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC; refinanced a Goldman Sachs bridge loan
title_en: Applied Digital $1.59B notes for the fourth CoreWeave building at Polaris Forge 1
title_zh: Applied Digital 为 Polaris Forge 1 第四栋楼发行 15.9 亿美元票据
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 3 sold $1.59B of 7% senior secured notes due 2031 to build the 150 MW ELN-04 building at Polaris Forge 1 (the campus leased to CoreWeave) and repay a Goldman Sachs bridge loan; the offering closed on 16 June 2026.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo 3 发行 15.9 亿美元、票息 7%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设 Polaris Forge 1 园区（租给 CoreWeave）150 兆瓦的 ELN-04 楼宇并偿还高盛过桥贷款，于 2026 年 6 月 16 日完成发行。

amount_text: $4.25B 6.129% senior secured notes due 2042, issued at par by Beacon Point DC LLC
title_en: Hut 8 $4.25B notes for its Beacon Point AI campus
title_zh: Hut 8 为 Beacon Point AI 园区发行 42.5 亿美元票据
summary_en: Hut 8's subsidiary Beacon Point DC sold $4.25B of 6.129% senior secured notes due 2042 to build a 352 MW AI data centre at Beacon Point in Nueces County, Texas, leased for 15 years (~$9.8B) to an unnamed AA-rated company.
summary_zh: Hut 8 子公司 Beacon Point DC 发行 42.5 亿美元、票息 6.129%、2042 年到期的优先担保票据，用于在得州纽埃塞斯县 Beacon Point 园区建设 352 兆瓦 AI 数据中心，该设施以 15 年、约 98 亿美元租给一家未具名的 AA 级公司。

amount_text: $4.66B: $1.75B 10-yr + $0.7B 20-yr USD notes and CNY 15B (~$2.21B) 10/30-yr notes; >$17B orders
title_en: Tencent $4.66B dual-currency bond sale
title_zh: 腾讯 46.6 亿美元双币种债券
summary_en: Tencent sold $2.45B of dollar notes and CNY 15B of offshore yuan notes, its first dollar bonds since 2021, for general corporate purposes including refinancing.
summary_zh: 腾讯发行 24.5 亿美元的美元票据和 150 亿元离岸人民币票据，为 2021 年以来首笔美元债，用于包括再融资在内的一般公司用途。

amount_text: C$14B maple bond in 5 tranches: C$1.25B 3.400% due 2029, C$2.5B 3.700% due 2031, C$2B 4.000% due 2033, C$3.5B 4.350% due 2036, C$4.75B 5.000% due 2056; ≈ US$10.2B at an approximate 0.73 USD/CAD rate; record Canadian-dollar corporate bond (~C$28B of orders); priced 2026-06-08/09, 424B5 filed 2026-06-10
title_en: Amazon C$14B maple bond (≈ US$10.2B), record Canadian corporate bond
title_zh: 亚马逊发行 140 亿加元枫叶债券（约 102 亿美元），创加拿大公司债纪录
summary_en: Amazon sold C$14 billion of Canadian-dollar senior notes in five tranches due 2029–2056, the largest corporate bond ever in Canada, beating Alphabet's C$8.5B maple bond of May; proceeds go to general corporate purposes including AI infrastructure. The 424B5 prospectus supplement was filed on 2026-06-10. Converted at roughly 0.73 USD per CAD (≈ US$10.2B).
summary_zh: 亚马逊发行 140 亿加元的加元计价优先票据，共 5 档，2029–2056 年到期，超过 Alphabet 5 月的 85 亿加元枫叶债券，成为加拿大史上最大的公司债；募集资金用于包括 AI 基础设施在内的一般公司用途。424B5 发行说明书补充文件于 2026 年 6 月 10 日提交。按约 0.73 美元/加元折算约 102 亿美元。

amount_text: $810.0M 6.000% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 99.75% by Stingray Compute LLC; Morgan Stanley representative of initial purchasers; Cipher completion guarantee
title_en: Cipher Digital $810M notes for the AWS-leased Stingray data centre
title_zh: Cipher Digital 发行 8.1 亿美元票据，建设 AWS 租用的 Stingray 数据中心
summary_en: Cipher Digital's subsidiary Stingray Compute sold $810 million of 6% senior secured notes due 2031 to finance the remaining cost of the 70 MW Stingray data centre in Andrews, Texas, leased to AWS, reimburse Cipher's equity and fund debt reserves; the offering closed on 15 June 2026.
summary_zh: Cipher Digital 子公司 Stingray Compute 发行 8.1 亿美元、票息 6%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于支付租给 AWS 的得州安德鲁斯 70 兆瓦 Stingray 数据中心剩余建设成本、偿还 Cipher 前期股本投入并设立偿债准备金，于 2026 年 6 月 15 日完成发行。

to_name: AI XPV (Broadcom chip-lease SPV for Anthropic)
amount_text: Maximum exposure $29B; rises as racks are deployed and falls as the customer pays its 5-year leases
title_en: Broadcom backstops up to $29B of lease payments to its AI XPV SPV
title_zh: 博通为其 AI XPV 特殊目的实体的租金提供最高 290 亿美元兜底
summary_en: When Apollo took over the purchase of Broadcom-designed AI racks and their leases to a customer (reported to be Anthropic, the obligor), Broadcom agreed to backstop the customer's 5-year lease payments, with a maximum exposure of $29B.
summary_zh: 阿波罗接手博通设计的 AI 机架采购及其对客户的租赁合同（据报道客户为 Anthropic，即被担保债务人）时，博通同意为该客户 5 年期租金提供兜底，最高敞口 290 亿美元。

subkind: senior unsecured delayed draw term loan
amount_text: $17.5B senior unsecured delayed-draw term loan (Citibank N.A. administrative agent); Term SOFR + 0.625–0.875%; commitments expire 30 Sep 2026 if not drawn; each loan matures 3 years after drawing
term: 3 years from each draw; draw period to 2026-09-30
title_en: Amazon $17.5B delayed-draw term loan led by Citibank
title_zh: 亚马逊获花旗牵头的 175 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款
summary_en: Amazon signed a $17.5B senior unsecured delayed-draw term loan with a bank group under Citibank as administrative agent, for general corporate purposes; undrawn commitments lapse on 30 September 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与以花旗银行为行政代理行的银团签订 175 亿美元无担保延迟提款定期贷款，用于一般企业用途；未提取的额度于 2026 年 9 月 30 日失效。

amount_text: $920M per month, Oct 2026-Jun 2029 (~$30B if run to term); terminable on 90 days' notice from 2027, so no committed total is counted (same rule as the Anthropic-SpaceX rental)
title_en: Google rents SpaceX/xAI compute ($920M a month)
title_zh: 谷歌租用 SpaceX/xAI 算力（每月 9.2 亿美元）
summary_en: A SpaceX SEC filing, as reported by DatacenterDynamics, shows Google will pay $920M a month for about 110,000 Nvidia GPUs and related hardware from October 2026 to June 2029, roughly $30B; either side can exit on 90 days' notice from 2027. Google called it bridge capacity for Gemini Enterprise.
summary_zh: 据 DatacenterDynamics 报道，SpaceX 向美国证交会提交的文件显示，谷歌将在 2026 年 10 月至 2029 年 6 月每月支付 9.2 亿美元，租用约 11 万颗英伟达 GPU 及相关硬件，合计约 300 亿美元；自 2027 年起任一方可提前 90 天退出。谷歌称这是为 Gemini Enterprise 提供的过渡算力。

title_en: Alphabet raises ~$40B in stock and mandatory convertibles
title_zh: Alphabet 通过股票和强制可转换优先股募资约 400 亿美元
summary_en: Alphabet sold about $20.7B of Class A and Class C shares and $19.25B of 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock (offerings upsized and over-allotments exercised in full), to fund capital spending on AI infrastructure and compute. With Berkshire Hathaway's $10B private placement and a $40B at-the-market programme, Alphabet put the whole package at $84.75B.
summary_zh: Alphabet 发行约 207 亿美元 A 类和 C 类股票，以及 192.5 亿美元、股息率 6.25% 的强制可转换优先股（发行规模上调，超额配售全额行使），用于 AI 基础设施和算力投资。加上伯克希尔·哈撒韦的 100 亿美元私募和 400 亿美元按市价发行计划，Alphabet 称整套融资合计 847.5 亿美元。

title_en: Berkshire Hathaway buys $10B of Alphabet stock

summary_zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦旗下公司于 2026 年 6 月 1 日同意以私募方式认购 100 亿美元 Alphabet 新发行的 A 类和 C 类股票，属于 Alphabet 为 AI 基础设施进行的股权融资的一部分。

Micron, Samsung and SK hynix joined as strategic investors.

title_en: Nebius fuel-cell power capacity agreement with Bloom Energy
title_zh: Nebius 与 Bloom Energy 的燃料电池供电容量协议
summary_en: On 14 May 2026 a Nebius subsidiary signed a master fuel-cell capacity agreement under which Bloom Energy installs, operates and maintains on-site fuel cells at Nebius data centres (about 250 MW guaranteed, 328 MW installed) and Nebius pays monthly service fees of up to $2.6B over the term. In July 2026 Industrial Development Funding and Oaktree announced a $1.7B project investment to finance the Bloom fuel cells for Nebius.
summary_zh: 2026 年 5 月 14 日，Nebius 旗下子公司与 Bloom Energy 签署燃料电池容量主协议：Bloom 在 Nebius 数据中心现场安装、运营和维护燃料电池（保证容量约 250 兆瓦，装机约 328 兆瓦），Nebius 在合同期内按月支付服务费，总额最高 26 亿美元。2026 年 7 月，Industrial Development Funding 与橡树资本宣布投入 17 亿美元为这批供 Nebius 使用的 Bloom 燃料电池提供项目融资。

amount_text: ~$1.6B for air-cooled NVIDIA Blackwell systems (GPUs, servers, storage, networking, services), paid within 30 days of each tranche shipping
title_en: IREN buys $1.6B of Blackwell systems from Dell
title_zh: IREN 向戴尔采购 16 亿美元 Blackwell 系统
summary_en: IREN agreed to buy about $1.6B of NVIDIA Blackwell systems from Dell for its Childress, Texas campus to serve its five-year, $3.4B AI cloud contract with NVIDIA; IREN guarantees its subsidiary's payments.
summary_zh: IREN 同意向戴尔采购约 16 亿美元英伟达 Blackwell 系统，部署于得州 Childress 园区，用于履行与英伟达为期五年、34 亿美元的 AI 云合同；IREN 为子公司付款提供担保。

title_en: Blackstone commits $5B to Crux AI, its TPU cloud with Google
title_zh: 黑石向与谷歌合办的 TPU 云 Crux AI 注资 50 亿美元
summary_en: Blackstone committed an initial $5B of equity to a TPU cloud venture with Google that rents out Google TPUs as compute-as-a-service, aiming for 500 MW of capacity in 2027; Google veteran Benjamin Treynor Sloss is CEO.
summary_zh: 黑石承诺首期 50 亿美元股权，与谷歌合办出租谷歌 TPU 算力的云业务，目标在 2027 年上线 500 兆瓦，由谷歌资深基础设施高管 Benjamin Treynor Sloss 任首席执行官。

title_en: Crux AI purchase of Google TPUs
title_zh: Crux AI 采购谷歌 TPU
summary_en: Crux AI, the TPU cloud venture of Blackstone and Google, buys Google's TPUs to rent them out as compute, aiming for 500 MW of capacity in 2027; the chips are financed by Blackstone's initial $5B of equity and a roughly $22B loan from ten banks. The purchase value was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 黑石与谷歌合资的 TPU 云公司 Crux AI 向谷歌采购 TPU 芯片并对外出租算力，目标是 2027 年达到 500 兆瓦容量；采购资金来自黑石首期 50 亿美元股权和十家银行约 220 亿美元贷款。采购金额未披露。

title_en: Alphabet ¥576.5B debut yen bond (≈ US$3.6B), record for a foreign issuer
title_zh: Alphabet 首次发行 5765 亿日元债券（约 36 亿美元），创外国发行人纪录
summary_en: Alphabet completed a 576.5 billion yen bond in Japan on 15 May 2026, its first in the currency and the largest yen bond ever by a foreign company (passing Berkshire Hathaway's 2019 record), in seven tranches of 3 to 40 years led by Mizuho Securities, Bank of America and Morgan Stanley.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 5 月 15 日在日本完成 5765 亿日元债券发行，为其首只日元债，也是外国公司有史以来最大的日元债（超过伯克希尔 2019 年纪录），共 7 档、期限 3 至 40 年，由瑞穗证券、美国银行和摩根士丹利牵头。

summary_zh: AMD 与以摩根大通银行为行政代理行的银团签订 50 亿美元、为期五年的无抵押循环信贷协议，取代此前的循环信贷（2026 年 5 月 15 日提交的 8-K）。

summary_zh: 亚马逊于 2026 年 5 月 12 日首次发行瑞士法郎债券，募集 28.2 亿瑞郎，创纪录地分为 6 档、期限 3 至 25 年，由法国巴黎银行、德意志银行和摩根大通安排；募集资金用于包括 AI 支出和偿债在内的一般公司用途。

title_zh: 英伟达与 IREN 签订 34 亿美元 GPU 云合同

title_zh: Anthropic 租用 SpaceX/xAI 算力（最高 1205 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to use all compute at SpaceX's (xAI's) Colossus 1 in Memphis, over 300 MW, and later added Colossus 2. title_en: Alphabet €9B euro bond (≈ US$10.5B), its largest in the currency
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 90 亿欧元债券（约 105 亿美元），其最大规模欧元债
summary_en: Alphabet priced €9 billion of SEC-registered euro senior notes in six tranches due 2030–2063 on 5 May 2026, its largest euro deal, in the same week as its C$8.5 billion maple bond; proceeds are for general corporate purposes amid capital spending of up to $190 billion in 2026.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 5 月 5 日定价发行 90 亿欧元、6 档、2030–2063 年到期的美国证监会注册欧元优先票据，为其最大规模欧元债，与 85 亿加元枫叶债券同周发行；募集资金用于一般公司用途，公司 2026 年资本开支最高达 1900 亿美元。

amount_text: C$8.5B maple bond in 4 tranches: C$1.5B 3.650% due 2031, C$2B 4.000% due 2033, C$2.25B 4.350% due 2036, C$2.75B 5.000% due 2056; ≈ US$6.2B at an approximate 0.73 USD/CAD rate; priced 2026-05-05, closed 2026-05-11
title_en: Alphabet C$8.5B maple bond (≈ US$6.2B), largest ever in Canada
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 85 亿加元枫叶债券（约 62 亿美元），加拿大史上最大
summary_en: Alphabet sold C$8.5 billion of Canadian-dollar senior notes in four tranches due 2031–2056, its first maple bond and the largest corporate bond in Canadian history, alongside a €9 billion euro deal the same week; the 424B2 pricing supplement was filed on 2026-05-07. Converted at roughly 0.73 USD per CAD (≈ US$6.2B).
summary_zh: Alphabet 发行 85 亿加元的加元计价优先票据，共 4 档，2031–2056 年到期，是其首只枫叶债券，也是加拿大历史上最大的公司债，同周还发行了 90 亿欧元债券；424B2 定价补充文件于 2026 年 5 月 7 日提交。按约 0.73 美元/加元折算约 62 亿美元。

amount_text: $3.25B 6.192% senior secured notes due 2042, issued at par by Hut 8 DC LLC
title_en: Hut 8 $3.25B notes for the River Bend (Fluidstack/Anthropic) campus
title_zh: Hut 8 为 River Bend 园区（Fluidstack/Anthropic）发行 32.5 亿美元票据
summary_en: Hut 8's subsidiary Hut 8 DC sold $3.25B of 6.192% senior secured notes due 2042 to build the 245 MW River Bend data centre leased to Fluidstack and its substation, and to reimburse Hut 8's equity; the notes amortise from 2028.
summary_zh: Hut 8 子公司 Hut 8 DC 发行 32.5 亿美元、票息 6.192%、2042 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设出租给 Fluidstack 的 245 兆瓦 River Bend 数据中心及变电站，并返还 Hut 8 已投入的股本；票据自 2028 年起分期摊还。

title_en: Meta $25B bond sale
title_zh: Meta 发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: A day after raising 2026 capex guidance to $125–145B, Meta sold $25B of bonds via Citi and Morgan Stanley. Orders (~$96B) were smaller than in Oct 2025 and most tranches priced at wider spreads, a sign of investor fatigue with AI debt.
summary_zh: Meta 将 2026 年资本开支指引上调至 1250–1450 亿美元的次日，经花旗和摩根士丹利发行 250 亿美元债券。认购（约 960 亿美元）低于 2025 年 10 月，且多数品种利差更宽，显示投资者对 AI 债务的疲劳。

amount_text: Up to $40B: $10B of Series G-2 preferred at $259.14 a share (~$350B valuation) + up to $30B of convertible notes or non-voting stock under the March 2026 note purchase agreement through 2030, tied to compute-agreement conditions and revenue targets; $10B of that went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $20B available at 30 June 2026 (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Google to invest up to $40B in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌向 Anthropic 投资最多 400 亿美元
summary_en: Google bought $10B of Anthropic preferred stock at a $350B valuation and agreed to provide up to $30B more in convertible notes or non-voting stock through 2030 if conditions under compute agreements and revenue targets are met. Anthropic's S-1 shows $10B of that facility was used in the May 2026 Series H, leaving $20B; Google may instead buy up to $10B of stock alongside the IPO, which would reduce the facility by the same amount.
summary_zh: 谷歌以 3500 亿美元估值购入 100 亿美元 Anthropic 优先股，并同意在 2030 年前、视算力协议条件和营收目标达成情况，再以可转换票据或无投票权股票提供最多 300 亿美元。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，其中 100 亿美元已用于 2026 年 5 月的 H 轮融资，剩余 200 亿美元；谷歌也可在 IPO 时同步认购最多 100 亿美元股票，届时该额度相应减少。

amount_text: Debt size undisclosed; total campus cost ~$16B (Related Digital + Blackstone equity, PIMCO-anchored debt)
title_en: PIMCO-anchored debt for Oracle's $16B Michigan campus
title_zh: PIMCO 牵头认购甲骨文密歇根 160 亿美元园区的债务融资
summary_en: Related Digital and Blackstone funds financed the $16B 'The Barn' campus in Saline Township, Michigan, built for Oracle's OpenAI capacity, with fixed-rate long-term debt anchored by PIMCO and Bank of America as structuring agent. Blue Owl had walked away from the project in Dec 2025 after lenders reportedly pushed for tougher terms (Oracle disputed that account).
summary_zh: Related Digital 与黑石旗下基金为甲骨文服务 OpenAI 的密歇根 Saline 镇 160 亿美元“The Barn”园区完成融资，债务部分为 PIMCO（品浩）牵头认购的长期固定利率债务，美国银行担任结构安排行。此前 Blue Owl 因放贷方要求更严苛条款，于 2025 年 12 月退出该项目（甲骨文对此说法有异议）。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no contract value given
title_en: Tesla picks Intel 14A for its Terafab chips
title_zh: 特斯拉选择英特尔 14A 工艺生产 Terafab 芯片
summary_en: On Tesla's Q1 2026 earnings call Elon Musk said Tesla plans to make AI chips at its Terafab complex on Intel's 14A process, which would make Tesla the first major named external 14A customer.
summary_zh: 马斯克在特斯拉 2026 年第一季度财报电话会上表示，特斯拉计划在 Terafab 项目中采用英特尔 14A 工艺生产 AI 芯片，使特斯拉成为 14A 首个公开的大客户。

amount_text: Up to $25B: $5B of Series G-2 preferred (Q2 2026) + up to $20B under the 2026 note purchase agreement (non-voting stock or convertible notes), released in $5B tranches tied to compute-capacity milestones; $5B of it went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $15B available at 30 June 2026 (Anthropic S-1). Separate from ~$6.2B of older Amazon rollover notes
title_en: Amazon to invest up to $25B more in Anthropic
title_zh: 亚马逊再向 Anthropic 投资最多 250 亿美元
summary_en: Amazon agreed to invest $5B in Anthropic immediately and up to $20B more tied to compute-capacity milestones, on top of its earlier $8B, as Anthropic committed to AWS. Anthropic's S-1 shows the $5B was paid for preferred stock in the second quarter of 2026 and a further $5B from the milestone facility went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $15B available.
