summary_zh: 亚马逊同意立即向 Anthropic 投资 50 亿美元，并视算力容量里程碑再投最多 200 亿美元（此前已投 80 亿美元），同时 Anthropic 向 AWS 作出采购承诺。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，这 50 亿美元已于 2026 年第二季度用于认购优先股，里程碑额度中另有 50 亿美元投入 2026 年 5 月的 H 轮融资，剩余 150 亿美元可用。

amount_text: At least $110B with AWS through April 2036 regardless of usage, non-cancelable except for Amazon's material breach, per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026); announced in Apr 2026 as >$100B over 10 years, up to 5 GW incl. Trainium2-Trainium4
title_en: Anthropic commits $110B to AWS through 2036 (>$100B announced)
title_zh: Anthropic 承诺至 2036 年在 AWS 支出 1100 亿美元（公告时为逾 1000 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic secured up to 5 GW of AWS capacity, with nearly 1 GW of Trainium2 and Trainium3 online by end-2026, and committed more than $100B to AWS services over ten years. Its October 2026 S-1 puts the minimum at $110B through April 2036, non-cancelable except for a material breach by Amazon.
summary_zh: Anthropic 锁定最多 5 吉瓦 AWS 算力，其中近 1 吉瓦 Trainium2/Trainium3 将于 2026 年底前上线，并承诺十年内在 AWS 服务上支出逾 1000 亿美元。其 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示最低承诺为至 2036 年 4 月 1100 亿美元，除亚马逊重大违约外不可撤销。

amount_text: ≈$3.6B: $1.5B 10-year USD notes at a record 8.5% coupon + €1.75B (≈$2.1B at an approximate 1.17 USD/EUR rate); priced 2026-04-15
title_en: SoftBank $3.6B high-yield bonds to repay OpenAI bridge loans
title_zh: 软银发行 36 亿美元高收益债券以偿还 OpenAI 相关过桥贷款
summary_en: SoftBank sold $1.5 billion and €1.75 billion of bonds on 15 April 2026, paying a record 8.5% on the 10-year dollar tranche, with part of the proceeds earmarked to repay bridge loans tied to its OpenAI investments.
summary_zh: 软银于 2026 年 4 月 15 日发行 15 亿美元及 17.5 亿欧元债券，10 年期美元债票息达创纪录的 8.5%，部分募集资金用于偿还与 OpenAI 投资相关的过桥贷款。

amount_text: ~$6B commitment to CoreWeave cloud services across several data centres, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems (term not disclosed)
title_en: Jane Street $6B AI cloud deal with CoreWeave
title_zh: Jane Street 与 CoreWeave 签订 60 亿美元 AI 云合同
summary_en: Trading firm Jane Street committed about $6B to CoreWeave cloud services, including NVIDIA Vera Rubin capacity, and at the same time bought $1B of CoreWeave stock (separate edge).
summary_zh: 交易公司 Jane Street 承诺采购约 60 亿美元 CoreWeave 云服务（含英伟达 Vera Rubin 算力），同时认购 10 亿美元 CoreWeave 股票（另列一条）。

amount_text: $1.0B: 9,174,311 Class A shares at $109.00 (about 7% below the prior close)
title_en: Jane Street invests $1B in CoreWeave
title_zh: Jane Street 向 CoreWeave 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: Jane Street bought $1B of newly issued CoreWeave Class A shares at $109 in a private placement on 15 April 2026, alongside its $6B cloud contract, lifting its stake to about $1.44B.
summary_zh: Jane Street 于 2026 年 4 月 15 日以每股 109 美元私募认购 10 亿美元 CoreWeave 新发行 A 类股，同时签订 60 亿美元云合同，持股市值增至约 14.4 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; initial commitment of more than 1 GW, the first phase of a multi-gigawatt rollout
title_en: Meta commits to multi-gigawatt MTIA custom chips with Broadcom
title_zh: Meta 与博通签署数吉瓦 MTIA 定制芯片合作
summary_en: Broadcom and Meta extended their custom-silicon partnership through 2029 across several MTIA generations, with Meta committing to an initial deployment of more than 1 GW on 2nm; Hock Tan moves from Meta's board to an advisory role.
summary_zh: 博通与 Meta 将定制芯片合作延长至 2029 年，覆盖多代 MTIA，Meta 承诺首期部署逾 1 吉瓦的 2 纳米芯片；博通 CEO 陈福阳将由 Meta 董事会转任顾问。

amount_text: Undisclosed; up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cells (1.2 GW already contracted for 2026–27); Bloom issued Oracle a warrant for 3,531,073 shares at $113.28 (agreed Oct 2025, issued 2026-04-09, exercised cashless on 2026-05-01 for 1,905,433 shares)
title_en: Oracle fuel-cell supply deal with Bloom Energy (up to 2.8 GW)
title_zh: 甲骨文与 Bloom Energy 的燃料电池供电协议（最高 2.8 吉瓦）
summary_en: Bloom Energy said it will supply Oracle with up to 2.8 GW of fuel-cell capacity for its AI and cloud data centres under an expanded master agreement, of which 1.2 GW is already contracted and being deployed. The value was not disclosed; Bloom also issued Oracle a warrant.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy 表示，根据扩大后的主协议，将为甲骨文的 AI 和云数据中心提供最高 2.8 吉瓦的燃料电池发电容量，其中 1.2 吉瓦已签约并在部署中。金额未披露；Bloom 还向甲骨文发行了认股权证。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: Anthropic multi-year cloud deal with CoreWeave
title_zh: Anthropic 与 CoreWeave 的多年期云合同
summary_en: Anthropic signed a multi-year agreement to run Claude workloads on CoreWeave, a day after CoreWeave's $21B Meta expansion; terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: Anthropic 签署多年期协议在 CoreWeave 上运行 Claude 工作负载，时间在 CoreWeave 与 Meta 210 亿美元扩容协议次日，条款未披露。

amount_text: $4.0B 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2032 (priced at an upsized $3.5B; initial purchasers' $500M option exercised, per the 10-Q)
title_en: CoreWeave $4B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 40 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $3.5B of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2032, a day after its 9.75% bond; with the $500M option exercised it issued $4.0B in April 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 在发行 9.75% 债券次日，定价扩容后的 35 亿美元、票息 1.75%、2032 年到期可转换优先票据；加上行使的 5 亿美元超额配售，2026 年 4 月共发行 40 亿美元。

amount_text: $1.75B 9.750% senior notes due 2031 (Apr 9) + $1B tack-on at 102% (Apr 2026)
title_en: CoreWeave $2.75B 9.75% senior notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 27.5 亿美元 9.75% 优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave sold $1.75B of 9.75% senior notes due 2031 and then a $1B add-on to the same notes, partly to repay debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 发行 17.5 亿美元、票息 9.75%、2031 年到期优先票据，随后同一品种增发 10 亿美元，部分用于偿债。

amount_text: ~$21B through Dec 2032; total Meta-CoreWeave contracts ~$35B
title_en: Meta expands CoreWeave contract by $21B
title_zh: Meta 追加 210 亿美元 CoreWeave 合同
summary_en: Meta signed a further ~$21B of CoreWeave capacity through 2032, including early Nvidia Vera Rubin deployments for inference, taking its total CoreWeave commitments to about $35B.
summary_zh: Meta 再签约约 210 亿美元 CoreWeave 算力（至 2032 年），包括首批用于推理的英伟达 Vera Rubin 部署，使其对 CoreWeave 的承诺总额达约 350 亿美元。

amount_text: US$505M at ~US$5.5B valuation, led by Coatue with NVIDIA participating
title_en: Firmus raises $505M led by Coatue
title_zh: Firmus 获 Coatue 领投 5.05 亿美元融资
summary_en: Nvidia-backed Firmus raised US$505M in a round led by Coatue at about a US$5.5B valuation to expand its Project Southgate AI factories in Australia.
summary_zh: 英伟达支持的 Firmus 完成由 Coatue 领投的 5.05 亿美元融资，估值约 55 亿美元，用于扩建其在澳大利亚的 Project Southgate AI 工厂。

subkind: long-term custom TPU development and supply agreement
amount_text: Undisclosed; no pricing or minimum volumes disclosed
title_en: Google locks in Broadcom for TPUs through 2031
title_zh: 谷歌与博通签署至 2031 年的 TPU 长期协议
summary_en: Broadcom disclosed in an 8-K a long-term agreement to develop and supply future generations of Google's custom TPUs, plus a supply-assurance deal for networking and other parts of Google's AI racks through 2031, alongside expanded TPU capacity for Anthropic.
summary_zh: 博通在 8-K 中披露与谷歌签订长期协议，开发并供应未来多代定制 TPU，另签供应保障协议覆盖谷歌 AI 机架的网络及其他部件至 2031 年，同时扩大为 Anthropic 提供的 TPU 产能。

amount_text: At least ~$114.5B of Google TPU spend between April 2026 and July 2033 per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026), non-cancelable except for Google's uncured material breach, with a true-up if spending falls short; this covers Anthropic's Google TPU deals together, so the Oct 2025 edge stays without an amount. 5 GW of next-gen TPU capacity from 2027 (Anthropic); a Broadcom filing cited ~3.5 GW
title_en: Anthropic 5 GW TPU deal with Google and Broadcom
title_zh: Anthropic 与谷歌、博通的 5 吉瓦 TPU 协议
summary_en: Anthropic signed with Google and Broadcom for 5 GW of next-generation TPU capacity coming online from 2027, which its CFO called its largest compute commitment to date; an earlier Broadcom filing cited about 3.5 GW. Anthropic's S-1 (October 2026) shows a minimum of about $114.5B of Google TPU commitments from April 2026 through July 2033, with a true-up payment if spending falls short, plus further TPU compute to be delivered in 2028-2031.
summary_zh: Anthropic 与谷歌及博通签约，自 2027 年起获得 5 吉瓦下一代 TPU 算力，其首席财务官称这是公司迄今最大的算力承诺；博通此前的文件显示规模约 3.5 吉瓦。Anthropic 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示，2026 年 4 月至 2033 年 7 月间对谷歌 TPU 的最低承诺约 1145 亿美元，支出不足须补足差额，另有 2028–2031 年交付的更多 TPU 算力。

amount_text: ~$12B beyond the $110B first close (round total $122B at $852B post-money), incl. ~$3B from individuals via bank channels
title_en: OpenAI extends its round by ~$12B to $122B
title_zh: OpenAI 融资轮追加约 120 亿美元至 1220 亿美元
summary_en: After the $110B first close with Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank, OpenAI took roughly $12B more from a wider investor pool including a16z, D. E. Shaw, MGX, TPG and T. Rowe Price-advised accounts, plus about $3B from individuals through banks, closing at $122B and an $852B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: 在亚马逊、英伟达和软银参与的 1100 亿美元首轮之后，OpenAI 又从 a16z、D. E. Shaw、MGX、TPG 及普信旗下账户等更广泛的投资者处募得约 120 亿美元，另通过银行渠道向个人投资者募资约 30 亿美元，最终以 1220 亿美元、投后估值 8520 亿美元完成该轮融资。

amount_text: $830M from seven banks (Bpifrance, BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, La Banque Postale, MUFG, Natixis CIB), per reports quoting the company
title_en: Mistral AI raises $830M of debt for Paris-area data centre
title_zh: Mistral AI 为巴黎附近数据中心举债 8.3 亿美元
summary_en: Mistral AI took its first big debt, an $830M loan from a seven-bank group, to fund Nvidia GB300 GPUs (about 13,800) and 44 MW at an Eclairion-run site in Bruyères-le-Châtel, south of Paris.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 首次大规模举债，从七家银行组成的银团获得 8.3 亿美元贷款，用于在巴黎南部 Bruyères-le-Châtel、由 Eclairion 运营的站点部署约 1.38 万颗英伟达 GB300 GPU 和 44 兆瓦容量。

subkind: investment-grade GPU-backed delayed draw term loan (DDTL 4.0)
amount_text: $8.5B (≈$7.5B initial, up to $8.5B on stabilisation); A3 (Moody's); floating SOFR+2.25% and ~5.9% fixed tranches; led by MUFG and Morgan Stanley
title_en: CoreWeave $8.5B investment-grade GPU loan
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 85 亿美元投资级 GPU 抵押贷款
summary_en: The first investment-grade rated GPU-backed financing: a non-recourse $8.5B loan secured by the chips and a customer contract that Bloomberg identified as CoreWeave's Meta deal. MUFG and Morgan Stanley led, with Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Blackstone participating.
summary_zh: 首笔获投资级评级的 GPU 抵押融资：85 亿美元无追索权贷款，以芯片及一份客户合同（彭博称为 CoreWeave 与 Meta 的合同）为抵押，由三菱日联与摩根士丹利牵头，高盛、摩根大通和黑石参与。

amount_text: $40B unsecured bridge; lenders JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Mizuho, SMBC, MUFG; matures 2027-03-25
title_en: SoftBank $40B bridge loan for its $30B OpenAI follow-on
title_zh: 软银 400 亿美元过桥贷款用于追加投资 OpenAI 300 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank signed a $40B one-year bridge facility with five banks, mainly to fund its additional $30B investment in OpenAI's $110B+ round; it plans to repay in stages from asset sales and other financing. SoftBank drew $30B and prepaid the remaining $25.9B on 15 September 2026, retiring the facility; the undrawn $10B was cancelled on 30 September 2026.
summary_zh: 软银与五家银行签署 400 亿美元一年期过桥贷款，主要用于在 OpenAI 逾 1100 亿美元融资轮中追加投资 300 亿美元，计划通过出售资产及其他融资分阶段偿还。 软银共提取 300 亿美元，并于 2026 年 9 月 15 日提前偿还剩余 259 亿美元，该贷款已全部结清；未提取的 100 亿美元额度于 2026 年 9 月 30 日取消。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: Meta is first customer for Arm's own AGI CPU
title_zh: Meta 成为 Arm 自研 AGI CPU 首个客户
summary_en: Arm launched its first in-house chip, the AGI CPU made on TSMC 3nm, with Meta, which co-developed it, as the first customer, moving Arm beyond licensing into selling silicon.
summary_zh: Arm 推出首款自研芯片——采用台积电 3 纳米的 AGI CPU，共同开发者 Meta 为首个客户，标志 Arm 从授权模式转向直接销售芯片。

amount_text: Undisclosed; named as an early customer, no volumes or terms disclosed
title_en: OpenAI named as early customer for Arm's AGI CPU
title_zh: OpenAI 被列为 Arm AGI CPU 的早期客户
summary_en: OpenAI was named among the early customers for Arm's first in-house data-centre chip, the AGI CPU, alongside Cloudflare and SAP; no order size was given.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Cloudflare、SAP 一同被列为 Arm 首款自研数据中心芯片 AGI CPU 的早期客户；未披露订单规模。

amount_text: Undisclosed; no volumes, prices or term disclosed
title_en: AMD and Samsung MOU for primary HBM4 supply
title_zh: AMD 与三星签署 HBM4 主力供应谅解备忘录
summary_en: Samsung and AMD signed an MOU to align on primary HBM4 supply for the Instinct MI455X GPU and DRAM for EPYC Venice, and to discuss Samsung foundry work; Lisa Su revisited Samsung in October 2026 as talks on a firmer long-term deal continued.
summary_zh: 三星与 AMD 签署谅解备忘录，三星将作为 Instinct MI455X GPU 的 HBM4 主力供应商并为 EPYC Venice 提供 DRAM，双方还将探讨代工合作；2026 年 10 月苏姿丰再访三星，长期协议仍在商谈。

amount_text: $4.3375B at closing: $2.5875B 1.25% due 2031 (incl. $337.5M option exercised in full) + $1.75B 2.625% due 2033; a further option of up to $262.5M of 2033 notes was still open at closing (20 Mar 2026, 6-K)
title_en: Nebius $4.34B convertible notes
title_zh: Nebius 发行 43.4 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Nebius priced an upsized $4.0B two-part convertible note offering to keep funding AI capacity; with the option on the 2031 notes exercised, $4.34B closed on 20 March 2026.
summary_zh: Nebius 定价扩容后的 40 亿美元两档可转换票据，继续为 AI 算力建设融资；2031 年票据的超额认购权行使后，43.4 亿美元于 2026 年 3 月 20 日完成交割。

amount_text: $500M added on 18 March 2026, bringing the bridge facility to $1.0B; repaid 6 May 2026
title_en: JPMorgan $500M bridge loan to Core Scientific (repaid)
title_zh: 摩根大通向 Core Scientific 提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: An amendment of 18 March 2026 used the accordion in Core Scientific's bridge facility to add $500M of commitments from JPMorgan Chase Bank, taking it to $1.0B; repaid in full on 6 May 2026 from the $3.3B notes offering.
summary_zh: 2026 年 3 月 18 日的修订协议启用过桥信贷的增额条款，由摩根大通新增 5 亿美元承诺额，总额增至 10 亿美元；2026 年 5 月 6 日以 33 亿美元票据发行所得全部偿还。

amount_text: Up to ~$27B: $12B dedicated capacity + up to $15B purchase commitment
term: 5 years; Vera Rubin capacity from early 2027
title_en: Meta up to $27B AI infrastructure deal with Nebius
title_zh: Meta 与 Nebius 最高 270 亿美元的 AI 基础设施协议
summary_en: Nebius signed a five-year deal with Meta worth up to about $27B: $12B of dedicated Vera Rubin capacity from early 2027 and a commitment of up to $15B for capacity Nebius cannot sell to other customers.
summary_zh: Nebius 与 Meta 签署为期五年、最高约 270 亿美元的协议：自 2027 年初起提供 120 亿美元专属 Vera Rubin 算力，另有最多 150 亿美元用于兜底 Nebius 未能售予其他客户的容量。

subkind: hardware lease of AI systems with warrant
amount_text: Not disclosed; multi-year lease of Cerebras systems in AWS data centres with options for further purchases; Cerebras issued AWS a warrant for up to 2,696,678 shares at $100, vesting with AWS payments
term: initial multi-year lease (agreement signed June 2026; not yet commenced at 30 June 2026)
title_en: AWS lease of Cerebras AI systems, with a Cerebras warrant
title_zh: AWS 租用 Cerebras AI 系统（附 Cerebras 认股权证）
summary_en: Amazon and Cerebras announced in March 2026 a joint inference service pairing AWS Trainium3 with Cerebras systems inside AWS data centres; in June 2026 they signed a global hardware leasing agreement with exclusivity and minimum manufacturing capacity guarantees for AWS. Cerebras issued Amazon a warrant for up to about 2.7 million shares at $100, vesting as AWS payments reach set thresholds; the value was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与 Cerebras 于 2026 年 3 月宣布在 AWS 数据中心内将 Trainium3 与 Cerebras 系统结合提供推理服务；2026 年 6 月双方签署全球硬件租赁协议，包含对 AWS 的排他条款和最低产能保证。Cerebras 向亚马逊发行认股权证，可按每股 100 美元认购最多约 270 万股，随 AWS 付款达到门槛分批归属；金额未披露。

subkind: offshore GPU compute rental (Nvidia B200, Malaysia)
amount_text: Undisclosed rental value; ~500 Blackwell systems (~36,000 B200 chips) whose hardware would cost >$2.5B, per WSJ
title_en: ByteDance rents Nvidia Blackwell cluster from Aolani Cloud in Malaysia
title_zh: 字节跳动向 Aolani Cloud 租用马来西亚英伟达 Blackwell 算力
summary_en: ByteDance is working with Aolani Cloud to use about 36,000 Nvidia B200 chips in Malaysia, according to the Wall Street Journal, and has made initial payments; Aolani has leased H100 servers to ByteDance there since February 2025. Aolani says its customers do not own the chips; renting capacity outside China is allowed under current US export rules.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，字节跳动与 Aolani Cloud 合作，在马来西亚使用约 3.6 万颗英伟达 B200 芯片，并已支付首期款项；自 2025 年 2 月起 Aolani 已在当地向字节出租 H100 服务器。Aolani 称客户并不拥有芯片；按现行美国出口规则，租用中国境外的算力是被允许的。

amount_text: $500M 364-day delayed-draw senior secured bridge facility to Raylan Data LLC; SOFR + 2.75%
title_en: Morgan Stanley $500M bridge loan for TeraWulf's Hawesville campus
title_zh: 摩根士丹利为 TeraWulf Hawesville 园区提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款
summary_en: Lenders with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as agent provided TeraWulf's subsidiary Raylan Data a 364-day, $500 million delayed-draw secured bridge loan to build its data centre in Hawesville, Kentucky, the campus later leased to Anthropic (separate edge).
summary_zh: 以摩根士丹利为代理行的贷款方向 TeraWulf 子公司 Raylan Data 提供为期 364 天、5 亿美元的延迟提款有担保过桥贷款，用于建设肯塔基州 Hawesville 数据中心；该园区后来租给 Anthropic（另列）。

amount_text: ~$2B via pre-funded warrants for 21.07M shares; Nvidia stake 9.3% (Jul 2026 filing)
title_en: Nvidia invests $2B in Nebius
title_zh: 英伟达向 Nebius 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia invested about $2B in Nebius through pre-funded warrants, and Nebius gets early access to Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs as it targets more than 5 GW of Nvidia capacity by 2030. A July 2026 filing showed Nvidia holding 9.3%.
summary_zh: 英伟达通过预付认股权证向 Nebius 投资约 20 亿美元，Nebius 获得 Rubin GPU 和 Vera CPU 优先供货，目标 2030 年前建成逾 5 吉瓦英伟达算力。2026 年 7 月的文件显示英伟达持股 9.3%。

amount_text: $37B USD (11 tranches, 2–50 years) + €14.5B euro debut (~$16.8B at the March 2026 pricing-date rate, per Bloomberg's ~$54B total); Treasury & Risk's earlier headline said 'nearly $50B'
title_en: Amazon ~$54B dollar and euro bond sales
title_zh: 亚马逊发行约 540 亿美元美元及欧元债券
summary_en: Amazon raised $37B in dollars (about $126B of orders) plus a record €14.5B euro debut, one of the largest corporate bond sales ever not tied to an acquisition, to fund about $200B of 2026 capex.
summary_zh: 亚马逊发行 370 亿美元美元债（订单约 1260 亿美元），并首次发行创纪录的 145 亿欧元欧元债，成为史上最大的非并购类企业发债之一，用于 2026 年约 2000 亿美元资本开支。

amount_text: NT$645.1B of 2025 revenue from 'client B', widely reported to be Apple (17% of TSMC revenue, down from 22%); ~US$20.6B at the exchange rate used for client A
title_en: Apple paid TSMC about $20.6B in 2025
title_zh: 苹果 2025 年向台积电支付约 206 亿美元
summary_en: TSMC's second-largest customer in 2025, reported to be Apple, contributed NT$645.1B, up 3.3% but slipping to 17% of revenue as Nvidia's AI orders overtook it. TSMC does not name customers.
summary_zh: 台积电 2025 年第二大客户（据报道为苹果）贡献 6451 亿新台币，增长 3.3%，但占比降至 17%，被英伟达的 AI 订单超越；台积电并未点名客户。

amount_text: $10.0B five-year revolving credit agreement dated 6 Mar 2026, replacing a $6.0B revolver; undrawn at 31 May 2026
title_en: Oracle $10B revolving credit facility
title_zh: 甲骨文 100 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: Oracle replaced its $6B revolver with a new $10B five-year revolving credit agreement with a bank group in March 2026 and raised its commercial paper programme to $10B; nothing was drawn on the revolver at 31 May 2026.
summary_zh: 甲骨文于 2026 年 3 月以与银团签订的 100 亿美元五年期循环信贷协议取代原 60 亿美元额度，并将商业票据计划提高至 100 亿美元；截至 2026 年 5 月 31 日该循环额度未提款。

subkind: foundry wafer and packaging purchases (2025 total)
amount_text: NT$726.9B (~US$23.2B) of 2025 revenue from TSMC's 'client A', widely reported to be Nvidia (TSMC does not name customers); 19% of TSMC revenue (12% in 2024)
title_en: Nvidia becomes TSMC's largest customer ($23B in 2025)
title_zh: 英伟达成为台积电最大客户（2025 年约 232 亿美元）
summary_en: TSMC's 2025 figures show its largest customer, reported to be Nvidia, paid NT$726.9B (about $23.2B), more than double 2024, overtaking Apple. The identification comes from press reports and Jensen Huang's remarks, not from TSMC.
summary_zh: 台积电 2025 年数据显示，第一大客户（据报道为英伟达）贡献营收 7269 亿新台币（约 232 亿美元），较 2024 年翻倍以上，超越苹果；客户身份来自媒体报道和黄仁勋的表述，台积电并未点名。

amount_text: $2.15B 6.750% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 98% by APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC; priced 2026-03-04, closed ~2026-03-10 (proceeds held in escrow until the escrow condition was met)
title_en: Applied Digital $2.15B 6.75% secured notes for the Polaris Forge 2 campus
title_zh: Applied Digital 发行 21.5 亿美元 6.75% 担保票据，用于 Polaris Forge 2 园区
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC priced $2.15 billion of 6.75% senior secured notes due 2031 to fund 200 MW of critical IT load at the Polaris Forge 2 campus in Harwood, North Dakota, with Applied Digital giving a completion guarantee; the notes are secured by first-priority liens on the issuer's assets.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC 定价发行 21.5 亿美元、票面利率 6.75%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设北达科他州 Harwood 的 Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 MW 关键 IT 负载，Applied Digital 提供完工担保；票据以发行人资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押。

amount_text: $500M of a $1.0B senior secured delayed-draw bridge facility (Term SOFR + 2.50%); repaid 6 May 2026
title_en: Morgan Stanley $500M bridge loan to Core Scientific (repaid)
title_zh: 摩根士丹利向 Core Scientific 提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: Core Scientific's 364-day Delayed-Draw Bridge Credit Agreement of 4 March 2026, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent and initial $500M lender; it was repaid in full on 6 May 2026 from the $3.3B notes offering.
summary_zh: Core Scientific 于 2026 年 3 月 4 日签订 364 天延迟提款过桥信贷协议，摩根士丹利为行政代理行并提供首批 5 亿美元；2026 年 5 月 6 日以 33 亿美元票据发行所得全部偿还。

amount_text: $20B bridge (Goldman Sachs, BofA, Citi, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley); retired ~$17.5–18.9B of X and xAI debt; repaid from June 2026 bonds
title_en: SpaceX $20B bridge loan to refinance xAI and X debt
title_zh: SpaceX 200 亿美元过桥贷款为 xAI 和 X 债务再融资
summary_en: After merging with xAI on 2026-02-02, SpaceX drew a Goldman-led $20B bridge loan to repay high-cost X and xAI debt (paying ~$1.16B of prepayment penalties), then refinanced the bridge with investment-grade bonds after its June IPO.
summary_zh: SpaceX 于 2026 年 2 月 2 日完成与 xAI 合并后，提取高盛牵头的 200 亿美元过桥贷款，偿还 X 和 xAI 的高成本债务（支付约 11.6 亿美元提前还款罚金），并在 6 月上市后以投资级债券置换该过桥贷款。

amount_text: ~$2.0B contracted lease payments over the 15-year base term (~$5.7B if three 5-year extensions are exercised); 70 MW critical IT (100 MW gross); signed March 2026 (day not disclosed), tenant named 2026-06-08
title_en: AWS leases Cipher's 70 MW Stingray data centre in Texas (~$2.0B)
title_zh: AWS 租用 Cipher 得州 Stingray 70 兆瓦数据中心（约 20 亿美元）
summary_en: Amazon Data Services (AWS) signed a 15-year triple-net lease for 70 MW of critical IT capacity at Cipher Digital's Stingray site in Andrews, Texas, worth about $2.0 billion in base rent, with rent from April 2027; Amazon.com guarantees the rent and covers construction cost overruns above a cap. It is Cipher's second AWS lease after Black Pearl.
summary_zh: 亚马逊数据服务公司（AWS）与 Cipher Digital 签订为期 15 年的三净租约，租用其得州安德鲁斯 Stingray 园区 70 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，基础租金约 20 亿美元，2027 年 4 月起计租；亚马逊母公司为租金提供担保，并承担超出上限的建设成本。这是继 Black Pearl 之后 Cipher 与 AWS 的第二份租约。

amount_text: Up to $42.0B of 9% PIK convertible notes (13% and a deeper conversion discount if revenue conditions are missed), drawable for five years once the leased equipment is ready for service, solely to pay quarterly rent under the 2026 Broadcom equipment lease; undrawn at 30 June 2026 (Anthropic S-1). The rent itself is counted on anthropic-broadcom-2026-10-equipment-leases
term: Draw period 5 years from equipment readiness; notes mature 57-63 months from the start of the draw period
title_en: Broadcom $42B convertible note facility for Anthropic's rack rent
title_zh: 博通为 Anthropic 机架租金提供 420 亿美元可转债融资额度
summary_en: Under a March 2026 note purchase agreement (day not disclosed), Anthropic may issue up to $42B of convertible notes to Broadcom, or a financial partner Broadcom designates, solely to finance rent on the 2026 master equipment lease for Broadcom TPU racks; interest is 9% paid in kind and holders can convert into stock at 90% of the market price. Draws depend on revenue-growth and liquidity conditions, and none had been made at 30 June 2026.
summary_zh: 根据 2026 年 3 月签订的票据购买协议（具体日期未披露），Anthropic 可向博通或其指定的金融合作方发行最多 420 亿美元可转换票据，专门用于支付 2026 年博通 TPU 机架设备总租约的租金；利率 9%、以实物支付，持有人可按市价 90% 转股。提取须满足营收增长和流动性条件，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日尚未提取。

amount_text: $50B committed: $15B upfront + $35B conditional (deadline 2028-12-31); $28.7B funded by 2026-06-30 per 10-Q
title_en: Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI
title_zh: 亚马逊向 OpenAI 投资 500 亿美元
summary_en: Amazon committed $50B to OpenAI's round, $15B upfront and $35B on conditions tied to the AWS partnership (deadline 31 December 2028). Amazon's 10-Q shows $28.7B funded by 30 June 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊承诺向 OpenAI 投资 500 亿美元，其中 150 亿美元先行到位，其余 350 亿美元附带与 AWS 合作挂钩的条件（截止日期为 2028 年 12 月 31 日）。亚马逊 10-Q 显示，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日已出资 287 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'multi-billion', multi-year
term: Multi-year; possible direct TPU purchases from 2027
title_en: Meta rents Google TPUs in multi-billion deal
title_zh: Meta 签署数十亿美元谷歌 TPU 租用协议
summary_en: The Information reported that Meta signed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar deal to rent Google TPUs for training next-generation models; earlier reports said Meta could also buy TPUs for its own data centres from 2027.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 签署多年期、数十亿美元协议租用谷歌 TPU 训练下一代模型；此前报道称 Meta 可能自 2027 年起直接采购 TPU 部署于自有数据中心。

amount_text: $30B in OpenAI's $122B round (closed 31 Mar 2026, $852B post-money)
title_en: Nvidia invests $30B in OpenAI
title_zh: 英伟达向 OpenAI 投资 300 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia put $30B into OpenAI's record round alongside Amazon and SoftBank, replacing the earlier $100B letter of intent; unlike that plan, the money is not tied to deployment milestones. The round closed on 31 March 2026 at $122B.
summary_zh: 英伟达与亚马逊、软银一同参与 OpenAI 创纪录融资，投资 300 亿美元，取代此前 1000 亿美元的意向书，且不再与算力部署里程碑挂钩。该轮融资于 2026 年 3 月 31 日以 1220 亿美元完成交割。

amount_text: +$100B over 8 years, incl. ~2 GW of Trainium capacity
title_en: OpenAI expands AWS commitment by $100B (Trainium)
title_zh: OpenAI 追加 1000 亿美元 AWS 承诺（Trainium 芯片）
summary_en: Alongside Amazon's $50B investment, OpenAI added $100B to its AWS agreement over eight years and committed to about 2 GW of Amazon Trainium capacity; AWS became the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier.
summary_zh: 在亚马逊投资 500 亿美元的同时，OpenAI 将 AWS 协议在八年内追加 1000 亿美元，并承诺使用约 2 吉瓦亚马逊 Trainium 算力；AWS 成为 OpenAI Frontier 平台独家第三方云分销商。

amount_text: $30B, paid in instalments during 2026 (SoftBank's Sept 2026 bonds fund its next $10B payment); cumulative SoftBank investment ~$64.6B (~13%)
title_en: SoftBank invests a further $30B in OpenAI
title_zh: 软银再向 OpenAI 投资 300 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank co-led OpenAI's $122B round with $30B, initially financed with bridge loans, lifting its cumulative investment to about $64.6B or roughly 13% of the company.
summary_zh: 软银以 300 亿美元联合领投 OpenAI 1220 亿美元融资，初期以过桥贷款筹资，累计投资增至约 646 亿美元，持股约 13%。

amount_text: Undisclosed value; more than 100 million advanced chips from TSMC Arizona in 2026
title_en: Apple to buy 100M+ chips from TSMC Arizona in 2026
title_zh: 苹果 2026 年将从台积电亚利桑那厂采购逾 1 亿颗芯片
summary_en: Apple said it is on track to buy more than 100 million advanced chips from TSMC's Arizona fab in 2026, up from 2025, under its $600B US investment pledge; procurement chief David Tom said Apple is taking as much of the fab's output as it can.
summary_zh: 苹果表示，作为其 6000 亿美元在美投资承诺的一部分，2026 年将从台积电亚利桑那厂采购逾 1 亿颗先进芯片，较 2025 年增加；其采购主管 David Tom 称苹果会尽可能买下该厂产能。

amount_text: Undisclosed by companies; reported ~$60B over 5 years to >$100B (WSJ); up to 6 GW
title_en: Meta deal for up to 6 GW of AMD GPUs
title_zh: Meta 采购最多 6 吉瓦 AMD GPU
summary_en: AMD and Meta agreed to deploy up to 6 GW of custom MI450-based GPUs in Helios racks, starting with 1 GW in the second half of 2026. Terms were not disclosed; reports range from about $60B to over $100B.
summary_zh: AMD 与 Meta 同意部署最多 6 吉瓦基于 MI450 的定制 GPU（Helios 机架），首批 1 吉瓦于 2026 年下半年开始。条款未披露，报道估值约 600 亿至逾 1000 亿美元不等。

amount_text: Performance warrant for up to 160M AMD shares (~10%), vesting with GW shipped and share-price thresholds
term: Vests from first 1 GW to 6 GW
title_en: AMD grants Meta warrant for up to 160M shares
title_zh: AMD 向 Meta 授予最多 1.6 亿股认股权证
summary_en: Mirroring its OpenAI deal, AMD issued Meta a performance warrant for up to 160 million shares that vests with GPU shipments from 1 GW to 6 GW and with AMD share-price targets reported to reach $600.
summary_zh: 与 OpenAI 协议如出一辙，AMD 向 Meta 发行最多 1.6 亿股的业绩认股权证，随 GPU 出货从 1 吉瓦增至 6 吉瓦及 AMD 股价目标（据报道最高 600 美元）分批归属。

amount_text: Undisclosed; millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs plus Grace/Vera CPUs
title_en: Meta multiyear deal for millions of Nvidia GPUs
title_zh: Meta 与英伟达签署数百万颗 GPU 的多年期协议
summary_en: Meta agreed a multiyear partnership to deploy millions of Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, the first large-scale Grace-only CPU deployment and Spectrum-X networking, on premises and via Nvidia cloud partners. Financial terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: Meta 与英伟达达成多年期合作，在自有及英伟达云合作伙伴数据中心部署数百万颗 Blackwell 和 Rubin GPU、首个大规模纯 Grace CPU 部署及 Spectrum-X 网络，财务条款未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the $30B Series G (round total is a separate edge)
title_en: MGX co-leads Anthropic's Series G
title_zh: MGX 联合领投 Anthropic G 轮
summary_en: MGX was a co-lead, with D. E. Shaw, Dragoneer, Founders Fund and ICONIQ, of Anthropic's $30B Series G led by GIC and Coatue at a $380B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: Anthropic 300 亿美元 G 轮融资由 GIC 和 Coatue 领投，投后估值 3800 亿美元；MGX 与 D. E. Shaw、Dragoneer、Founders Fund、ICONIQ 为联合领投方。

amount_text: ~€1.2B (~$1.4B) joint investment with EcoDataCenter
title_en: Mistral AI's $1.4B AI data centre in Sweden with EcoDataCenter
title_zh: Mistral AI 与 EcoDataCenter 在瑞典投资 14 亿美元建设 AI 数据中心
summary_en: Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter will invest about €1.2B in an AI data centre at EcoDataCenter's Borlänge site, which EcoDataCenter will design, build and run, designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs; opening is set for 2027.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 与 EcoDataCenter 将在 EcoDataCenter 位于博伦厄的站点投资约 12 亿欧元建设 AI 数据中心，由 EcoDataCenter 设计、建设和运营，面向英伟达 Vera Rubin GPU，计划 2027 年启用。

amount_text: $30.2B gross in Q1 2026 at $259.14 a share ($380B post-money): ~$23.45B of voting Series G-1 from 261 investors (counted here) + ~$6.7B of non-voting Series G-2 from strategic investors the S-1 does not name (not counted; reports said the round included part of Microsoft's and NVIDIA's commitments, which have their own edges). Google's $10B and Amazon's $5B of Series G-2 in Q2 are on their own edges
title_en: Anthropic $30B Series G at $380B
title_zh: Anthropic 300 亿美元 G 轮融资（估值 3800 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised $30B led by GIC and Coatue at a $380B post-money valuation. Its S-1 shows $23.45B of voting Series G-1 shares sold to 261 investors in January-February 2026 and about $6.7B of non-voting Series G-2 shares to strategic investors; reports said the round included part of the Microsoft and NVIDIA investments.
summary_zh: Anthropic 完成 300 亿美元 G 轮融资，由 GIC 与 Coatue 领投，投后估值 3800 亿美元。S-1 显示，2026 年 1-2 月向 261 名投资者出售了 234.5 亿美元有投票权的 G-1 优先股，另向战略投资者出售约 67 亿美元无投票权 G-2 优先股；报道称本轮包含微软和英伟达投资的一部分。

amount_text: US$10B facility led by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Blackstone Credit & Insurance, with Coatue
title_en: Blackstone leads $10B debt facility for Australia's Firmus
title_zh: 黑石牵头为澳大利亚 Firmus 提供 100 亿美元债务融资
summary_en: Blackstone funds led, with Coatue, a US$10B private debt facility for Nvidia-backed Firmus to fund the next stage of its Project Southgate AI factories.
summary_zh: 黑石基金牵头、Coatue 参与，为英伟达支持的 Firmus 提供 100 亿美元私募信贷额度，用于 Project Southgate AI 工厂下一阶段建设。

amount_text: Almost $32B: $20B USD (7 tranches) + £5.5B (~$7.5B, incl. £1B 100-year note) + CHF ~3.05B (~$3.95B)
title_en: Alphabet ~$32B multi-currency bonds incl. century bond
title_zh: Alphabet 发行近 320 亿美元多币种债券（含百年期债券）
summary_en: Alphabet borrowed almost $32B in under 24 hours across dollars, sterling and Swiss francs, including tech's first 100-year bond since 1997, after guiding 2026 capex to about $185B. The sterling and franc deals were each the largest corporate sales in those markets.
summary_zh: Alphabet 在将 2026 年资本开支指引定为约 1850 亿美元后，24 小时内以美元、英镑和瑞郎发债近 320 亿美元，其中包括自 1997 年以来科技公司首只百年期债券；英镑和瑞郎部分均创各自市场企业发债纪录。

amount_text: $2.0B 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031-02-15, issued at par by Black Pearl Compute LLC; ~$13B of orders (Bloomberg); priced 2026-02-04, closed 2026-02-11
title_en: Cipher Mining / Black Pearl Compute $2.0B secured notes for the AWS-leased Black Pearl site
title_zh: Cipher Mining / Black Pearl Compute 发行 20 亿美元担保票据，用于租给 AWS 的 Black Pearl 园区
summary_en: Cipher Mining's subsidiary Black Pearl Compute LLC sold $2.0 billion of 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031 to finish the Black Pearl data centre in Wink, Texas, which is leased to Amazon Web Services; the notes are guaranteed by the project subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on the project assets.
summary_zh: Cipher Mining 子公司 Black Pearl Compute LLC 发行 20 亿美元、票面利率 6.125%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于完成位于得州 Wink、租给亚马逊云（AWS）的 Black Pearl 数据中心；票据由项目子公司担保，并以项目资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押。

amount_text: $25B in eight tranches (3–40 years); debt half of a $45–50B 2026 debt-and-equity plan; ~$129B peak orders reported
title_en: Oracle $25B bond sale in $45–50B 2026 funding plan
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 250 亿美元债券（2026 年 450–500 亿美元融资计划的一部分）
summary_en: Oracle sold $25B of bonds as the debt part of a plan to raise up to $50B in debt and equity in 2026; its Q3 release says $30B was raised within days through investment-grade bonds and mandatory convertible preferred stock, with no further bonds expected in calendar 2026. In July 2026 S&P cut Oracle to BBB-, one notch above junk, citing AI capex and reliance on OpenAI.
summary_zh: 甲骨文发行 250 亿美元债券，作为 2026 年最多 500 亿美元股债融资计划中的债务部分；其第三财季公告称，数日内通过投资级债券和强制可转换优先股募得 300 亿美元，并预计 2026 自然年内不再发债。2026 年 7 月，标普以 AI 资本开支和对 OpenAI 的依赖为由，将其评级下调至 BBB-（仅高于垃圾级一档）。

amount_text: 100M depositary shares of 6.50% Series D mandatory convertible preferred (~$5B at $50 per depositary share); closed 5 Feb 2026
title_en: Oracle raises $5B with mandatory convertible preferred stock
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 50 亿美元强制可转换优先股
summary_en: Oracle sold 100 million depositary shares of 6.50% Series D mandatory convertible preferred stock (underwriting agreement 2 Feb, closed 5 Feb 2026), part of its 2026 debt-and-equity funding plan for AI data centres.
summary_zh: 甲骨文发行 1 亿份存托股，对应股息率 6.50% 的 D 系列强制可转换优先股（2 月 2 日签署承销协议，2026 年 2 月 5 日交割），为其 2026 年 AI 数据中心债务加股权融资计划的一部分。

amount_text: Not counted: all-stock merger, no cash changed hands; xAI valued at ~$250B and SpaceX at ~$1T (combined ~$1.25T, reported) — the figure is the valuation of xAI equity exchanged
title_en: SpaceX acquires xAI
title_zh: SpaceX 收购 xAI
summary_en: SpaceX acquired Elon Musk's xAI, making it a wholly owned subsidiary in a deal that reportedly valued xAI at $250B and SpaceX at $1T, ahead of SpaceX's planned IPO. xAI's Colossus data centres now rent compute to Anthropic and Google. The $250B is a valuation in an all-stock exchange, not cash, so no amount is counted.
summary_zh: SpaceX 收购马斯克旗下 xAI，使其成为全资子公司；据报道该交易对 xAI 估值 2500 亿美元、SpaceX 估值 1 万亿美元，为 SpaceX 计划中的上市铺路。xAI 的 Colossus 数据中心现向 Anthropic 和谷歌出租算力。 2500 亿美元是全股票换股中的估值而非现金，因此不计入金额。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Micron's HBM4 sales passed $1B within about four months of first shipments (exact Feb 2026 shipment day not given)
title_en: Micron supplies HBM4 for Nvidia's Vera Rubin
title_zh: 美光为英伟达 Vera Rubin 供应 HBM4
summary_en: Micron began HBM4 shipments in February 2026 and announced high-volume production aimed at Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; Jensen Huang said all three memory makers are qualified and producing.
summary_zh: 美光于 2026 年 2 月开始出货 HBM4，并宣布面向英伟达 Vera Rubin 平台量产；黄仁勋表示三家存储厂商均已通过认证并在生产。

amount_text: ~$14B (about CNY 100B) planned 2026 Nvidia chip budget, per SCMP, not a signed contract total; ~10,000 H200 delivered by Aug 2026 per FT
title_en: ByteDance plans ~$14B of Nvidia H200 purchases in 2026
title_zh: 字节跳动计划 2026 年采购约 140 亿美元英伟达 H200
summary_en: ByteDance planned to spend about $14B on Nvidia chips in 2026 once H200 sales to China were allowed; Beijing reportedly approved H200 purchases for ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent in January 2026 under conditions. By August 2026 ByteDance had reportedly taken delivery of roughly 10,000 H200s, far below the licence ceiling.
summary_zh: 字节跳动计划在 H200 获准对华销售后于 2026 年斥资约 140 亿美元采购英伟达芯片；据报道，2026 年 1 月北京有条件批准字节、阿里和腾讯采购 H200。据报道，截至 2026 年 8 月字节约收到 1 万颗 H200，远低于许可上限。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Beijing approval Jan 2026; ~10,000 H200 delivered by Aug 2026 per FT
title_en: Tencent buys Nvidia H200 chips after approvals
title_zh: 腾讯获批后采购英伟达 H200
summary_en: Tencent was among the first Chinese firms Beijing reportedly allowed to buy Nvidia H200s in January 2026. By August 2026 it had reportedly taken delivery of about 10,000 units.
summary_zh: 据报道，腾讯是 2026 年 1 月首批获北京批准采购英伟达 H200 的中国企业之一。据报道，截至 2026 年 8 月已收到约 1 万颗。

amount_text: ~$2B, inside the $20B Series E counted on private-investors-xai-2026-01-series-e; converted into SpaceX common stock (under 1%) in March 2026 after the xAI–SpaceX merger, carried at $2.00B cost per Tesla's 10-Q
title_en: Tesla invests about $2B in xAI
title_zh: 特斯拉向 xAI 投资约 20 亿美元
summary_en: Tesla disclosed in its Q4 2025 shareholder letter a roughly $2B investment in xAI's Series E preferred stock, with a framework agreement for AI collaboration. After xAI merged into SpaceX on 2 February 2026, Tesla's stake converted in March 2026 into SpaceX common stock representing under 1% of SpaceX, which Tesla's 10-Q carries as a $2.00B equity-method investment (about $2.9B at the end of September 2026). It is part of the Series E, so it is not counted again in the round total.
summary_zh: 特斯拉在 2025 年第四季度股东信中披露向 xAI E 轮优先股投资约 20 亿美元，并签署 AI 合作框架协议。xAI 于 2026 年 2 月 2 日并入 SpaceX 后，特斯拉所持股份于 2026 年 3 月转换为 SpaceX 普通股（持股不足 1%），特斯拉 10-Q 以 20.0 亿美元权益法投资列示（2026 年 9 月底约 29 亿美元）。该笔属于 E 轮的一部分，不重复计入轮次总额。

amount_text: $2B at $87.20/share, nearly doubling Nvidia's ~6.3% stake
title_en: Nvidia invests $2B more in CoreWeave
title_zh: 英伟达再向 CoreWeave 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia bought $2B of CoreWeave stock at $87.20 a share, nearly doubling its stake, and agreed to help CoreWeave secure land and power toward more than 5 GW of capacity by 2030. Bloomberg called it the latest circular deal in AI.
summary_zh: 英伟达以每股 87.20 美元买入 20 亿美元 CoreWeave 股票，持股接近翻倍，并同意协助 CoreWeave 获取土地和电力，力争 2030 年前建成逾 5 吉瓦容量。彭博称之为 AI 领域最新的循环交易。

amount_text: Undisclosed; supply-chain estimates put Samsung at ~25-30% of Nvidia's HBM4 volume
title_en: Samsung starts HBM4 shipments to Nvidia
title_zh: 三星开始向英伟达供应 HBM4
summary_en: Samsung was reported to begin official HBM4 shipments to Nvidia (and AMD) in February 2026 after passing qualification, with pricing near what Nvidia agreed with SK hynix.
summary_zh: 据报道，三星通过认证后于 2026 年 2 月开始向英伟达（及 AMD）正式供应 HBM4，价格接近英伟达与 SK 海力士商定的水平。

amount_text: 15% stake; price undisclosed; deal values TikTok US at ~$14B per Axios
title_en: MGX takes 15% of TikTok US joint venture
title_zh: MGX 持有 TikTok 美国合资公司 15% 股权
summary_en: Abu Dhabi's MGX became one of three 15% managing investors, alongside Oracle and Silver Lake, in the TikTok US joint venture carved out of ByteDance, which keeps 19.9%.
summary_zh: 阿布扎比 MGX 与甲骨文、银湖一起，成为从字节跳动分拆出的 TikTok 美国合资公司的三家各持 15% 的管理投资方，字节保留 19.9%。

amount_text: 15% stake; price undisclosed; deal values TikTok US at ~$14B per Axios
title_en: Oracle takes 15% of TikTok US joint venture
title_zh: 甲骨文持有 TikTok 美国合资公司 15% 股权
summary_en: ByteDance's TikTok US business moved into a joint venture closed on 22 January 2026 in which Oracle, Silver Lake and MGX each hold 15% as managing investors and ByteDance keeps 19.9%. Oracle also hosts TikTok US data.
summary_zh: 字节跳动将 TikTok 美国业务转入合资公司，交易于 2026 年 1 月 22 日完成，甲骨文、银湖和 MGX 作为管理投资方各持 15%，字节保留 19.9%。甲骨文同时承担 TikTok 美国数据的托管。

amount_text: $1.8B cash for the P5 site (land, buildings, cleanroom; no tools)
title_en: Micron buys PSMC's Tongluo fab for $1.8B to add DRAM/HBM capacity
title_zh: 美光以 18 亿美元收购力积电铜锣晶圆厂，扩充 DRAM/HBM 产能
summary_en: Micron agreed to buy Powerchip's P5 fab site in Tongluo, Taiwan, with about 300,000 sq ft of 300mm cleanroom, for $1.8B in cash and closed the deal on 15 March 2026; it will retrofit the site for leading-edge DRAM including HBM.
summary_zh: 美光以 18 亿美元现金收购力积电位于台湾铜锣的 P5 厂区（约 30 万平方英尺 12 英寸洁净室），于 2026 年 3 月 15 日完成交割，将改造用于包括 HBM 在内的先进 DRAM。

amount_text: ~$636M total contract revenue over the 10-year initial terms for 50 MW ($311M for the first 25 MW signed Jan 2026 + $325M for a 25 MW expansion option exercised in Q1 2026); three 5-year extensions; AMD holds options for up to 150 MW more
term: 10 years (three 5-year extension options); 25 MW from May 2026, 50 MW by May 2027
title_en: AMD leases 50 MW at Riot's Rockdale site (~$636M)
title_zh: AMD 租用 Riot Rockdale 园区 50 兆瓦（约 6.36 亿美元）
summary_en: AMD signed Riot Platforms' first data-centre lease, for 25 MW of critical IT capacity at Rockdale, Texas (~$311 million over 10 years), and in Q1 2026 exercised an expansion option for another 25 MW, taking the lease to 50 MW and about $636 million. AMD keeps options for up to 150 MW more.
summary_zh: AMD 与 Riot Platforms 签订其首份数据中心租约，租用得州 Rockdale 园区 25 兆瓦关键 IT 容量（10 年约 3.11 亿美元）；2026 年一季度 AMD 行使扩容选择权再增 25 兆瓦，租约增至 50 兆瓦、约 6.36 亿美元，并保留最多再增 150 兆瓦的选择权。

amount_text: >$10B for 750 MW (Jan 2026), roughly doubled to >$20B over 3 years (The Information, Apr 2026; the >$20B total is a press figure, not stated in the Cerebras S-1)
title_en: OpenAI compute deal with Cerebras (>$20B)
title_zh: OpenAI 与 Cerebras 的算力合同（逾 200 亿美元）
summary_en: OpenAI agreed in January 2026 to buy up to 750 MW of Cerebras-hosted inference compute, reported at over $10B; The Information reported in April that the commitment roughly doubled to more than $20B. Cerebras' filings also show OpenAI funded a ~$1B working-capital loan to Cerebras.
summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2026 年 1 月同意采购最多 750 兆瓦由 Cerebras 托管的推理算力，据报道价值逾 100 亿美元；The Information 4 月报道该承诺约翻倍至逾 200 亿美元。Cerebras 文件还显示 OpenAI 向其提供了约 10 亿美元营运资金贷款。

amount_text: Warrant for up to 33,445,026 Cerebras shares at $0.00001; 10,033,508 exercised Jul 2026 (~4.2%)
title_en: OpenAI warrant and stake in Cerebras
title_zh: OpenAI 持有 Cerebras 认股权证及股份
summary_en: Cerebras issued OpenAI a warrant for up to about 33.4 million shares, vesting with the working-capital loan, capacity delivery and market-cap milestones. OpenAI exercised about 10 million vested shares in July 2026, roughly a 4.2% stake.
summary_zh: Cerebras 向 OpenAI 发行最多约 3340 万股认股权证，随营运资金贷款发放、算力交付及市值里程碑归属。OpenAI 于 2026 年 7 月行使约 1000 万股已归属权证，持股约 4.2%。

amount_text: ~$1B per year (Bloomberg; undisclosed by companies); no contract total
title_en: Apple licenses Google Gemini for Siri and Apple Foundation Models
title_zh: 苹果授权使用谷歌 Gemini 打造 Siri 与苹果基础模型
summary_en: Apple and Google announced a multi-year deal under which the next Apple Foundation Models and a more personal Siri will be built on Gemini, running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute. Bloomberg reported Apple will pay about $1B a year.
summary_zh: 苹果与谷歌宣布多年期合作，下一代苹果基础模型及更个性化的 Siri 将基于 Gemini 打造，并运行于苹果私有云计算。据彭博报道，苹果每年将支付约 10 亿美元。

amount_text: Alibaba's amount undisclosed; IPO raised ~HK$4.8B (~$620M) per Reuters (HK$5.54B with the greenshoe per TechNode)
title_en: Alibaba is cornerstone investor in MiniMax Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: 阿里巴巴作为基石投资者认购 MiniMax 港股 IPO
summary_en: Alibaba was a cornerstone investor, with ADIA, Boyu Capital and Mirae Asset, in MiniMax's Hong Kong IPO, which priced at HK$165 and listed on 9 January 2026.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴与阿布扎比投资局、博裕资本、未来资产等作为基石投资者认购 MiniMax 香港 IPO，发行价 165 港元，于 2026 年 1 月 9 日上市。

amount_text: $500M (half of a $1B joint investment with SoftBank); valuation undisclosed
title_en: OpenAI invests $500M in Stargate partner SB Energy
title_zh: OpenAI 向星际之门合作方 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元
summary_en: OpenAI and SoftBank each put $500M into SB Energy, which will build and operate OpenAI's 1.2 GW Stargate site in Milam County, Texas, under a non-exclusive preferred partnership.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与软银各向 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元。SB Energy 将建设并运营 OpenAI 位于得州米拉姆县的 1.2 吉瓦星际之门站点，双方为非独家优先合作关系。

amount_text: HK$4,817.6M gross (~$619M): 29,197,600 Class A shares at HK$165, net ~HK$4,596M; the 4,379,640-share over-allotment was later exercised in full (net ~HK$697M more)
title_en: MiniMax raises HK$4.82B (~$619M) in Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: MiniMax 港股 IPO 募资 48.2 亿港元（约 6.19 亿美元）
summary_en: MiniMax listed in Hong Kong on 9 January 2026, a day after Zhipu, pricing 29.2 million Class A shares at the top of its HK$151-165 range; the retail tranche was over 1,800 times subscribed and the shares closed their first day up 109% at HK$345. Alibaba's cornerstone subscription is a separate edge.
summary_zh: MiniMax 于 2026 年 1 月 9 日（智谱上市次日）在港交所上市，以 151–165 港元区间上限定价发行 2920 万股 A 类股；公开发售超额认购逾 1800 倍，首日收报 345 港元、涨 109%。阿里巴巴的基石认购另有一条边。

amount_text: $500M (half of a $1B joint investment with OpenAI)
title_en: SoftBank puts $500M more into SB Energy for Stargate Texas
title_zh: 软银再向 SB Energy 注资 5 亿美元支持得州星际之门
summary_en: SoftBank matched OpenAI's $500M investment in its SB Energy unit, which is developing the 1.2 GW Stargate data-centre campus in Milam County, Texas, for OpenAI.
summary_zh: 软银与 OpenAI 同额向旗下 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元；SB Energy 正为 OpenAI 开发得州米拉姆县 1.2 吉瓦星际之门数据中心园区。

subkind: initial public offering (Hong Kong H shares)
amount_text: HK$4.35B gross (~$558M): 37,419,500 H shares at HK$116.20; the 5,623,900-share over-allotment was exercised in full on 4 Feb 2026 (a further ~HK$654M), total net proceeds ~HK$4,896M
title_en: Zhipu AI raises HK$4.35B in Hong Kong IPO, the first listed LLM developer
title_zh: 智谱 AI 港股 IPO 募资 43.5 亿港元，成首家上市大模型公司
summary_en: Zhipu (Knowledge Atlas, since renamed Z.ai) listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 8 January 2026 as stock code 2513, selling 37.4 million H shares at HK$116.20; the Hong Kong public tranche was about 1,160 times subscribed and eleven cornerstone investors took just under HK$3B. About 70% of proceeds go to model R&D. Zhipu is on the US Entity List.
summary_zh: 智谱（北京智谱华章，后更名 Z.ai）于 2026 年 1 月 8 日以股票代码 2513 在港交所上市，以每股 116.20 港元发行 3742 万股 H 股；香港公开发售超额认购约 1160 倍，11 家基石投资者认购近 30 亿港元。约七成募资用于模型研发。智谱已被列入美国实体清单。

amount_text: $3.5B capital solution for a ~$5.4B GPU vehicle; part of xAI's Oct 2025 plan for ~$7.5B equity + up to $12.5B GPU-backed debt
title_en: Apollo $3.5B financing for xAI GPU vehicle
title_zh: 阿波罗为 xAI 的 GPU 特殊目的实体提供 35 亿美元融资
summary_en: Apollo funds led $3.5B of financing for Valor Compute Infrastructure, a Valor Equity Partners vehicle with Nvidia as anchor LP, that buys ~$5.4B of Nvidia GB200 systems and leases them to an xAI subsidiary. It is the realised part of the GPU SPV that Bloomberg reported in Oct 2025 (~$7.5B equity, up to $12.5B debt).
summary_zh: 阿波罗旗下基金牵头为 Valor Compute Infrastructure 提供 35 亿美元融资。该特殊目的实体由 Valor Equity Partners 管理、英伟达为基石有限合伙人，购买约 54 亿美元英伟达 GB200 系统并租给 xAI 子公司，是彭博 2025 年 10 月所报 GPU SPV（约 75 亿美元股权、最高 125 亿美元债务）的落地部分。

amount_text: Rent undisclosed; covers ~$5.4B of compute incl. Nvidia GB200
title_en: xAI leases Nvidia GPUs from Valor vehicle
title_zh: xAI 向 Valor 特殊目的实体租用英伟达 GPU
summary_en: An xAI subsidiary leases the GPUs owned by Valor Compute Infrastructure on a triple-net basis for Grok training at its Memphis site; lenders are repaid from the lease, secured by the chips.
summary_zh: xAI 子公司以三重净租赁方式租用 Valor Compute Infrastructure 持有的 GPU，用于孟菲斯基地的 Grok 训练；贷款以芯片为抵押，由租金偿付。

title_en: Broadcom $4.5B bond sale (January 2026)
title_zh: 博通发行 45 亿美元债券（2026 年 1 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $4.5B of senior notes in four tranches due 2031 to 2056 for general corporate purposes, including redeeming earlier notes.
summary_zh: 博通发行四档共 45 亿美元优先票据（2031 至 2056 年到期），用于一般公司用途，包括赎回早期票据。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Bloomberg reported up to $2B; part of xAI's $20B Series E
title_en: Nvidia invests in xAI's $20B Series E
title_zh: 英伟达参与 xAI 200 亿美元 E 轮融资
summary_en: xAI closed a $20B Series E with Nvidia and Cisco as strategic investors; Bloomberg had reported Nvidia would put in up to $2B, with much of the round's debt raised through an SPV that buys Nvidia GPUs to lease to xAI. xAI was merged into SpaceX weeks later.
summary_zh: xAI 完成 200 亿美元 E 轮融资，英伟达和思科为战略投资者；彭博此前报道英伟达出资最多 20 亿美元，该轮大部分债务通过一家购买英伟达 GPU 再租给 xAI 的特殊目的实体筹集。数周后 xAI 并入 SpaceX。

amount_text: $20B upsized Series E (target was $15B); Nvidia's share is a separate edge
title_en: xAI raises $20B Series E
title_zh: xAI 完成 200 亿美元 E 轮融资
summary_en: xAI raised an upsized $20B Series E from Valor, StepStone, Fidelity, QIA, MGX and Baron, with Nvidia and Cisco as strategic investors.
summary_zh: xAI 完成超额认购的 200 亿美元 E 轮融资（目标 150 亿美元），投资方包括 Valor、StepStone、富达、卡塔尔投资局、MGX 和 Baron，英伟达和思科为战略投资者。

amount_text: $1,004,571,259 secured promissory note dated 2026-01-05 (Cerebras S-1): 6% interest, due 2032-12-31, repayable in cash or in compute/hardware (interest waived if repaid in services); carried as 'Loan from customer' of about $983M on Cerebras' balance sheet
title_en: OpenAI ~$1B working-capital loan to Cerebras, secured and paired with warrants
title_zh: OpenAI 向 Cerebras 提供约 10 亿美元营运资金贷款（有担保，附认股权证）
summary_en: Alongside its multi-gigawatt compute purchase, OpenAI advanced Cerebras about $1.0 billion under a secured promissory note (6%, due 31 December 2032) whose proceeds sit in a lockbox to build the contracted capacity; Cerebras may repay in cash or by delivering compute and hardware, and OpenAI separately holds warrants for up to 33.4 million Class N shares (see the investment edge).
summary_zh: 在数吉瓦算力采购协议之外，OpenAI 依据一份有担保本票（年息 6%，2032 年 12 月 31 日到期）向 Cerebras 预付约 10 亿美元，资金存入专户用于建设合同算力；Cerebras 可用现金或交付算力和硬件偿还，OpenAI 另持有最多 3344 万股 N 类普通股认股权证（见投资条目）。

amount_text: $500M at $4.3B valuation; IDG Capital led with $150M; Alibaba and Tencent took part
title_en: Moonshot AI $500M Series C
title_zh: 月之暗面 5 亿美元 C 轮融资
summary_en: Moonshot AI closed a $500M Series C led by IDG Capital, with existing backers Alibaba and Tencent participating, valuing it at $4.3B.
summary_zh: 月之暗面完成 5 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 IDG 资本领投，老股东阿里巴巴和腾讯跟投，估值 43 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; reported above $2B (WSJ), $2-3B per Reuters sources. Closed 29 Dec 2025 per Manus; China ordered the deal unwound on 27 Apr 2026
title_en: Meta acquires AI agent startup Manus
title_zh: Meta 收购 AI 智能体初创公司 Manus
summary_en: Meta agreed on 29 December 2025 to buy Manus, the Singapore-based AI agent startup with Chinese roots, for a reported $2B-plus, and the deal closed the same day. China's Ministry of Commerce opened a review in January 2026, and on 27 April 2026 the NDRC-led foreign-investment security review prohibited the acquisition and ordered the parties to unwind it; Manus said it would operate independently again, while Meta said the transaction complied with applicable law.
summary_zh: Meta 于 2025 年 12 月 29 日同意收购总部位于新加坡、具有中国背景的 AI 智能体初创公司 Manus，据报价格超过 20 亿美元，交易当日完成交割。中国商务部于 2026 年 1 月启动审查，2026 年 4 月 27 日由国家发改委牵头的外商投资安全审查禁止该收购并责令双方解除交易；Manus 表示将恢复独立运营，Meta 则称交易符合适用法律。

amount_text: Undisclosed by the companies; reported at about $20B in cash (CNBC)
title_en: Nvidia licenses Groq's inference technology
title_zh: 英伟达获得 Groq 推理技术授权
summary_en: Groq and Nvidia signed a non-exclusive licence for Groq's inference technology, and Groq's founder and senior leaders joined Nvidia while Groq stays independent; the reported ~$20B would be Nvidia's largest deal.
summary_zh: Groq 与英伟达签署 Groq 推理技术的非独家授权协议，Groq 创始人及高管加入英伟达，Groq 继续独立运营；据报道约 200 亿美元，为英伟达最大一笔交易。

amount_text: $4.75B cash plus assumed debt; Intersect's existing Texas and California operating assets excluded and kept by current investors as a separate company
title_en: Alphabet buys data-centre power developer Intersect for $4.75B
title_zh: Alphabet 以 47.5 亿美元收购数据中心电力开发商 Intersect
summary_en: Alphabet agreed to acquire Intersect, a developer of co-located power and data-centre campuses, for $4.75B in cash plus debt; the deal closed on 10 March 2026.
summary_zh: Alphabet 同意以 47.5 亿美元现金加承担债务收购电源与数据中心一体化园区开发商 Intersect；交易于 2026 年 3 月 10 日完成。

amount_text: $1.3B 7.250% senior secured notes due 2030, issued at par by Flash Compute LLC (Abernathy JV subsidiary); Morgan Stanley representative of initial purchasers
title_en: TeraWulf–Fluidstack JV $1.3B notes for the Abernathy campus
title_zh: TeraWulf–Fluidstack 合资公司发行 13 亿美元票据建设 Abernathy 园区
summary_en: Flash Compute, a subsidiary of the TeraWulf (50.1%) and Fluidstack (49.9%) joint venture, sold $1.3 billion of 7.25% senior secured notes due 2030 to fund part of the 168 MW Abernathy, Texas campus leased to Fluidstack, with Google's lease backstop supporting the credit; the offering closed on 29 December 2025.
summary_zh: TeraWulf（持股 50.1%）与 Fluidstack（49.9%）合资公司旗下 Flash Compute 发行 13 亿美元、票息 7.25%、2030 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设租给 Fluidstack 的得州 Abernathy 168 兆瓦园区，谷歌的租金兜底为其增信，于 2025 年 12 月 29 日完成发行。

amount_text: Undisclosed; covers Fluidstack's lease payments and pass-through obligations for the 15-year base term ($7.0B lease)
title_en: Google backstops Fluidstack's River Bend lease with Hut 8
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 Hut 8 River Bend 的租约提供兜底
summary_en: Google provides a financial backstop covering Fluidstack's lease payments and pass-through obligations to Hut 8 at River Bend for the 15-year base term (Fluidstack is the obligor), which supports Hut 8's project financing.
summary_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 River Bend 园区 15 年基础租期内应付 Hut 8 的租金及转嫁费用提供财务兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），为 Hut 8 的项目融资提供支撑。

amount_text: $7.0B base-term contract value for 245 MW; up to ~$17.7B with three 5-year renewals; ROFO on up to 1,000 MW more
title_en: Fluidstack leases 245 MW at Hut 8's River Bend campus ($7B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 Hut 8 River Bend 园区 245 兆瓦（70 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed a 15-year, $7.0B triple-net lease for 245 MW at Hut 8's River Bend campus in Louisiana, part of a partnership in which Hut 8 develops capacity for Anthropic on clusters operated by Fluidstack; Google backstops the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 Hut 8 签订 15 年、70 亿美元的三净租约，租用其路易斯安那州 River Bend 园区 245 兆瓦；这是 Hut 8 为 Anthropic 开发、由 Fluidstack 运营算力集群的合作的一部分，谷歌为租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: $10B order (Broadcom FQ3 2025) + $11B order (FQ4 2025) for Ironwood TPU racks; not counted here because Anthropic's S-1 shows it takes Broadcom TPU hardware under five-year master equipment leases (from 2025; ~$161.2B of rent in total, counted on anthropic-broadcom-2026-10-equipment-leases)
title_en: Anthropic buys $21B of Google Ironwood TPU racks from Broadcom
title_zh: Anthropic 向博通采购 210 亿美元谷歌 Ironwood TPU 机架
summary_en: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan revealed that Anthropic was the customer behind a $10B order and a further $11B order for complete Google Ironwood TPU racks, and later said Anthropic is on track to be Broadcom's largest custom-chip customer in 2027. Anthropic's S-1 shows it receives this hardware under five-year equipment leases with Broadcom, so the money is counted on the lease edge.
summary_zh: 博通 CEO 陈福阳披露，Anthropic 是一笔 100 亿美元及另一笔 110 亿美元谷歌 Ironwood TPU 整机架订单的买家，并表示 Anthropic 有望在 2027 年成为博通最大的定制芯片客户。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，这些硬件通过与博通的五年期设备租赁取得，因此金额计入租赁关系。

amount_text: $1B equity stake (some reports add warrants for more shares); paired with a 3-year character licence for Sora
title_en: Disney invests $1B in OpenAI and licenses characters to Sora
title_zh: 迪士尼向 OpenAI 投资 10 亿美元并授权角色用于 Sora
summary_en: Disney is taking a $1B equity stake in OpenAI and licensing more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora and ChatGPT Images for three years; Disney also becomes a major OpenAI API customer. At announcement the deal was subject to final agreements and approvals.
summary_zh: 迪士尼将入股 OpenAI 10 亿美元，并把 200 多个迪士尼、漫威、皮克斯和星球大战角色授权给 Sora 和 ChatGPT 图像功能使用三年，同时成为 OpenAI API 的大客户。公布时交易仍需最终协议和批准。

amount_text: $2.25B 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 (upsized from $2B; +$337.5M option)
title_en: CoreWeave $2.25B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 22.5 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $2.25B of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 for general corporate purposes and capped calls.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价扩容后的 22.5 亿美元、票息 1.75%、2031 年到期可转换优先票据，用于一般企业用途及上限看涨期权交易。

amount_text: $2B priced ($1B 0.25% due 2032 + $1B 1.00% due 2033); $2.3B incl. $300M option; ~$544M used to repurchase older converts
title_en: IREN $2.3B convertible notes for Microsoft build-out
title_zh: IREN 发行 23 亿美元可转债支持微软项目
summary_en: IREN sold $2B (+$300M option) of convertible notes to fund data centres and GPUs for its ~$9.7B five-year Microsoft AI cloud contract and to buy back older notes.
summary_zh: IREN 发行 20 亿美元（另含 3 亿美元超额配售）可转换票据，用于其与微软约 97 亿美元五年期 AI 云合同所需的数据中心和 GPU，并回购旧可转债。

amount_text: Undisclosed; fund targets $10B of equity, $5B committed at launch by Brookfield, Nvidia, KIA and others; up to $100B of assets with co-investment and debt
title_en: Nvidia joins Brookfield's $100B AI infrastructure programme
title_zh: 英伟达加入布鲁克菲尔德 1000 亿美元 AI 基础设施计划
summary_en: Nvidia and the Kuwait Investment Authority joined as founding investors in the Brookfield Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Fund, which aims to buy up to $100B of AI assets across energy, land, data centres and compute.
summary_zh: 英伟达与科威特投资局作为创始投资者加入布鲁克菲尔德人工智能基础设施基金，该基金计划收购最高 1000 亿美元覆盖能源、土地、数据中心和算力的 AI 资产。

amount_text: At least $44.9B of Azure spend from November 2026 to May 2033, non-cancelable except for an uncured Microsoft breach or undelivered capacity, per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026, amended agreement); announced as $30B of Azure compute plus additional capacity up to 1 GW in Nov 2025
title_en: Anthropic commits $44.9B to Microsoft Azure ($30B announced)
title_zh: Anthropic 承诺采购 449 亿美元微软 Azure 算力（公告时为 300 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic committed in November 2025 to buy $30B of Azure compute and to contract additional capacity up to 1 GW (Nvidia Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin), as Microsoft and Nvidia agreed to invest in it. Its October 2026 S-1 shows the agreement was amended to a minimum of $44.9B of Azure spending between November 2026 and May 2033, owed regardless of usage.
summary_zh: Anthropic 于 2025 年 11 月承诺采购 300 亿美元 Azure 算力，并另签最多 1 吉瓦的额外算力（英伟达 Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin 系统）；同时微软和英伟达同意向其投资。其 2026 年 10 月的 S-1 显示协议已修订为 2026 年 11 月至 2033 年 5 月间最低 449 亿美元的 Azure 支出，无论实际用量如何均须支付。

amount_text: Up to $5B
title_en: Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic
title_zh: 微软向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元
summary_en: Microsoft committed up to $5B to Anthropic as part of the Azure deal; Anthropic said its February 2026 Series G included a portion of this previously announced investment.
summary_zh: 微软在 Azure 合作中承诺向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元；Anthropic 表示其 2026 年 2 月 G 轮融资包含了该笔已宣布投资的一部分。

amount_text: Up to $10B
title_en: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic
title_zh: 英伟达向 Anthropic 投资最多 100 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia committed up to $10B to Anthropic alongside a new engineering partnership, while Anthropic committed to compute on Nvidia systems. Anthropic said part of it was included in its February 2026 Series G.
summary_zh: 英伟达承诺向 Anthropic 投资最多 100 亿美元并建立工程合作，Anthropic 则承诺使用英伟达系统算力。Anthropic 表示其中部分资金已计入 2026 年 2 月 G 轮融资。

amount_text: $15B in six tranches (longest 2065); ~$80B peak orders
title_en: Amazon $15B bond sale, first US deal in three years
title_zh: 亚马逊发行 150 亿美元债券（三年来首次美元发债）
summary_en: Amazon returned to the US bond market for the first time in about three years with a $15B six-part sale to help fund ~$125B of 2025 capex driven by AI.
summary_zh: 亚马逊约三年来首次重返美元债市场，分六档发行 150 亿美元债券，支持 2025 年约 1250 亿美元、以 AI 为主的资本开支。

amount_text: $2.35B 9.250% senior secured notes due 2030-12-15, issued at 97% by APLD ComputeCo LLC; priced 2025-11-13, closed 2025-11-20; amortisation from 2027-12-15
title_en: Applied Digital $2.35B 9.25% secured notes for CoreWeave-leased Polaris Forge 1 buildings
title_zh: Applied Digital 发行 23.5 亿美元 9.25% 担保票据，用于租给 CoreWeave 的 Polaris Forge 1 数据中心
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo LLC sold $2.35 billion of 9.25% senior secured notes due 2030 to build the 100 MW ELN-02 and 150 MW ELN-03 buildings at the Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, leased to CoreWeave, and to repay an SMBC loan and fund debt-service reserves.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo LLC 发行 23.5 亿美元、票面利率 9.25%、2030 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设北达科他州 Ellendale 的 Polaris Forge 1 园区中租给 CoreWeave 的 100 MW ELN-02 和 150 MW ELN-03 数据中心，并偿还三井住友贷款及设立偿债准备金。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Anthropic's $50B US data-centre programme (Texas, New York first) — the share paid to Fluidstack is not disclosed, so no amount is counted
title_en: Anthropic's $50B US data-centre build with Fluidstack
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Fluidstack 合作的 500 亿美元美国数据中心建设
summary_en: Anthropic announced a $50B investment in its own US data centres, built with Fluidstack, starting in Texas and New York with sites coming online through 2026. The $50B is Anthropic's whole programme; Fluidstack's share is undisclosed and not counted.
summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布投资 500 亿美元自建美国数据中心，由 Fluidstack 承建，首批位于得州和纽约州，2026 年陆续投运。 500 亿美元为 Anthropic 整体计划规模，支付给 Fluidstack 的份额未披露，不计入金额。

amount_text: $2.5B revolving credit facility (upsized from $1.5B; originally $650M in Oct 2024), maturity extended from May 2028 to November 2029; lead banks JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and MUFG, with Citi, Crédit Agricole, Deutsche Bank, SMBC and Wells Fargo
title_en: CoreWeave $2.5B revolving credit facility
title_zh: CoreWeave 25 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: CoreWeave amended its revolving credit facility on 12 November 2025, raising it from $1.5 billion to $2.5 billion and extending maturity to November 2029; JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and MUFG led the nine-bank group. The facility backs general corporate liquidity rather than a specific GPU purchase.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年 11 月 12 日修订其循环信贷额度，由 15 亿美元上调至 25 亿美元，到期日延长至 2029 年 11 月；由摩根大通、高盛、摩根士丹利和三菱日联牵头的九家银行参与。该额度用于一般公司流动性，而非特定的 GPU 采购。

amount_text: ~$3B over 5 years
title_en: Meta ~$3B AI infrastructure contract with Nebius
title_zh: Meta 与 Nebius 约 30 亿美元的 AI 基础设施合同
summary_en: Nebius disclosed a five-year agreement worth about $3B to supply AI infrastructure to Meta.
summary_zh: Nebius 披露与 Meta 签署为期五年、价值约 30 亿美元的 AI 基础设施供应协议。

amount_text: ~$18B from ~20 banks; agents SMBC, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, MUFG; ~SOFR+250bp, 4 years + two 1-year extensions; quoted at 89–91 cents in Sept 2026
title_en: $18B bank loan for Oracle-linked Project Jupiter, New Mexico
title_zh: 180 亿美元银团贷款支持甲骨文相关的新墨西哥州 Jupiter 项目
summary_en: About 20 banks led by SMBC, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs and MUFG lent ~$18B to build the Stargate-linked Project Jupiter campus in Doña Ana County that Oracle will lease, developed by Blue Owl's Stack Infrastructure. By Sept 2026 the loans traded at 89–91 cents after gas-pipeline delays, and Oracle sent a force-majeure notice to defer payments if the 2028 opening slips, while saying the project is on schedule.
summary_zh: 约 20 家银行（三井住友、法国巴黎银行、高盛、三菱日联为代理行）提供约 180 亿美元贷款，建设由 Blue Owl 旗下 STACK Infrastructure 开发、甲骨文承租的星际之门相关新墨西哥 Jupiter 园区。因天然气管道延误，2026 年 9 月贷款报价跌至 89–91 美分；甲骨文发出不可抗力通知，若 2028 年无法投运可推迟付款，但称项目仍按计划推进。

amount_text: ~$265M in cash, subject to purchase price adjustments; agreed October 2025 (day not given), disclosed 2025-11-05
title_en: Arm buys AI networking chipmaker DreamBig for $265M
title_zh: Arm 以 2.65 亿美元收购 AI 网络芯片商 DreamBig
summary_en: Arm agreed in October 2025 to buy 100% of DreamBig Semiconductor, maker of AI networking chiplets and SuperNICs, for about $265M in cash, disclosed with its November 2025 results; the deal closed on 1 July 2026.
summary_zh: Arm 于 2025 年 10 月同意以约 2.65 亿美元现金收购 AI 网络小芯片和超级网卡厂商 DreamBig 的全部股权，并在 2025 年 11 月财报中披露；交易于 2026 年 7 月 1 日完成。

amount_text: $1.4B 7.125% senior secured notes due 2030 (Cipher Compute LLC); a further $333M add-on was planned in Nov 2025
title_en: Cipher $1.4B secured notes for Barber Lake AI campus
title_zh: Cipher 发行 14 亿美元优先担保票据建设 Barber Lake AI 园区
summary_en: Cipher Mining's subsidiary sold $1.4B of 7.125% secured notes to fund the Barber Lake data centre leased to Fluidstack and backstopped by Google.
summary_zh: Cipher Mining 子公司发行 14 亿美元、票息 7.125% 的优先担保票据，为租给 Fluidstack、由谷歌兜底的 Barber Lake 数据中心融资。

amount_text: ~$5.5B over 15 years for 300 MW; rent starts August 2026
term: 15 years; capacity delivered in two phases, July to Q4 2026
title_en: AWS signs $5.5B, 15-year lease with Cipher Mining
title_zh: AWS 与 Cipher Mining 签订 55 亿美元 15 年租约
summary_en: Amazon Web Services agreed to lease 300 MW of air- and liquid-cooled data-centre capacity from bitcoin miner Cipher Mining for about $5.5B over 15 years, with delivery during 2026.
summary_zh: AWS 同意以约 55 亿美元、为期 15 年的条件，向比特币矿企 Cipher Mining 租用 300 兆瓦风冷和液冷数据中心容量，2026 年内交付。

title_en: Alphabet ~$25B US and euro bond sales
title_zh: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 在美欧发行约 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Alphabet raised about $25B in a week: $17.5B of US bonds after €6.5B in Europe, to fund AI data-centre capex.
summary_zh: Alphabet 一周内筹资约 250 亿美元：继在欧洲发行 65 亿欧元债券后，又在美国发行 175 亿美元债券，用于 AI 数据中心资本开支。

amount_text: ~$9.7B over 5 years incl. 20% prepayment
term: 5 years; phased deployment through 2026 at Childress, Texas
title_en: Microsoft $9.7B AI cloud contract with IREN
title_zh: 微软与 IREN 的 97 亿美元 AI 云合同
summary_en: IREN will give Microsoft access to Nvidia GB300 GPUs for five years at its Childress, Texas campus for about $9.7B, with a 20% prepayment; IREN is buying the chips from Dell for about $5.8B.
summary_zh: IREN 将在其得州 Childress 园区向微软提供为期五年的英伟达 GB300 GPU 算力，合同约 97 亿美元，含 20% 预付款；IREN 以约 58 亿美元向戴尔采购相关芯片和设备。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'multibillion-dollar', tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs incl. GB300 NVL72
title_en: Microsoft multibillion-dollar GPU deal with Lambda
title_zh: 微软与 Lambda 的数十亿美元 GPU 协议
summary_en: Lambda signed a multi-year, multibillion-dollar agreement to deploy tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, including GB300 NVL72 systems, for Microsoft.
summary_zh: Lambda 与微软签署多年期、数十亿美元协议，为其部署数万颗英伟达 GPU，包括 GB300 NVL72 系统。

amount_text: $38B over 7 years
title_en: OpenAI $38B AWS cloud contract
title_zh: OpenAI 与 AWS 的 380 亿美元云合同
summary_en: OpenAI signed a multi-year $38B agreement for AWS EC2 UltraServers with hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, its first big cloud deal outside Microsoft. It was extended by $100B in February 2026.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 AWS 签订为期多年、价值 380 亿美元的协议，使用搭载数十万颗英伟达 GPU 的 EC2 UltraServers，这是其在微软之外的首个大型云合同；2026 年 2 月该协议再扩大 1000 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs
title_en: Samsung builds an AI Megafactory on 50,000+ Nvidia GPUs
title_zh: 三星以 5 万余颗英伟达 GPU 打造 AI 超级工厂
summary_en: Samsung said it will deploy more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs and the Omniverse platform in an AI Megafactory that runs its chip, mobile and robotics manufacturing; the two also work together on HBM4.
summary_zh: 三星宣布将部署 5 万余颗英伟达 GPU 及 Omniverse 平台，建设覆盖其芯片、手机和机器人制造的 AI 超级工厂；双方还在 HBM4 方面合作。

amount_text: $30B in six tranches; record ~$125B order book
title_en: Meta $30B bond sale
title_zh: Meta 发行 300 亿美元债券
summary_en: Meta sold $30B of bonds, the biggest US high-grade deal of 2025, drawing a record ~$125B of orders on the day its shares fell after it signalled much higher AI capex.
summary_zh: Meta 发行 300 亿美元债券，为 2025 年美国最大的投资级发债，认购订单创纪录达约 1250 亿美元；当天其股价因释放更高 AI 资本开支信号而下跌。

amount_text: $1.025B 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032-05-01 ($900M priced 2025-10-29 plus $125M option exercised in full); 37.5% conversion premium; net proceeds ~$999.7M; closed 2025-10-31
title_en: TeraWulf $1.025B zero-coupon convertible notes for the Abernathy, Texas campus
title_zh: TeraWulf 发行 10.25 亿美元零息可转换票据，用于得州 Abernathy 园区
summary_en: TeraWulf sold $1.025 billion of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 in a private 144A offering led by Morgan Stanley and Cantor Fitzgerald, upsized from $900 million, to fund part of the construction of its Abernathy, Texas data-centre campus and for general corporate purposes.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 通过由摩根士丹利和 Cantor Fitzgerald 牵头的 144A 私募发行 10.25 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换优先票据（由 9 亿美元上调），用于其得州 Abernathy 数据中心园区的部分建设及一般公司用途。

amount_text: Google backs ~$1.3B of Fluidstack's long-term lease obligations at the Abernathy JV campus; no TeraWulf warrants issued
title_en: Google backstops $1.3B of Fluidstack's Abernathy lease
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 的 Abernathy 租约提供 13 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google agreed to back about $1.3 billion of Fluidstack's lease payments (Fluidstack is the obligor) to the TeraWulf–Fluidstack joint venture's Abernathy, Texas campus, to support the project's debt financing; unlike the Lake Mariner backstop, no TeraWulf warrants were issued.
summary_zh: 谷歌同意为 Fluidstack 向 TeraWulf–Fluidstack 合资公司得州 Abernathy 园区支付的约 13 亿美元租金提供兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），以支持项目债务融资；与 Lake Mariner 兜底不同，此次 TeraWulf 未发行认股权证。

amount_text: ~$9.5B contracted revenue to the joint venture over a 25-year term for 168 MW critical IT (240 MW gross); term may be shortened to 20 or 15 years
title_en: Fluidstack leases TeraWulf's 168 MW Abernathy JV campus (~$9.5B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 TeraWulf 合资的 Abernathy 168 兆瓦园区（约 95 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf and Fluidstack formed a joint venture (TeraWulf 50.1%) to build a 168 MW AI campus in Abernathy, Texas, fully leased to Fluidstack for 25 years for about $9.5 billion, serving a frontier AI model developer; Google backs $1.3 billion of the lease (separate edge). In July 2026 TeraWulf agreed to sell its whole JV stake to Fluidstack and other buyers for about $530 million.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 与 Fluidstack 成立合资公司（TeraWulf 持股 50.1%），在得州 Abernathy 建设 168 兆瓦 AI 园区，由 Fluidstack 整体租用 25 年，合同收入约 95 亿美元，服务一家前沿大模型开发商；谷歌为其中 13 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列）。2026 年 7 月 TeraWulf 同意以约 5.3 亿美元将所持合资股权全部出售给 Fluidstack 等买方。

amount_text: Incremental $250B of Azure services
title_en: OpenAI commits an extra $250B to Microsoft Azure
title_zh: OpenAI 追加 2500 亿美元微软 Azure 采购承诺
summary_en: In the October 2025 recapitalisation OpenAI agreed to buy an additional $250B of Azure, and Microsoft gave up its right of first refusal on OpenAI compute. An April 2026 amendment ended Azure exclusivity: OpenAI can sell on any cloud, Azure stays primary, and OpenAI's ~20% revenue share to Microsoft is capped and runs through 2030.
summary_zh: 在 2025 年 10 月的资本重组中，OpenAI 同意追加采购 2500 亿美元 Azure 服务，微软放弃对 OpenAI 算力的优先购买权。2026 年 4 月的修订终止了 Azure 独家：OpenAI 可在任意云上销售，Azure 仍为首选；OpenAI 向微软支付的约 20% 收入分成设上限并持续至 2030 年。

amount_text: $38B: $23.25B (Shackelford County, Texas) + $14.75B (Port Washington, Wisconsin); ~SOFR+250bp, 4 years + two 1-year extensions
title_en: $38B bank loans for Oracle-leased Vantage data centres
title_zh: 380 亿美元银行贷款支持甲骨文租用的 Vantage 数据中心
summary_en: JPMorgan and MUFG led a record $38B pair of construction loans for two Vantage Data Centers campuses in Texas and Wisconsin that Oracle leases to serve OpenAI under Stargate. More than six months later banks were still selling down the last <$1B, some at a discount to non-bank buyers.
summary_zh: 摩根大通与三菱日联牵头，为 Vantage 在得州和威斯康星州的两个数据中心园区提供创纪录的 380 亿美元建设贷款，园区由甲骨文承租、用于星际之门项目下的 OpenAI 算力。半年多后银行仍在分销最后不足 10 亿美元的份额，部分以折价卖给非银行买家。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 'tens of billions of dollars'; up to 1M TPUs, well over 1 GW in 2026
title_en: Anthropic expands Google Cloud TPU use to up to 1M chips
title_zh: Anthropic 将谷歌云 TPU 用量扩大至最多 100 万颗
summary_en: Anthropic agreed to use up to one million Google Cloud TPUs, an expansion worth tens of billions of dollars that brings well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026.
summary_zh: Anthropic 同意使用最多 100 万颗谷歌云 TPU，扩容价值数百亿美元，将于 2026 年上线超过 1 吉瓦算力。

amount_text: ~$5B total contracted revenue over ~15 years for 200 MW; right of first refusal on a further 800 MW
title_en: Oracle leases 200 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 2 (~$5B)
title_zh: 甲骨文租用 Applied Digital Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 兆瓦（约 50 亿美元）
summary_en: Applied Digital signed a ~15-year, ~$5B lease for 200 MW at its Polaris Forge 2 campus in Harwood, North Dakota, with a then-unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler; its March 2026 8-K says the campus is leased to Oracle. The tenant holds a right of first refusal on another 800 MW.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 与一家当时未具名的投资级超大规模云厂商签订约 15 年、约 50 亿美元租约，出租北达科他州哈伍德 Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 兆瓦；其 2026 年 3 月 8-K 文件披露该园区租户为甲骨文。租户对另外 800 兆瓦拥有优先承租权。

amount_text: ~$7B cash contributed by Blue Owl funds for 80% of the JV (Meta keeps 20% and received a ~$3B one-time distribution); total development cost ~$27B
term: JV owns the Hyperion campus; Meta leases it on 4-year initial terms with extensions
title_en: Blue Owl funds take an 80% stake in Meta's Hyperion data-centre JV
title_zh: Blue Owl 基金入股 Meta Hyperion 数据中心合资公司 80%
summary_en: Blue Owl-managed funds hold 80% of the joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana, having put in about $7B of cash; Meta kept 20% and took a one-time distribution of about $3B. The JV's bonds and Meta's lease are separate edges.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 管理的基金持有 Meta 路易斯安那州 Hyperion 园区合资公司 80% 股权，出资约 70 亿美元现金；Meta 保留 20% 并获得约 30 亿美元一次性分配。该合资公司的债券和 Meta 的租约另列。

amount_text: Rent undisclosed; ~$27B campus development cost; Meta can exit at 4-year intervals
title_en: Meta leases Hyperion campus from Blue Owl JV
title_zh: Meta 向 Blue Owl 合资公司租用 Hyperion 园区
summary_en: Meta leases the Hyperion campus back from the Beignet joint venture; its rent services the $27.3B of bonds. Short renewable terms keep the obligation off Meta's balance sheet.
summary_zh: Meta 从 Beignet 合资公司回租 Hyperion 园区，其租金用于偿付 273 亿美元债券；较短的可续租期使该义务不计入 Meta 资产负债表。

amount_text: Undisclosed; covers the first 16 years of operations
title_en: Meta residual value guarantee to Hyperion JV
title_zh: Meta 向 Hyperion 合资公司提供余值担保
summary_en: Meta gave the Hyperion joint venture a residual value guarantee: if Meta stops leasing and the campus is worth less than what bondholders and Blue Owl are owed, Meta pays the difference. S&P warned that substantial credit risk could pass back to Meta.
summary_zh: Meta 向 Hyperion 合资公司提供余值担保：若 Meta 不再续租且园区价值低于欠债券持有人和 Blue Owl 的金额，由 Meta 补足差额。标普警告称，大量信用风险可能回流至 Meta。

amount_text: $27.3B 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049 (A+ by S&P), one tranche, sole lead Morgan Stanley; PIMCO ~$18B anchor (reported) and BlackRock funds >$3B; the PIMCO allocation (pimco-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes) carries no amount of its own
title_en: Meta Hyperion SPV (Beignet Investor) $27.3B senior secured notes
title_zh: Meta Hyperion 特殊目的实体（Beignet Investor）发行 273 亿美元优先担保票据
summary_en: Beignet Investor, the Blue Owl (80%) / Meta (20%) joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana, sold $27.3B of 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049, the largest single-tranche bond on record (sole lead Morgan Stanley). PIMCO was the anchor buyer with about $18B and BlackRock funds took more than $3B; the debt sits off Meta's balance sheet and the notes traded around 91 cents on the dollar in early October 2026.
summary_zh: Beignet Investor 是 Blue Owl（80%）与 Meta（20%）的合资公司，持有 Meta 位于路易斯安那州的 Hyperion 园区，发行 273 亿美元、票息 6.58%、2049 年到期的优先担保票据，为史上最大单一档债券（摩根士丹利独家牵头）。PIMCO（品浩）为主力认购方，买入约 180 亿美元，贝莱德旗下基金认购逾 30 亿美元；债务不计入 Meta 资产负债表，2026 年 10 月初该债券跌至约 91 美分。

amount_text: $3.2B 7.750% senior secured notes due 2030, issued by WULF Compute LLC; Morgan Stanley initial purchaser
title_en: TeraWulf $3.2B secured notes for Lake Mariner AI campus
title_zh: TeraWulf 发行 32 亿美元优先担保票据建设 Lake Mariner AI 园区
summary_en: TeraWulf's subsidiary sold $3.2B of 7.75% secured notes to build Fluidstack's data halls at Lake Mariner, New York; Google's pledged warrants form part of the collateral until completion.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 子公司发行 32 亿美元、票息 7.75% 的优先担保票据，为 Fluidstack 建设纽约 Lake Mariner 数据机房；完工前谷歌质押的认股权证构成部分抵押品。

amount_text: ~$18B anchor allocation (reported) of the $27.3B 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049; part of bond-investors-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes, where the whole bond is counted, so no amount is counted here
title_en: PIMCO buys ~$18B of Meta Hyperion SPV bonds
title_zh: PIMCO 认购约 180 亿美元 Meta Hyperion SPV 债券
summary_en: PIMCO was the anchor buyer, taking about $18B of the $27.3B single-tranche bond issued by Beignet Investor, the Blue Owl (80%) / Meta (20%) joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana. This is a holder allocation within one bond, counted on bond-investors-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes, not a separate instrument.
summary_zh: PIMCO（品浩）为主力认购方，买入 Beignet Investor 发行的 273 亿美元单一档债券中约 180 亿美元。Beignet 是 Blue Owl（80%）与 Meta（20%）的合资公司，持有 Meta 位于路易斯安那州的 Hyperion 园区。这是同一只债券中的持有人份额，金额已计入 Beignet Investor 273 亿美元票据这条边，并非单独的融资工具。

from_name: AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock, GIP, MGX, Microsoft, NVIDIA)
amount_text: ~$40B enterprise value; closed 21 Jul 2026, plus a further $5B growth-capital commitment by the consortium
title_en: BlackRock-led AI Infrastructure Partnership to buy Aligned Data Centers (~$40B)
title_zh: 贝莱德牵头的 AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP）以约 400 亿美元收购 Aligned 数据中心
summary_en: The AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock/GIP and MGX, with Microsoft and NVIDIA) agreed in October 2025 to buy Aligned Data Centers from Macquarie Asset Management for about $40B, its first deal. The acquisition of 100% of Aligned's equity closed on 21 July 2026, and the consortium committed a further $5B of growth capital for Aligned's expansion (51 campuses, over 6.4 GW operational and planned).
summary_zh: AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP，贝莱德/GIP 与 MGX，微软和英伟达参与）于 2025 年 10 月同意以约 400 亿美元从麦格理资产管理收购 Aligned 数据中心，为其首笔交易。收购 Aligned 全部股权于 2026 年 7 月 21 日完成，财团另承诺 50 亿美元增长资本用于 Aligned 扩张（51 个园区，运营及规划容量逾 6.4 吉瓦）。

amount_text: Undisclosed; ~200,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs; FT estimated up to ~$14B (other reports ~$24B)
term: Texas from Q3 2026, Portugal Q1 2026, UK Q1 2027, Norway via Aker JV
title_en: Microsoft contracts ~200,000 GB300 GPUs from Nscale
title_zh: 微软向 Nscale 采购约 20 万颗 GB300 GPU 算力
summary_en: Nscale contracted to deliver about 200,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs to Microsoft across Texas, Portugal, the UK and Norway. The value was not disclosed; the FT estimated up to about $14B. In October 2026 Microsoft pulled out of the UK site at Loughton, Essex (grid power not expected until the 2030s); Microsoft said the rest of the partnership stands.
summary_zh: Nscale 签约在得州、葡萄牙、英国和挪威向微软交付约 20 万颗英伟达 GB300 GPU 算力。金额未披露，英国《金融时报》估计最高约 140 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs from Q3 2026, expanding in 2027+
title_en: Oracle deploys 50,000 AMD MI450 GPUs
title_zh: 甲骨文部署 5 万颗 AMD MI450 GPU
summary_en: Oracle Cloud will be a launch partner for the first public AI supercluster on AMD Instinct MI450, starting with 50,000 GPUs in Q3 2026 and expanding from 2027.
summary_zh: 甲骨文云将成为首个基于 AMD Instinct MI450 的公共 AI 超级集群的首发伙伴，2026 年第三季度先部署 5 万颗 GPU，2027 年起扩容。

amount_text: Up to $5B to deploy Bloom fuel cells at Brookfield AI factories (first phase); first deal of Brookfield's AI Infrastructure strategy
title_en: Brookfield's $5B Bloom Energy fuel-cell deal for AI data centres
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德与 Bloom Energy 签订 50 亿美元 AI 数据中心燃料电池协议
summary_en: Brookfield agreed to invest up to $5B deploying Bloom Energy's fuel cells as behind-the-meter power for its AI data centres, making Bloom its preferred on-site power supplier.
summary_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德同意投资最高 50 亿美元，在其 AI 数据中心部署 Bloom Energy 燃料电池作为表后电源，Bloom 成为其首选现场电力供应商。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators and Broadcom Ethernet racks
term: Racks from H2 2026, complete by end-2029
title_en: OpenAI and Broadcom 10 GW custom accelerator deal
title_zh: OpenAI 与博通的 10 吉瓦定制加速器协议
summary_en: OpenAI will design its own AI accelerators and Broadcom will develop and deploy 10 GW of racks with them plus Broadcom networking, from the second half of 2026 to the end of 2029. Financial terms were not disclosed.
summary_zh: OpenAI 自主设计 AI 加速器，由博通开发并部署搭载该芯片及博通网络设备的 10 吉瓦机架，时间为 2026 年下半年至 2029 年底，财务条款未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; AMD expects 'tens of billions of dollars' of revenue; 6 GW over several GPU generations
term: Multi-year; first 1 GW of MI450 from H2 2026
title_en: OpenAI 6 GW AMD Instinct GPU agreement
title_zh: OpenAI 与 AMD 的 6 吉瓦 Instinct GPU 协议
summary_en: OpenAI agreed to deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs across multiple generations, starting with 1 GW of MI450 in the second half of 2026. AMD said the deal should bring tens of billions of dollars in revenue.
summary_zh: OpenAI 同意跨多代产品部署 6 吉瓦 AMD Instinct GPU，首批 1 吉瓦 MI450 于 2026 年下半年开始部署。AMD 表示该协议预计带来数百亿美元收入。

amount_text: Warrant for up to 160M AMD shares (~10%) at $0.01, vesting with GW deployed and AMD share-price milestones
term: Vests in tranches from first 1 GW to 6 GW
title_en: AMD grants OpenAI warrant for up to 160M shares
title_zh: AMD 向 OpenAI 授予最多 1.6 亿股认股权证
