summary_en: As part of the GPU deal AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares at one cent each, vesting as deployments scale to 6 GW and as AMD's share price hits targets. It is a circular structure: the buyer can end up owning about a tenth of its supplier.
summary_zh: 作为 GPU 协议的一部分，AMD 向 OpenAI 发行可按每股 0.01 美元认购最多 1.6 亿股的认股权证，随部署规模扩大至 6 吉瓦及 AMD 股价达标分批归属。这是典型的循环结构：买方最终可能持有供应商约一成股份。

amount_text: Undisclosed by the parties; the Wall Street Journal reported on 5 Oct 2025 that xAI would spend at least $18B on ~300,000 more Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2, excluding servers; neither xAI nor Nvidia has confirmed a total, so the figure is not counted
title_en: xAI to buy ~300,000 more Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2 (reported, at least $18B)
title_zh: xAI 据报将为 Colossus 2 再采购约 30 万颗英伟达 GPU（据报不少于 180 亿美元）
summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that xAI needed to spend at least $18B to buy the remaining ~300,000 Nvidia GPUs for its Colossus 2 data centre in Memphis, with Musk saying the site would reach 550,000 chips. No party has confirmed the figure, so it is listed as reported with no amount.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，xAI 需至少支出 180 亿美元为孟菲斯 Colossus 2 数据中心采购其余约 30 万颗英伟达 GPU，马斯克称该站点将达到 55 万颗芯片。各方均未确认该数字，因此标为据报且金额为空。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Stargate demand of up to 900,000 DRAM wafers/month
title_en: OpenAI memory-supply letter of intent with Samsung
title_zh: OpenAI 与三星的存储芯片供应意向书
summary_en: OpenAI signed a letter of intent in Seoul for Samsung to supply memory for Stargate, which OpenAI and its Korean partners said could need up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month. No value was disclosed.
summary_zh: OpenAI 在首尔与三星签署意向书，由三星为星际之门供应存储芯片；双方称星际之门需求可能高达每月 90 万片 DRAM 晶圆，金额未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Stargate demand of up to 900,000 DRAM wafers/month
title_en: OpenAI memory-supply letter of intent with SK hynix
title_zh: OpenAI 与 SK 海力士的存储芯片供应意向书
summary_en: OpenAI signed a parallel letter of intent with SK hynix for high-bandwidth memory for Stargate; SK said the stated demand is more than double current global HBM capacity.
summary_zh: OpenAI 同时与 SK 海力士签署意向书，为星际之门供应高带宽存储（HBM）；SK 称该需求是当前全球 HBM 产能的两倍以上。

amount_text: Up to $14.2B through 2031, option to expand to 2032
title_en: Meta $14.2B cloud contract with CoreWeave
title_zh: Meta 与 CoreWeave 的 142 亿美元云合同
summary_en: CoreWeave disclosed in a filing that Meta will buy up to $14.2B of Nvidia GB300-based compute through 2031, diversifying CoreWeave beyond Microsoft.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 在监管文件中披露，Meta 将在 2031 年前采购最多 142 亿美元基于英伟达 GB300 的算力，帮助 CoreWeave 降低对微软的依赖。

amount_text: CNY 3.985B (~$560M at ~7.11 CNY/USD) at CNY 1,195.02/share to 13 investors incl. GF Fund (CNY 1.208B), UBS AG, New China Asset
title_en: Cambricon CNY 3.99B private placement for large-model chips
title_zh: 寒武纪 39.85 亿元人民币定增投向大模型芯片
summary_en: Cambricon raised CNY 3.985B from 13 institutional investors to fund a chip platform and a software platform for large AI models, plus working capital. The new shares were registered on 16 October 2025.
summary_zh: 寒武纪向 13 家机构定增募资 39.85 亿元人民币，用于面向大模型的芯片平台和软件平台项目及补充流动资金；新增股份于 2025 年 10 月 16 日完成登记。

amount_text: $1.73B total: $1.4B (Sept 2025) + $333M (Nov 2025); Google receives warrants for ~5.4% of Cipher
title_en: Google backstops $1.73B of Fluidstack leases at Cipher
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 Cipher 的租约提供 17.3 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google backstopped Fluidstack's lease payments to Cipher Mining's Barber Lake, Texas site (Fluidstack is the obligor), first $1.4B and then a further $333M when the lease grew to the full 300 MW site, supporting Cipher's project bonds.
summary_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 向 Cipher Mining 得州 Barber Lake 园区支付的租金提供兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），先为 14 亿美元，租约扩至整个 300 兆瓦园区后再增加 3.33 亿美元，以支持 Cipher 的项目债券。

amount_text: ~$3.8B contracted revenue over initial 10-year terms: ~$3B for 168 MW (Sept 2025) + ~$830M for 56 MW (Nov 2025); ~$9B with two 5-year extensions
title_en: Fluidstack leases 224 MW at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$3.8B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 Cipher Barber Lake 园区 224 兆瓦（约 38 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed a 10-year, 168 MW AI hosting lease at Cipher Mining's Barber Lake site in Texas (~$3B) and added 56 MW in November 2025 (~$830M), ~$3.8B in all over the initial term. Google backstops $1.73B of the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 Cipher Mining 签订得州 Barber Lake 园区 168 兆瓦、为期 10 年的 AI 托管租约（约 30 亿美元），2025 年 11 月再追加 56 兆瓦（约 8.3 亿美元），初始期限合同收入合计约 38 亿美元；谷歌为其中 17.3 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: $18B in six tranches incl. a 40-year note; ~$88B peak orders
title_en: Oracle $18B bond sale for AI infrastructure
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 180 亿美元债券为 AI 基础设施融资
summary_en: Oracle sold $18B of investment-grade bonds in six parts, including a rare 40-year note, to fund AI data-centre spending tied largely to its OpenAI contracts. It was the second-largest US high-grade bond sale of 2025 at the time.
summary_zh: 甲骨文分六档发行 180 亿美元投资级债券（含罕见的 40 年期品种），资金用于主要与 OpenAI 合同相关的 AI 数据中心资本开支，规模一度为 2025 年美国第二大投资级发债。

amount_text: Up to $100B, tied to each GW of 10 GW deployed; a maximum that was never committed (cancelled, so not in totals)
term: Staged as each gigawatt deploys, first phase H2 2026
title_en: Nvidia letter of intent to invest up to $100B in OpenAI (superseded)
title_zh: 英伟达拟向 OpenAI 投资最多 1000 亿美元的意向书（已被取代）
summary_en: Nvidia and OpenAI signed a letter of intent for at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems, with Nvidia investing up to $100B as capacity came online. Nvidia's CFO said in December 2025 it had not gone past the LOI stage, and in February 2026 it was replaced by a $30B equity investment with no deployment milestones.
summary_zh: 英伟达与 OpenAI 签署意向书，计划部署至少 10 吉瓦英伟达系统，英伟达随算力上线分阶段投资最多 1000 亿美元。英伟达首席财务官 2025 年 12 月表示该协议仍停留在意向书阶段；2026 年 2 月被一笔不附带部署里程碑的 300 亿美元股权投资取代。

amount_text: ~$20B reported (Bloomberg/Reuters, Sep 2025 talks); neither company has confirmed a contract or amount. Oracle cited new Meta commitments in Dec 2025 RPO without figures
title_en: Meta ~$20B cloud contract with Oracle
title_zh: Meta 与甲骨文约 200 亿美元的云合同
summary_en: Bloomberg and Reuters reported in September 2025 that Oracle was negotiating a roughly $20B multi-year AI cloud deal with Meta. In December 2025 Oracle said its $68B quarterly backlog increase was driven by new commitments from Meta, Nvidia and others, without giving amounts.
summary_zh: 彭博和路透社 2025 年 9 月报道，甲骨文正与 Meta 洽谈约 200 亿美元的多年期 AI 云合同。2025 年 12 月甲骨文表示当季剩余履约义务（RPO）增加 680 亿美元，主要来自 Meta、英伟达等的新承诺，但未披露金额。

title_en: Nvidia invests $5B in Intel
title_zh: 英伟达向英特尔投资 50 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia agreed to buy $5B of Intel stock at $23.28 a share as the two co-develop custom data-centre CPUs and RTX-equipped PC chips; the purchase closed in late December 2025 after US antitrust clearance.
summary_zh: 英伟达同意以每股 23.28 美元买入 50 亿美元英特尔股票，双方共同开发定制数据中心 CPU 及集成 RTX 的 PC 芯片；该交易在获美国反垄断批准后于 2025 年 12 月底完成。

amount_text: $750M at a $6.9B post-money valuation, led by Disruptive with BlackRock, Neuberger Berman, DTCP; Samsung, Cisco and others participated
title_en: Groq raises $750M at $6.9B valuation
title_zh: Groq 融资 7.5 亿美元，估值 69 亿美元
summary_en: AI inference-chip maker Groq raised $750M at a $6.9B post-money valuation, led by Disruptive, to expand its data-centre capacity, three months before Nvidia's licensing and acqui-hire deal.
summary_zh: AI 推理芯片公司 Groq 完成由 Disruptive 领投的 7.5 亿美元融资，投后估值 69 亿美元，用于扩充数据中心容量；三个月后英伟达与其达成技术授权和人才收购协议。

amount_text: CNY 9B (~$1.27B): CNY 2B 2.1% 5-year, CNY 6B 2.5% 10-year, CNY 1B 3.1% 30-year (tenors per Reuters)
title_en: Tencent CNY 9B debut dim sum bonds
title_zh: 腾讯首发 90 亿元离岸人民币债券
summary_en: Tencent raised CNY 9B (about $1.27B) in its first offshore yuan bond and first bond sale in four years, for general corporate needs.
summary_zh: 腾讯发行 90 亿元人民币（约 12.7 亿美元）离岸人民币债券，为其首笔点心债，也是四年来首次发债，用于一般公司用途。

amount_text: ~$3.2B zero-coupon convertible notes due 2032
title_en: Alibaba $3.2B convertible to fund cloud and AI
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 32 亿美元可转债投向云与 AI
summary_en: Alibaba issued about $3.2B of zero-coupon convertible notes due 2032, with proceeds for general corporate purposes with a focus on strengthening cloud infrastructure and its international commerce business.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行约 32 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换票据，所得款项用于一般公司用途，重点加强云基础设施和国际电商业务。

amount_text: ~$3.16B: ~$1.58B 1.00% due 2030 + ~$1.58B 2.75% due 2032, incl. the initial purchasers' option exercised at closing (priced at $2.75B, upsized from $2B); closed 15 Sept 2025 with a concurrent ~$1B share sale
title_en: Nebius $3.16B convertible notes after Microsoft deal
title_zh: Nebius 在微软合同后发行 31.6 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Shortly after announcing a multi-billion-dollar capacity contract with Microsoft, Nebius sold convertible notes plus about $1B of stock to fund data-centre build-out; with the buyers' option exercised, the notes came to about $3.16B at closing on 15 September 2025.
summary_zh: 在宣布与微软签署数十亿美元算力合同后不久，Nebius 发行可转换票据并增发约 10 亿美元股票，用于数据中心建设；初始购买方行使超额认购权后，票据于 2025 年 9 月 15 日交割时合计约 31.6 亿美元。

amount_text: ~$300B over ~5 years (WSJ; Oracle and OpenAI have not confirmed the figure); ~4.5 GW of Stargate capacity
title_en: OpenAI cloud compute contract with Oracle (Stargate 4.5 GW)
title_zh: OpenAI 与甲骨文的云算力合同（星际之门 4.5 吉瓦）
summary_en: OpenAI announced a 4.5 GW Stargate data-centre partnership with Oracle in July 2025; the WSJ reported the contract at about $300B over roughly five years from 2027. It anchors Oracle's backlog (RPO $664B at 31 Aug 2026); Bloomberg reported some sites slipping to 2028, which Oracle denied.
summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 7 月宣布与甲骨文合作开发 4.5 吉瓦星际之门数据中心容量；据《华尔街日报》报道，合同金额约 3000 亿美元，自 2027 年起为期约五年。该合同是甲骨文剩余履约义务（RPO，截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日为 6640 亿美元）的主要来源；彭博曾报道部分站点推迟至 2028 年，甲骨文予以否认。

amount_text: €1.3B (~$1.5B) of a €1.7B Series C; ~11% fully diluted stake; ~€11.7B post-money
title_en: ASML leads Mistral AI's Series C with €1.3B
title_zh: 阿斯麦以 13 亿欧元领投 Mistral AI C 轮
summary_en: ASML invested €1.3B as lead investor of Mistral AI's €1.7B Series C, taking about 11% and a seat on its Strategic Committee, alongside a partnership to use Mistral models across ASML's products and R&D.
summary_zh: 阿斯麦作为领投方向 Mistral AI 17 亿欧元的 C 轮投入 13 亿欧元，获得约 11% 股权及战略委员会席位，并达成在其产品与研发中使用 Mistral 模型的合作。

amount_text: €600M (~$703M as reported)
title_en: Deutsche Bank lends EcoDataCenter €600M
title_zh: 德意志银行向 EcoDataCenter 提供 6 亿欧元贷款
summary_en: Swedish data-centre operator EcoDataCenter, owned by Areim, raised €600M of debt from Deutsche Bank Private Credit and Infrastructure, mainly to expand its Falun and Borlänge campuses (Borlänge later hosts Mistral AI's Swedish site).
summary_zh: Areim 旗下瑞典数据中心运营商 EcoDataCenter 从德意志银行私募信贷与基础设施部门获得 6 亿欧元债务融资，主要用于扩建法伦和博伦厄园区（博伦厄后来成为 Mistral AI 瑞典站点所在地）。

amount_text: $6.3B initial order value; Nvidia buys capacity CoreWeave cannot sell, through Apr 2032
title_en: Nvidia $6.3B backstop for CoreWeave's unsold capacity
title_zh: 英伟达为 CoreWeave 未售出算力提供 63 亿美元兜底采购
summary_en: CoreWeave disclosed a $6.3B order under which Nvidia must buy any of CoreWeave's cloud capacity not used by other customers through April 2032. Nvidia is also CoreWeave's GPU supplier and a major shareholder. It supports CoreWeave's borrowing but is not a guarantee of its debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 披露一份 63 亿美元订单：2032 年 4 月前，英伟达须购买 CoreWeave 其他客户未使用的云算力。英伟达同时是 CoreWeave 的 GPU 供应商和主要股东。这增强了 CoreWeave 的举债能力，但并非对其债务的担保。

amount_text: CNY 4.4B (~$618M at ~7.12 CNY/USD), 1.90% coupon, due 2029
title_en: Baidu CNY 4.4B dim sum bonds for AI
title_zh: 百度 44 亿元离岸人民币债券支持 AI
summary_en: Baidu sold CNY 4.4B of 1.90% senior unsecured notes due 2029 for general corporate purposes including repaying debt, as it funds AI; completed on 15 September 2025. With the March deal it raised CNY 14.4B in dim sum bonds in 2025.
summary_zh: 百度发行 44 亿元人民币、票息 1.90%、2029 年到期的优先无担保票据，用于偿债等一般公司用途，支持其 AI 投入，于 2025 年 9 月 15 日完成；连同 3 月发行，2025 年点心债共募资 144 亿元人民币。

amount_text: $17.4B through 2031, up to ~$19.4B with options; ~$7B of upfront payments tied to milestones
title_en: Microsoft $17.4B GPU capacity contract with Nebius
title_zh: 微软与 Nebius 的 174 亿美元 GPU 算力合同
summary_en: Nebius will supply Microsoft dedicated GPU capacity from its Vineland, New Jersey data centre through 2031 for $17.4B, or up to $19.4B with extra capacity, financed partly with debt secured on the contract.
summary_zh: Nebius 将在 2031 年前从其新泽西州 Vineland 数据中心向微软提供专属 GPU 算力，金额 174 亿美元，若追加容量最高 194 亿美元，部分资金以该合同为抵押的债务筹集。

amount_text: ~$1.5B over 4 years for ~18,000 GPUs ($1.3B for 10,000 + $200M for 8,000)
title_en: Nvidia leases back its own GPUs from Lambda (~$1.5B)
title_zh: 英伟达向 Lambda 回租自家 GPU（约 15 亿美元）
summary_en: The Information reported that Nvidia, an investor in Lambda, will rent about 18,000 GPU servers back from Lambda over four years for roughly $1.5B, making it Lambda's biggest customer; Lambda raised a ~$917M loan to buy the chips.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，作为 Lambda 投资方的英伟达将在四年内以约 15 亿美元回租约 1.8 万台 GPU 服务器，成为 Lambda 最大客户；Lambda 为购买这些芯片筹集了约 9.17 亿美元贷款。

amount_text: $13.0B of Series F-1 shares at $140.97 a share, sold August-September 2025 ($183B post-money; Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Anthropic $13B Series F at $183B
title_zh: Anthropic 130 亿美元 F 轮融资（估值 1830 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised $13B led by ICONIQ, co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed, at a $183B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: Anthropic 完成 130 亿美元 F 轮融资，由 ICONIQ 领投、富达与 Lightspeed 联合领投，投后估值 1830 亿美元。

amount_text: ~$4.0B over an initial ~15-year term for 150 MW (third building, ELN-04); brings CoreWeave's Polaris Forge 1 leases to 400 MW and ~$11B
title_en: CoreWeave leases a further 150 MW at Polaris Forge 1 (~$4B)
title_zh: CoreWeave 追加租用 Polaris Forge 1 园区 150 兆瓦（约 40 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave exercised its option and signed a third ~15-year lease for 150 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus, worth about $4B, taking the whole 400 MW campus and about $11B of contracted rent. The building is funded by Applied Digital's $1.59B 2031 notes (separate edge).
summary_zh: CoreWeave 行使选择权，与 Applied Digital 签订第三份约 15 年期租约，追加租用 Polaris Forge 1 园区 150 兆瓦，价值约 40 亿美元，使其包下整个 400 兆瓦园区、合同租金合计约 110 亿美元。该栋楼由 Applied Digital 发行的 15.9 亿美元 2031 年到期票据出资（另列一条）。

to_name: Chirisa Technology Parks (Blue Owl JV partner)
amount_text: $4B JV funding (Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks affiliates, Machine Investment Group)
title_en: Blue Owl-led $4B JV funds CoreWeave's Lancaster campus
title_zh: Blue Owl 牵头的 40 亿美元合资为 CoreWeave 兰开斯特园区融资
summary_en: Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks affiliates and Machine Investment Group closed a JV with $4B of funding for the CoreWeave-leased AI campus in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 基金、Chirisa 科技园关联方与 Machine Investment Group 完成合资，为 CoreWeave 承租的宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特 AI 园区提供 40 亿美元资金。

amount_text: $8.9B for 433.3M shares at $20.47 (~9.9%): $5.7B of unpaid CHIPS grants + $3.2B Secure Enclave; plus a 5-year warrant for 5% more at $20 if Intel's foundry stake falls below 51%
title_en: US government takes a 9.9% stake in Intel for $8.9B
title_zh: 美国政府以 89 亿美元入股英特尔 9.9%
summary_en: The US government converted Intel's remaining CHIPS Act and Secure Enclave grants into an $8.9B purchase of Intel common stock, a passive 9.9% stake; the Secure Enclave portion is paid as milestones are met.
summary_zh: 美国政府将英特尔尚未拨付的芯片法案及“安全飞地”补贴转为 89 亿美元的英特尔普通股认购，持股约 9.9%（被动持股）；安全飞地部分按里程碑拨付。

subkind: AI inference chip procurement (via H3C and ZTE servers)
amount_text: Over CNY 1B (~$139M), across China Mobile's 2025-26 inference equipment tender
title_en: Baidu's Kunlunxin wins >CNY 1B China Mobile AI chip orders
title_zh: 百度昆仑芯中标中国移动逾 10 亿元人民币 AI 芯片订单
summary_en: Kunlunxin, 59%-owned by Baidu, said it won orders worth over CNY 1B for China Mobile AI projects, with chips going into servers from first-tier suppliers H3C and ZTE. A Huawei-related company won other parts of the tender.
summary_zh: 百度持股 59% 的昆仑芯宣布获得中国移动 AI 项目逾 10 亿元人民币订单，芯片将用于一级供应商新华三和中兴的服务器；招标其余部分由华为相关公司中标。

amount_text: >$10B over 6 years
title_en: Meta $10B+ Google Cloud deal
title_zh: Meta 与谷歌云逾 100 亿美元的合同
summary_en: The Information and Reuters reported that Meta signed a six-year Google Cloud deal worth more than $10B, mostly for AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 和路透社报道，Meta 与谷歌云签署为期六年、价值逾 100 亿美元的合同，主要用于 AI 基础设施。

amount_text: $2B of new Intel common stock at $23 a share
title_en: SoftBank invests $2B in Intel
title_zh: 软银向英特尔投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank signed a definitive agreement to buy $2B of newly issued Intel shares at $23 each; Intel's Q3 2025 results reported the investment as made.
summary_zh: 软银签署最终协议，以每股 23 美元认购 20 亿美元英特尔新股；英特尔 2025 年第三季度财报确认该投资已完成。

amount_text: $1.4B senior secured term loan; SOFR (2.5% floor) + 4.75%; 80% loan-to-cost
title_en: Deutsche Bank $1.4B project loan for Galaxy's Helios (CoreWeave) campus
title_zh: 德意志银行为 Galaxy Helios 园区（CoreWeave 租用）提供 14 亿美元项目贷款
summary_en: Deutsche Bank is the initial lender on a $1.4B senior secured term loan to Galaxy Helios I LLC to build Phase I of the Helios campus leased to CoreWeave, secured by the project's assets; Galaxy put in about $350M of equity.
summary_zh: 德意志银行作为初始贷款方，向 Galaxy Helios I LLC 提供 14 亿美元优先担保定期贷款，用于建设租给 CoreWeave 的 Helios 园区一期，以项目资产作抵押；Galaxy 投入约 3.5 亿美元股本。

amount_text: $3.2B total: $1.8B (CB-3/CB-4, Aug 14) + $1.4B (CB-5, Aug 18); Google receives warrants for ~14% of TeraWulf
title_en: Google backstops $3.2B of Fluidstack leases at TeraWulf
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 TeraWulf 的租约提供 32 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google agreed to cover up to $3.2B of Fluidstack's lease payments to TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus if Fluidstack cannot pay (Fluidstack is the obligor), which let TeraWulf raise project debt; in return Google got warrants making it TeraWulf's largest shareholder.
summary_zh: 谷歌同意在 Fluidstack 无法支付时，承担其对 TeraWulf 纽约 Lake Mariner 园区最高 32 亿美元的租金（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），使 TeraWulf 得以进行项目债务融资；作为回报谷歌获得认股权证，成为 TeraWulf 最大股东。

amount_text: ~$6.7B contracted revenue over initial 10-year terms for CB-3, CB-4 and CB-5 (~$3.7B for the first ~200 MW, then +160 MW CB-5); up to ~$16B with extensions; July 2026 amendments raised CB-4 and CB-5 to 168 MW each (value not updated)
title_en: Fluidstack leases 360 MW at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner (~$6.7B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 TeraWulf Lake Mariner 园区 360 兆瓦（约 67 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed 10-year leases for AI data halls at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus in New York, first ~200 MW (CB-3/CB-4, ~$3.7B) and then CB-5 (+160 MW), for ~$6.7B of contracted revenue. Google backstops up to $3.2B of the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 TeraWulf 签订纽约 Lake Mariner 园区 AI 数据机房 10 年租约，先是约 200 兆瓦（CB-3/CB-4，约 37 亿美元），后追加 CB-5（160 兆瓦），合同收入合计约 67 亿美元；谷歌为其中最多 32 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: Price undisclosed; plus new capital to the land fund to develop 650 MW in Chicago, Atlanta and Dallas
title_en: Apollo funds to buy majority of Stream Data Centers
title_zh: 阿波罗基金收购 Stream 数据中心多数股权
summary_en: Apollo-managed funds agreed to buy a majority stake in hyperscale developer Stream Data Centers from Stream Realty Partners, management keeping a minority stake; closing was expected in 2025 (not confirmed here).
summary_zh: 阿波罗管理的基金同意从 Stream Realty Partners 收购超大规模数据中心开发商 Stream 数据中心的多数股权，管理层保留少数股权；预计 2025 年交割（此处未核实是否已完成）。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of Apple's American Manufacturing Program
title_en: Apple to have Samsung make new chips in Austin, Texas
title_zh: 苹果委托三星在得州奥斯汀生产新型芯片
summary_en: Apple named Samsung's Austin fab as a partner in its American Manufacturing Program to launch a new chipmaking technology; Apple did not say what the chips are, and industry experts expect stacked image sensors for future iPhones.
summary_zh: 苹果在“美国制造计划”中宣布与三星奥斯汀工厂合作推出全新芯片制造技术；苹果未说明具体产品，业内预计为用于未来 iPhone 的堆叠式图像传感器。

amount_text: $2.6B; led by Morgan Stanley and MUFG (Goldman Sachs joint lead arranger); reported SOFR+4%
title_en: CoreWeave $2.6B loan to serve OpenAI contract
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 26 亿美元贷款以履行 OpenAI 合同
summary_en: Morgan Stanley and MUFG led a $2.6B delayed-draw loan, with JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, SMBC and others, to fund GPUs and infrastructure for CoreWeave's long-term OpenAI contract.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利与三菱日联牵头（摩根大通、富国、三井住友等参与）提供 26 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款，为 CoreWeave 与 OpenAI 的长期合同采购 GPU 和基础设施。

subkind: foundry manufacturing contract (AI6 chips, Taylor fab)
amount_text: ~$16.5B (KRW 22.76 trillion) from 24 Jul 2025 to 31 Dec 2033; Musk called it a minimum
title_en: Tesla $16.5B AI6 chip foundry contract with Samsung
title_zh: 特斯拉与三星的 165 亿美元 AI6 芯片代工合同
summary_en: Samsung disclosed a $16.5B chip manufacturing contract with an unnamed client running to 2033, and Elon Musk confirmed it is Tesla, whose AI6 chip will be made at Samsung's Taylor, Texas fab.
summary_zh: 三星披露一份为期至 2033 年、金额 165 亿美元的芯片代工合同，客户未具名；马斯克确认客户为特斯拉，其 AI6 芯片将在三星得州泰勒工厂生产。

amount_text: $1.75B 9.000% senior notes due 2031 (upsized by $250M)
title_en: CoreWeave $1.75B senior notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 17.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced $1.75B of 9% senior notes due 2031 for general corporate purposes including refinancing.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价 17.5 亿美元、票息 9%、2031 年到期的优先票据，用于一般企业用途及再融资。

amount_text: ~$9B all-stock; terminated, so not counted in totals
title_en: CoreWeave's $9B bid for Core Scientific (terminated)
title_zh: CoreWeave 90 亿美元收购 Core Scientific（已终止）
summary_en: CoreWeave agreed to buy its data-centre landlord Core Scientific in an all-stock deal worth about $9B; the deal was terminated on 30 October 2025 after Core Scientific shareholders voted it down.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 同意以全股票方式约 90 亿美元收购其数据中心出租方 Core Scientific；2025 年 10 月 30 日因 Core Scientific 股东投票否决而终止。

amount_text: HK$12.023B (~$1.53B) zero-coupon bonds due July 2032, exchangeable into Alibaba Health shares
title_en: Alibaba HK$12B exchangeable bonds for cloud and commerce
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 120 亿港元可交换债券用于云与国际电商
summary_en: Alibaba sold HK$12.023B of zero-coupon bonds exchangeable into shares of Alibaba Health, with proceeds for general corporate purposes including investment in its cloud infrastructure and international commerce businesses.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行 120.23 亿港元零息可交换债券（可换股为阿里健康股份），所得款项用于一般公司用途，包括投资云基础设施和国际电商业务。

amount_text: $5B secured notes + term loans (fixed ~12%, floating SOFR+700bp reported); repaid in March 2026
title_en: xAI $5B bonds and loans via Morgan Stanley (repaid)
title_zh: xAI 经摩根士丹利发行 50 亿美元债券及贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: Morgan Stanley placed $5B of xAI secured notes and term loans at junk-level yields alongside $5B of equity. After SpaceX acquired xAI in Feb 2026, the debt was retired in March 2026 with SpaceX's $20B bridge loan.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利为 xAI 配售 50 亿美元优先担保票据和定期贷款（垃圾级收益率），同时 xAI 获 50 亿美元股权融资。SpaceX 于 2026 年 2 月收购 xAI 后，这笔债务于 2026 年 3 月由 SpaceX 的 200 亿美元过桥贷款偿清。

amount_text: $750M credit facility from Brookfield's infrastructure debt platform
title_en: Brookfield provides Crusoe a $750M credit facility
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德向 Crusoe 提供 7.5 亿美元信贷额度
summary_en: Crusoe secured a $750M credit facility from Brookfield Asset Management's infrastructure debt business, mainly to expand its AI factories (purpose-built AI data centres) and AI cloud platform.
summary_zh: Crusoe 从布鲁克菲尔德资产管理的基础设施债务业务获得 7.5 亿美元信贷额度，主要用于扩建其 AI 工厂（专用 AI 数据中心）和 AI 云平台。

amount_text: Widely reported at ~$14.3B for 49%; amount not in the company post
title_en: Meta takes a 49% stake in Scale AI
title_zh: Meta 入股 Scale AI 49%
summary_en: Meta made a large investment in Scale AI, and Scale's founder Alexandr Wang left to join Meta's new superintelligence effort.
summary_zh: Meta 大额投资 Scale AI，Scale 创始人亚历山大·王（Alexandr Wang）离任并加入 Meta 新组建的超级智能团队。

amount_text: Undisclosed; finalised in May 2025 per Reuters sources
title_en: OpenAI adds Google Cloud as a compute supplier
title_zh: OpenAI 将谷歌云纳入算力供应商
summary_en: Reuters reported, citing three sources, that OpenAI signed up for Google Cloud capacity, a deal finalised in May 2025. Neither company disclosed its size or scope.
summary_zh: 据路透社援引三位知情人士报道，OpenAI 签约使用谷歌云算力，协议于 2025 年 5 月敲定，双方均未披露规模或范围。

amount_text: ~$7B total revenue over ~15 years for 250 MW of critical IT load (two leases, ELN-02 100 MW and ELN-03 150 MW)
title_en: CoreWeave leases 250 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 (~$7B)
title_zh: CoreWeave 租用 Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1 园区 250 兆瓦（约 70 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave signed two ~15-year leases for 250 MW of critical IT load at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, worth about $7B in total. CoreWeave also took an option on a further 150 MW, which it later exercised (separate edge).
summary_zh: CoreWeave 与 Applied Digital 签订两份约 15 年期租约，租用其北达科他州埃伦代尔 Polaris Forge 1 园区 250 兆瓦关键 IT 负载，总收入约 70 亿美元；CoreWeave 还获得追加 150 兆瓦的选择权，后已行使（另列一条）。

amount_text: ~$40B for ~400,000 GB200 chips (FT)
term: Compute leased to OpenAI for 15 years
title_en: Oracle buys ~$40B of Nvidia chips for OpenAI's Abilene site
title_zh: 甲骨文为 OpenAI 阿比林站点采购约 400 亿美元英伟达芯片
summary_en: The FT reported that Oracle will spend about $40B on roughly 400,000 Nvidia GB200 chips for the first Stargate site in Abilene, Texas, and lease the computing power to OpenAI.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，甲骨文将斥资约 400 亿美元采购约 40 万颗英伟达 GB200 芯片，用于得州阿比林的首个星际之门站点，并将算力租给 OpenAI。

amount_text: $7.1B construction loan for phase 2 of a $15B, 1.2 GW JV (JPMorgan total across both loans ~$9.6B)
title_en: JPMorgan-led $7.1B loan for Abilene Stargate phase 2
title_zh: 摩根大通牵头 71 亿美元贷款支持阿比林星际之门二期
summary_en: A JPMorgan-led consortium lent $7.1B for phase 2 of the 1.2 GW Abilene campus, owned by a $15B Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital joint venture and leased to Oracle for OpenAI.
summary_zh: 摩根大通牵头的银团提供 71 亿美元贷款，建设 1.2 吉瓦阿比林园区二期；园区由 Crusoe、Blue Owl 与 Primary Digital 组成的 150 亿美元合资公司持有，租给甲骨文供 OpenAI 使用。

amount_text: $15B joint venture in total (Crusoe, Blue Owl Real Assets funds, Primary Digital Infrastructure); Blue Owl's share undisclosed
term: 1.2 GW, eight buildings; phase 2 energized mid-2026
title_en: Blue Owl co-sponsors Crusoe's $15B Abilene campus joint venture
title_zh: Blue Owl 联合投资 Crusoe 阿比林园区 150 亿美元合资项目
summary_en: Funds managed by Blue Owl's Real Assets platform, Crusoe and Primary Digital Infrastructure jointly sponsor the 1.2 GW Abilene, Texas campus (Stargate, built for Oracle and OpenAI), in a joint venture totalling about $15B. The JPMorgan-led construction loans are separate edges.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 旗下实物资产基金与 Crusoe、Primary Digital Infrastructure 共同出资建设得州阿比林 1.2 吉瓦园区（为甲骨文和 OpenAI 的星际之门项目建造），合资项目总额约 150 亿美元。摩根大通牵头的建设贷款另列。

amount_text: $2B 9.250% senior notes due 2030 (upsized)
title_en: CoreWeave $2B high-yield bond debut
title_zh: CoreWeave 首发 20 亿美元高收益债
summary_en: CoreWeave's first bond after its IPO: $2B of 9.25% unsecured senior notes due 2030, used partly to repay existing debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 上市后首只债券：20 亿美元、票息 9.25%、2030 年到期的无担保优先票据，部分用于偿还现有债务。

amount_text: ~$6.5B all-stock; OpenAI already held ~23% and paid ~$5B of shares for the rest (announced 2025-05-21, closed 2025-07-09)
title_en: OpenAI buys Jony Ive's io for $6.5B in stock
title_zh: OpenAI 以约 65 亿美元股票收购乔尼·艾维的 io
summary_en: OpenAI bought io, the AI-device startup co-founded by former Apple design chief Jony Ive, in an all-stock deal of nearly $6.5B, its largest acquisition, to build its own hardware. The deal closed on 9 July 2025.
summary_zh: OpenAI 以近 65 亿美元全股票方式收购前苹果首席设计师乔尼·艾维联合创办的 AI 设备公司 io，这是其迄今最大收购，用于自研硬件；交易于 2025 年 7 月 9 日完成。

to_name: Campus AI (MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI, NVIDIA JV in France)
amount_text: Undisclosed share; project reported at ~€8.5B (~$9.6B) by Bloomberg
term: 1.4 GW near Paris; construction from H2 2026, operations from 2028
title_en: MGX co-founds Campus AI, Europe's largest AI campus, in France
title_zh: MGX 联合创立法国 AI 园区（欧洲最大 AI 园区）
summary_en: MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI and Nvidia formed a joint venture to build a 1.4 GW AI campus in the Paris region, announced at the Choose France summit. Mistral gets priority access to its compute.
summary_zh: MGX、Bpifrance、Mistral AI 与英伟达在“选择法国”峰会上宣布组建合资公司，在巴黎地区建设 1.4 吉瓦 AI 园区，Mistral 享有算力优先使用权。

to_name: Campus AI (MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI, NVIDIA JV in France)
amount_text: Undisclosed share; project reported at ~€8.5B by Bloomberg
title_en: Mistral AI co-founds the Campus AI joint venture
title_zh: Mistral AI 联合创立法国 AI 园区合资公司
summary_en: Mistral AI is a partner, with MGX, Bpifrance and Nvidia, in the joint venture building the 1.4 GW Campus AI in the Paris region, which will host its compute.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 与 MGX、Bpifrance 和英伟达共同参与在巴黎地区建设 1.4 吉瓦法国 AI 园区的合资公司，该园区将承载其算力。

amount_text: $15B senior secured revolver under the amended and restated credit agreement of 4 Sept 2026 (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding agent), maturing 4 Sept 2031; grown from $2.5B (May 2025) to $2.75B (Sept 2025) and $3.25B (Nov 2025); undrawn at 30 June 2026 apart from $78M of letters of credit (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Anthropic $15B revolving credit facility
title_zh: Anthropic 150 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: Anthropic's revolver from banks led by Morgan Stanley, opened at $2.5B in May 2025 with Barclays, Citi, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, RBC and MUFG, was enlarged to $15B in September 2026 and now runs to 2031. The S-1 says it is secured on substantially all assets until Anthropic wins investment-grade ratings and requires at least $5B of liquidity.
summary_zh: Anthropic 由摩根士丹利牵头的循环信贷额度于 2025 年 5 月以 25 亿美元设立（参与银行包括巴克莱、花旗、高盛、摩根大通、加拿大皇家银行和三菱日联），2026 年 9 月扩大至 150 亿美元，期限延至 2031 年。S-1 显示，在获得投资级评级前该额度以几乎全部资产担保，并要求公司保持至少 50 亿美元流动性。

amount_text: $4.5B in four tranches: $1.5B 3-year, $1B 5-year, $1B 7-year, $1B 10-year notes (maturities 2028-2035)
title_en: Apple $4.5B bond sale, its first in two years
title_zh: 苹果发行 45 亿美元债券，两年来首次
summary_en: Apple sold $4.5B of bonds in four tranches, its first offering in two years, to fund buybacks and repay debt; orders reached about $10B.
summary_zh: 苹果发行四档共 45 亿美元债券，为两年来首次发债，用于回购股票和偿还债务，认购约 100 亿美元。

amount_text: $15B one-year bridge ($8.5B drawn for OpenAI, $6.5B for Ampere per SoftBank's FY2025 report); lead underwriters Mizuho, SMBC, JPMorgan, 21 banks; reported May 2025 (day not given); repaid by maturity in April 2026
term: 1 year; fully repaid by maturity in April 2026
title_en: SoftBank $15B bridge loan for OpenAI and Ampere
title_zh: 软银 150 亿美元过桥贷款用于 OpenAI 与 Ampere 投资
summary_en: SoftBank took a one-year $15B bridge loan, underwritten by Mizuho, SMBC and JPMorgan, to fund its first OpenAI investments and the $6.5B Ampere acquisition. SoftBank's FY2025 consolidated financial report (year to 31 March 2026) says the borrowings were fully repaid by their maturity in April 2026.
summary_zh: 软银获得由瑞穗、三井住友和摩根大通包销的一年期 150 亿美元过桥贷款，用于首批 OpenAI 投资及 65 亿美元收购 Ampere。据软银 2025 财年（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）合并财务报告，该贷款已于 2026 年 4 月到期前全部偿还。

amount_text: $1.75B: $500M 5.65% notes due Nov 2032 + $1.25B 6.05% notes due 2035. Micron prepaid $429M of the 2032 notes and $1,030M of the 2035 notes on 3 April 2026, leaving $71M and $220M (10-K for fiscal 2026)
title_en: Micron $1.75B senior notes
title_zh: 美光发行 17.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: Micron sold $1.75B of senior notes due 2032 and 2035 (closed 29 April 2025); proceeds were mainly to redeem its 2027 notes and unwind related swaps. On 3 April 2026 Micron prepaid most of both series ($1.46B of principal), leaving $291M outstanding.
summary_zh: 美光发行 17.5 亿美元 2032 年及 2035 年到期优先票据（2025 年 4 月 29 日交割），所得主要用于赎回 2027 年到期票据及结清相关利率互换。2026 年 4 月 3 日美光提前偿还了两期票据的大部分（本金 14.6 亿美元），剩余 2.91 亿美元未偿。

amount_text: Undisclosed
title_en: AMD makes 2nm EPYC Venice and US-built CPUs at TSMC
title_zh: AMD 在台积电生产 2 纳米 EPYC Venice 及美国制造 CPU
summary_en: AMD said its next EPYC 'Venice' CPU is the industry's first HPC product taped out on TSMC's 2nm (N2) process, and that it validated 5th Gen EPYC CPUs at TSMC's Arizona fab, its first products made in the US.
summary_zh: AMD 宣布其下一代 EPYC “Venice” 处理器是业界首款在台积电 2 纳米（N2）工艺流片的高性能计算产品，并已在台积电亚利桑那厂完成第五代 EPYC 验证，这是 AMD 首批美国制造产品。

subkind: equity investment (co-investors in a SoftBank-led round)
amount_text: ~$10B syndicated to co-investors (Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter, Thrive) in the $40B round led by SoftBank's $30B; SoftBank later put the aggregate at $41B; SoftBank's $30B is softbank-openai-2025-03-equity
title_en: Co-investors put ~$10B into OpenAI's March 2025 round
title_zh: 跟投方向 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月融资轮出资约 100 亿美元
summary_en: Alongside SoftBank's $30B lead, a syndicate including Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter and Thrive committed about $10B to OpenAI's $40B round at a $300B post-money valuation announced on 31 March 2025; CNBC reported in December 2025 that the round was fully funded at an aggregate $41B. Individual amounts were not disclosed.
summary_zh: 在软银领投 300 亿美元之外，微软、Coatue、Altimeter 和 Thrive 等跟投方向 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月 31 日宣布的 400 亿美元融资（投后估值 3000 亿美元）承诺约 100 亿美元；CNBC 2025 年 12 月报道该轮已全部到位，合计 410 亿美元。各家出资额未披露。

amount_text: $30B from SoftBank ($7.5B Apr 2025 + $22.5B Dec 2025) in a $41B round; the ~$10-11B co-investor piece is its own edge (private-investors-openai-2025-03-round)
title_en: SoftBank leads OpenAI's $41B round
title_zh: 软银领投 OpenAI 410 亿美元融资
summary_en: SoftBank led OpenAI's March 2025 round, investing $7.5B in April and $22.5B in December 2025 through Vision Fund 2, with $11B from co-investors. SoftBank said the round was fully funded on 26 December 2025, giving it about 11% of OpenAI.
summary_zh: 软银领投 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月的融资，通过愿景基金二期于 4 月出资 75 亿美元、12 月出资 225 亿美元，另有 110 亿美元来自跟投方。软银称该轮已于 2025 年 12 月 26 日全部到位，持有 OpenAI 约 11% 股份。

amount_text: Undisclosed total; Galaxy expects >$1B average annual revenue over the 15-year terms for 526 MW of critical IT load (133 MW Phase I, 260 MW Phase II, 133 MW Phase III)
title_en: CoreWeave leases all 526 MW at Galaxy's Helios campus
title_zh: CoreWeave 租下 Galaxy Helios 园区全部 526 兆瓦
summary_en: CoreWeave leased the first 133 MW at Galaxy's Helios campus in Dickens County, Texas, in March 2025 and then exercised its options for 260 MW and the final 133 MW, taking all 526 MW of critical IT load; Galaxy expects more than $1B of average annual revenue. Phase I was delivered in July 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年 3 月租用 Galaxy 位于得州迪肯斯县 Helios 园区的首期 133 兆瓦，随后行使选择权追加 260 兆瓦及最后 133 兆瓦，包下全部 526 兆瓦关键 IT 负载；Galaxy 预计年均收入超过 10 亿美元。一期已于 2026 年 7 月交付。

amount_text: ~$1.9B final payment (net of adjustments) at second closing on 27 Mar 2025; total deal ~$9B agreed 2020
title_en: SK hynix completes purchase of Intel's NAND business
title_zh: SK 海力士完成收购英特尔 NAND 业务
summary_en: SK hynix made a final payment of about $1.9B to Intel to complete its roughly $9B purchase of Intel's NAND and SSD business, folding the remaining IP and R&D staff into Solidigm.
summary_zh: SK 海力士向英特尔支付约 19 亿美元尾款，完成约 90 亿美元的英特尔 NAND 与固态硬盘业务收购，剩余知识产权与研发人员并入 Solidigm。

to_name: AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock, GIP, MGX, Microsoft, NVIDIA)
amount_text: Undisclosed; AIP seeks $30B of capital, up to $100B with debt
title_en: xAI joins the AI Infrastructure Partnership
title_zh: xAI 加入 AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP）
summary_en: BlackRock, GIP, Microsoft and MGX announced that xAI and Nvidia join their data-centre and energy investment partnership, renamed the AI Infrastructure Partnership; GE Vernova and NextEra collaborate with it.
summary_zh: 贝莱德、GIP、微软和 MGX 宣布 xAI 与英伟达加入其数据中心和能源投资合作平台，并更名为 AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP）；GE Vernova 和 NextEra 为合作方。

title_en: OpenAI cloud contracts with CoreWeave (~$22.4B)
title_zh: OpenAI 与 CoreWeave 的云算力合同（约 224 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave signed three contracts with OpenAI in 2025 worth up to about $22.4B in total, used to train OpenAI's next-generation models. The deals reduced CoreWeave's dependence on Microsoft, which was 62% of its 2024 revenue.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年与 OpenAI 签订三份合同，总价值最高约 224 亿美元，用于训练 OpenAI 下一代模型，降低了其对微软（占 2024 年收入 62%）的依赖。

amount_text: $2B zero-coupon bonds due March 2032, exchangeable into Trip.com Hong Kong shares
title_en: Baidu $2B exchangeable bonds into Trip.com
title_zh: 百度 20 亿美元可交换债（可换携程股份）
summary_en: Baidu sold $2B of zero-coupon bonds exchangeable into Trip.com shares, with proceeds to repay debt, pay interest and for general corporate purposes. The deal closed on 12 March 2025.
summary_zh: 百度发行 20 亿美元零息可交换债券（可交换为携程港股），所得款项用于偿债、付息及一般公司用途，2025 年 3 月 12 日交割。

title_en: Baidu CNY 10B dim sum bonds
title_zh: 百度 100 亿元离岸人民币债券
summary_en: Baidu raised CNY 10B in offshore yuan notes, its first bond sale since 2021, ahead of a $600M security due in April.
summary_zh: 百度发行 100 亿元离岸人民币债券，为 2021 年以来首次发债，并在 4 月一笔 6 亿美元债券到期前完成。

amount_text: US$250M (~RM1.1B) over 10 years
title_en: Malaysia pays Arm $250M for chip design licences
title_zh: 马来西亚向 Arm 支付 2.5 亿美元购买芯片设计授权
summary_en: Malaysia agreed to pay Arm $250M over ten years for chip design licences and technology so local firms can design their own AI and data-centre chips.
summary_zh: 马来西亚同意在十年内向 Arm 支付 2.5 亿美元，获取芯片设计授权与技术，帮助本土企业自主设计 AI 与数据中心芯片。

subkind: GPU purchases (Nvidia systems bought through OEM partners)
amount_text: Undisclosed; no Nvidia purchase total is disclosed: CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPU servers through OEM partners such as Dell and Super Micro and its 10-K says it has no long-term supply contracts (three suppliers were 23%, 20% and 17% of 2025 purchases); cash paid for property and equipment was $10.3B in 2025 and $8.7B in 2024
title_en: CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPUs for its cloud (via OEMs, total undisclosed)
title_zh: CoreWeave 为其云平台采购英伟达 GPU（经 OEM 交付，总额未披露）
summary_en: CoreWeave's fleet runs on Nvidia GPUs: its S-1 says customers contractually specify Nvidia GPUs, and the GPUs arrive as servers from OEM partners such as Dell and Super Micro rather than under a disclosed Nvidia purchase contract. This is the buyer leg of the Nvidia-CoreWeave loop (Nvidia is also a CoreWeave shareholder and buys its unsold capacity); the amount is undisclosed, so it is not counted.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 的算力全部基于英伟达 GPU：其 S-1 注册文件称客户在合同中指定使用英伟达 GPU，GPU 以服务器形式经戴尔、超微等 OEM 合作伙伴交付，并无公开披露的英伟达采购合同。这是英伟达与 CoreWeave 循环交易中的采购一环（英伟达同时是 CoreWeave 股东并包销其未售出算力）；金额未披露，不计入总额。

amount_text: ~$3.57B of Series E-1 shares at $56.09 a share, sold January-March 2025 ($61.5B post-money; Lightspeed led; Anthropic S-1). Google's and Amazon's earlier convertible notes converted into non-voting Series E shares at the same time (no new cash; on their own edges)
title_en: Anthropic $3.5B Series E at $61.5B
title_zh: Anthropic 35 亿美元 E 轮融资（估值 615 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised about $3.57B in Series E-1 shares (January-March 2025) led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Bessemer, Cisco, D1, Fidelity, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo and Salesforce Ventures, to fund compute, research and international expansion.
summary_zh: Anthropic 于 2025 年 1-3 月以 E-1 优先股融资约 35.7 亿美元，由 Lightspeed 领投，Bessemer、思科、D1、富达、General Catalyst、Jane Street、Menlo 和 Salesforce Ventures 参投，资金用于算力、研究和国际扩张。

amount_text: $3B per year to deploy OpenAI products across SoftBank group companies; no contract total
title_en: SoftBank to spend $3B a year on OpenAI products (Cristal intelligence)
title_zh: 软银每年斥资 30 亿美元采购 OpenAI 产品（Cristal intelligence）
summary_en: SoftBank agreed to spend $3B a year deploying OpenAI's solutions across its group companies and to form SB OpenAI Japan to sell them in Japan.
summary_zh: 软银同意每年投入 30 亿美元在集团各公司部署 OpenAI 的解决方案，并成立 SB OpenAI Japan 在日本销售相关产品。

amount_text: ~$1B additional (reported as more than $1B); takes Google's total past $3B (FT)
title_en: Google invests another $1B in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌再向 Anthropic 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: The Financial Times reported that Google was investing a further $1B or more in Anthropic, taking its total past $3B; CNBC confirmed through a source.
summary_zh: 据《金融时报》报道，谷歌再向 Anthropic 投资约 10 亿美元或更多，使其累计投资超过 30 亿美元；CNBC 通过消息人士予以证实。

amount_text: $2.3B construction loan for phase 1 (206 MW)
title_en: JPMorgan $2.3B loan for Abilene Stargate phase 1
title_zh: 摩根大通为阿比林星际之门一期提供 23 亿美元贷款
summary_en: JPMorgan lent $2.3B to the Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital joint venture building the first 206 MW of the Abilene, Texas campus, fully leased to Oracle and used for OpenAI (the first Stargate site). Borrower is the JV in which Crusoe is developer.
summary_zh: 摩根大通向 Crusoe、Blue Owl 与 Primary Digital 的合资公司提供 23 亿美元贷款，用于建设得州阿比林园区首期 206 兆瓦，园区由甲骨文整体承租、供 OpenAI 使用（星际之门首个站点）。借款方为 Crusoe 担任开发商的合资公司。

amount_text: $100B to deploy at once, up to $500B over four years across all partners; each partner's share not disclosed
title_en: MGX is an initial equity funder of Stargate
title_zh: MGX 为星际之门（Stargate）初始股权出资方
summary_en: The Stargate Project, a new company to build AI infrastructure for OpenAI in the US, launched with SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX as initial equity funders; MGX is Abu Dhabi's AI investment firm.
summary_zh: 星际之门项目是为 OpenAI 在美国建设 AI 基础设施的新公司，初始股权出资方为软银、OpenAI、甲骨文和 MGX；MGX 为阿布扎比 AI 投资公司。

amount_text: $100B to deploy at once, up to $500B over four years across all partners; each partner's share not disclosed
title_en: OpenAI is an initial equity funder of Stargate
title_zh: OpenAI 为星际之门（Stargate）初始股权出资方
summary_en: The Stargate Project, a new company to build AI infrastructure for OpenAI in the US, launched with SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX as initial equity funders; OpenAI has operational responsibility.
summary_zh: 星际之门项目是为 OpenAI 在美国建设 AI 基础设施的新公司，初始股权出资方为软银、OpenAI、甲骨文和 MGX；OpenAI 负责运营。

amount_text: $100B to deploy at once, up to $500B over four years across all partners; each partner's share not disclosed
title_en: Oracle is an initial equity funder of Stargate
title_zh: 甲骨文为星际之门（Stargate）初始股权出资方
summary_en: The Stargate Project, a new company to build AI infrastructure for OpenAI in the US, launched with SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX as initial equity funders; Oracle is also a technology partner.
summary_zh: 星际之门项目是为 OpenAI 在美国建设 AI 基础设施的新公司，初始股权出资方为软银、OpenAI、甲骨文和 MGX；甲骨文同时是技术合作伙伴。

amount_text: $100B to deploy at once, up to $500B over four years across all partners; each partner's share not disclosed
title_en: SoftBank is an initial equity funder of Stargate
title_zh: 软银为星际之门（Stargate）初始股权出资方
summary_en: The Stargate Project, a new company to build AI infrastructure for OpenAI in the US, launched with SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX as initial equity funders; SoftBank has financial responsibility.
summary_zh: 星际之门项目是为 OpenAI 在美国建设 AI 基础设施的新公司，初始股权出资方为软银、OpenAI、甲骨文和 MGX；软银负责融资。

title_en: Broadcom $3B bond sale (January 2025)
title_zh: 博通发行 30 亿美元债券（2025 年 1 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $3B of senior notes in three tranches to prepay part of its VMware term loans.
summary_zh: 博通发行三档共 30 亿美元优先票据，用于提前偿还部分 VMware 定期贷款。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the $6B Series C (round total is a separate edge)
title_en: MGX invests in xAI's Series C
title_zh: MGX 参投 xAI C 轮
summary_en: xAI's release lists MGX among the investors in its $6B Series C, alongside a16z, BlackRock, Fidelity, Kingdom Holdings, QIA, Sequoia and others, with Nvidia and AMD as strategic investors.
summary_zh: xAI 公告列出 MGX 为其 60 亿美元 C 轮投资方之一，其他包括 a16z、贝莱德、富达、王国控股、卡塔尔投资局、红杉等，英伟达和 AMD 为战略投资者。

amount_text: $6B Series C
title_en: xAI raises $6B Series C
title_zh: xAI 完成 60 亿美元 C 轮融资
summary_en: xAI raised a further $6B from a16z, BlackRock, Fidelity, Kingdom Holdings, Lightspeed, MGX, Morgan Stanley, QIA, Sequoia, Valor and Vy, among others, with Nvidia and AMD as strategic investors.
summary_zh: xAI 再获 60 亿美元融资，投资方包括 a16z、贝莱德、富达、王国控股、Lightspeed、MGX、摩根士丹利、卡塔尔投资局、红杉、Valor 和 Vy 等，英伟达和 AMD 为战略投资者。

amount_text: Google's share undisclosed in an $800M+ round with TPG Rise Climate, CAI and Greenbelt; tied to a ~$20B plan for co-located clean power and data-centre parks by 2030
title_en: Google takes a stake in Intersect Power in $800M round
title_zh: 谷歌在 8 亿美元融资中入股 Intersect Power
summary_en: Google joined TPG Rise Climate, Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital in an $800M+ funding of Intersect Power, under a partnership to build data-centre parks co-located with new clean power, with Google as anchor tenant. Google later bought the company (separate edge).
summary_zh: 谷歌与 TPG Rise Climate、Climate Adaptive Infrastructure 及 Greenbelt Capital 一起参与 Intersect Power 逾 8 亿美元的融资，双方合作建设与新清洁电源同址的数据中心园区，谷歌为主力租户；谷歌后来收购了该公司（另列一条）。

subkind: senior unsecured notes (USD and offshore CNY)
amount_text: $2.65B USD notes ($1B 2030, $1.15B 2035, $0.5B 2054) + CNY 17B (~$2.35B) offshore yuan notes, maturities 2028-2044
title_en: Alibaba $5B dual-currency bond sale
title_zh: 阿里巴巴约 50 亿美元双币种债券
summary_en: Alibaba priced $2.65B of US dollar notes and CNY 17B of offshore yuan notes, about $5B in total, for general corporate purposes including repaying offshore debt and share buybacks. Both closed by 28 November 2024.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴定价发行 26.5 亿美元的美元票据及 170 亿元离岸人民币票据，合计约 50 亿美元，用于偿还离岸债务、股份回购等一般公司用途，两部分均于 2024 年 11 月 28 日前交割。

amount_text: $5B of loans in the finalised CHIPS award (alongside $6.6B of grants, not counted here); amount drawn not disclosed
title_en: US CHIPS award gives TSMC Arizona $5B of loans
title_zh: 美国芯片法案向台积电亚利桑那提供 50 亿美元贷款
summary_en: The Commerce Department finalised TSMC's CHIPS award for its Arizona fabs: $6.6B of grants plus $5B in loans. The loans are counted here; the grants are not debt.
summary_zh: 美国商务部敲定台积电亚利桑那工厂的芯片法案支持：66 亿美元补贴，外加 50 亿美元贷款。此处仅计入贷款，补贴不属于债务。

amount_text: Undisclosed; 100,000 Nvidia Hopper (H100) GPUs in service at Colossus per Nvidia's 28 Oct 2024 release, then being doubled to 200,000; neither company has disclosed a purchase total
title_en: xAI buys 100,000+ Nvidia H100 GPUs for Colossus (total undisclosed)
title_zh: xAI 为 Colossus 超级计算机采购逾 10 万颗英伟达 H100 GPU（总额未披露）
summary_en: Nvidia's October 2024 release says xAI's Colossus cluster in Memphis runs 100,000 Nvidia Hopper GPUs on Spectrum-X Ethernet and was being doubled to 200,000. It is the buyer leg of the Nvidia-xAI loop (Nvidia later invested in xAI's Series E). No purchase price was disclosed, so the edge is not counted.
summary_zh: 英伟达 2024 年 10 月的新闻稿称，xAI 位于孟菲斯的 Colossus 集群运行 10 万颗英伟达 Hopper GPU，采用 Spectrum-X 以太网，并正扩充至 20 万颗。这是英伟达与 xAI 循环交易中的采购一环（英伟达后来参投 xAI 的 E 轮融资）。采购价格未披露，不计入总额。

amount_text: $4B, undrawn at closing; JPMorgan, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS, HSBC
title_en: OpenAI $4B revolving credit facility
title_zh: OpenAI 40 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: OpenAI set up a $4B revolver with nine banks alongside its $6.6B equity round, giving it over $10B of liquidity to buy compute.
summary_zh: OpenAI 在 66 亿美元股权融资同时与九家银行设立 40 亿美元循环信贷额度，使其可用于购买算力的流动性超过 100 亿美元。

amount_text: $6.6B at a $157B valuation; Thrive Capital led (per a source), Microsoft, Nvidia and SoftBank joined
title_en: OpenAI raises $6.6B at a $157B valuation
title_zh: OpenAI 以 1570 亿美元估值融资 66 亿美元
summary_en: OpenAI closed a $6.6B round at a $157B valuation, reportedly led by Thrive Capital, with Microsoft, Nvidia, SoftBank and others participating.
summary_zh: OpenAI 以 1570 亿美元估值完成 66 亿美元融资，据报道由 Thrive Capital 领投，微软、英伟达、软银等参投。

amount_text: $10.8B from about 18-20 international and Chinese banks; half term loan, half revolver; three years plus a two-year extension option
title_en: ByteDance $10.8B offshore syndicated loan
title_zh: 字节跳动 108 亿美元境外银团贷款
summary_en: ByteDance set up a $10.8B offshore loan with Chinese and international banks, reported as the largest dollar corporate loan in Asia outside Japan. Part of it retired a $5B loan from 2021; Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan coordinated.
summary_zh: 字节跳动与中资及国际银行签署 108 亿美元境外贷款，据报道是日本以外亚洲规模最大的美元公司贷款，其中部分用于偿还 2021 年的 50 亿美元贷款，花旗、高盛和摩根大通为统筹行。

amount_text: $5B in four tranches (notes due 2028-2034); priced 26 Sep, settled 2 Oct 2024; to prepay term loans
title_en: Broadcom $5B bond sale (September 2024)
title_zh: 博通发行 50 亿美元债券（2024 年 9 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold a further $5B of senior notes in four tranches after the Fed's rate cut, using the proceeds to prepay VMware-related term loans.
summary_zh: 博通在美联储降息后再发行四档共 50 亿美元优先票据，所得用于提前偿还与 VMware 相关的定期贷款。

subkind: custom chip foundry and co-investment framework (Intel 18A, Intel 3)
amount_text: Multi-year, multi-billion-dollar framework; exact value undisclosed
title_en: AWS multi-billion custom-chip deal with Intel (18A AI fabric chip)
title_zh: AWS 与英特尔数十亿美元定制芯片合作（18A AI 互连芯片）
summary_en: AWS and Intel announced a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar co-investment framework: Intel will make an AI fabric chip for AWS on Intel 18A and a custom Xeon 6 on Intel 3.
summary_zh: AWS 与英特尔宣布多年期、数十亿美元的共同投资框架，英特尔将以 18A 工艺为 AWS 生产 AI 互连芯片，并以 Intel 3 工艺生产定制版至强 6 处理器。

amount_text: A$24B enterprise value (~US$16.1B at ~0.67 USD/AUD on 2024-09-04); Blackstone funds with CPP Investments
title_en: Blackstone buys AirTrunk for A$24B
title_zh: 黑石以 240 亿澳元收购 AirTrunk
summary_en: A Blackstone-led consortium including CPP Investments bought Australian data-centre operator AirTrunk at an enterprise value of about A$24B, billed as the largest data-centre deal globally; it closed in December 2024 after regulatory approvals.
summary_zh: 黑石牵头、加拿大养老基金投资公司参与的财团以约 240 亿澳元的企业价值收购澳大利亚数据中心运营商 AirTrunk，被称为全球最大的数据中心交易，于 2024 年 12 月获监管批准后完成。

to_name: Chirisa Technology Parks (Blue Owl JV partner)
amount_text: Up to ~$5B of potential capacity (Blue Owl, Chirisa Technology Parks, PowerHouse), not a committed total; first phase 120 MW near Richmond, Virginia
title_en: Blue Owl, Chirisa and PowerHouse JV for CoreWeave data centres
title_zh: Blue Owl、Chirisa 与 PowerHouse 为 CoreWeave 设立数据中心合资
summary_en: Blue Owl, Chirisa Technology Parks and PowerHouse Data Centers formed a partnership able to deploy up to about $5B on AI and HPC data centres, starting with 120 MW at Chirisa's Richmond-area campus delivered for CoreWeave.
summary_zh: Blue Owl、Chirisa 科技园与 PowerHouse 数据中心组建合作，可投入最高约 50 亿美元建设 AI 和高性能计算数据中心，首期为 Chirisa 里士满附近园区、为 CoreWeave 交付的 120 兆瓦。

amount_text: Joined a >$300M round at $3.3B valuation; Tencent's share undisclosed
title_en: Tencent invests in Moonshot AI
title_zh: 腾讯投资月之暗面
summary_en: Tencent joined a funding round of more than $300M in Moonshot AI that valued the Kimi maker at $3.3B, alongside Gaorong Capital and existing backer Alibaba.
summary_zh: 腾讯参与月之暗面逾 3 亿美元融资，估值 33 亿美元，同轮投资方还有高榕资本和老股东阿里巴巴。

amount_text: $5B in three tranches (notes due 2027, 2029, 2031); to prepay VMware acquisition term loans
title_en: Broadcom $5B bond sale (July 2024)
title_zh: 博通发行 50 亿美元债券（2024 年 7 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $5B of investment-grade bonds in three parts, led by BofA, BNP Paribas and HSBC, to repay part of the loans that funded its VMware purchase.
summary_zh: 博通发行三档共 50 亿美元投资级债券，由美国银行、法国巴黎银行和汇丰牵头，用于偿还收购 VMware 的部分贷款。

amount_text: €600M (~$645M) at ~€5.8B valuation; reportedly part equity, part debt
title_en: Mistral AI raises €600M at €5.8B valuation
title_zh: Mistral AI 以 58 亿欧元估值融资 6 亿欧元
summary_en: Mistral AI raised about €600M at a roughly €5.8B valuation, led by General Catalyst with existing VCs and corporate investors including Nvidia and Samsung.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 以约 58 亿欧元估值融资约 6 亿欧元，由 General Catalyst 领投，现有风投及英伟达、三星等企业投资者参与。

amount_text: $11B for a 49% equity interest in the Fab 34 (Ireland) joint venture; Intel keeps 51% and control
title_en: Apollo pays $11B for 49% of Intel's Fab 34 venture in Ireland
title_zh: 阿波罗以 110 亿美元收购英特尔爱尔兰 Fab 34 合资企业 49% 股权
summary_en: Apollo-managed funds invested $11B for a 49% stake in a joint venture tied to Intel's Fab 34 in Leixlip, Ireland; Intel retains 51% and operational control.
summary_zh: 阿波罗旗下基金投资 110 亿美元，取得英特尔爱尔兰莱克斯利普 Fab 34 相关合资企业 49% 股权；英特尔保留 51% 股权和运营控制权。

amount_text: $6B Series B
title_en: xAI raises $6B Series B
title_zh: xAI 完成 60 亿美元 B 轮融资
summary_en: xAI raised $6B from investors including Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia, Fidelity, Prince Alwaleed bin Talal and Kingdom Holding.
summary_zh: xAI 从 Valor Equity Partners、Vy Capital、a16z、红杉、富达、阿尔瓦利德王子及王国控股等处融资 60 亿美元。

amount_text: $5B of 0.50% convertible notes due 2031 ($4.5B base + $0.5B option exercised)
title_en: Alibaba $5B convertible notes
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 50 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: Alibaba sold $5B of 0.50% convertible senior notes due 2031 ($4.5B base plus a $0.5B option), with proceeds mainly for capped call transactions and share buybacks.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行 50 亿美元、票息 0.50%、2031 年到期的可转换优先票据（基础 45 亿美元加 5 亿美元超额配售选择权），资金主要用于上限看涨期权交易和股份回购。

amount_text: Up to $7.5B; led by Blackstone funds, Magnetar co-lead; Coatue, Carlyle, CDPQ, DigitalBridge, BlackRock and others
title_en: CoreWeave $7.5B debt facility led by Blackstone
title_zh: 黑石牵头向 CoreWeave 提供 75 亿美元债务融资
summary_en: In one of the largest private-credit financings of its kind, Blackstone and Magnetar led up to $7.5B of GPU-backed debt so CoreWeave could build compute for existing contracts with AI developers and enterprises.
summary_zh: 同类最大规模私募信贷之一：黑石与 Magnetar 牵头提供最高 75 亿美元 GPU 抵押债务，供 CoreWeave 为与 AI 实验室及企业的现有合同建设算力。

amount_text: Led a round of at least $600M at >$2.5B valuation; Alibaba's share undisclosed
title_en: Alibaba leads $600M round in MiniMax
title_zh: 阿里巴巴领投 MiniMax 6 亿美元融资
summary_en: Alibaba led a funding round of at least $600M in Shanghai AI start-up MiniMax at a valuation above $2.5B; HongShan (formerly Sequoia China) also committed, and existing backers included Tencent and IDG Capital.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴领投上海 AI 初创公司 MiniMax 至少 6 亿美元的融资，估值超过 25 亿美元，红杉中国（HongShan，原红杉资本中国基金）也承诺跟投，老股东包括腾讯和 IDG 资本。

amount_text: Led a ~$1B round at ~$2.5B valuation; Alibaba's own share undisclosed in the round reports (its annual report later showed ~$0.8B for ~36% over FY2024, per SCMP)
title_en: Alibaba leads $1B round in Moonshot AI
title_zh: 阿里巴巴领投月之暗面 10 亿美元融资
summary_en: Alibaba led a roughly $1B funding round in Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot, at about a $2.5B valuation, then the largest single round for a Chinese AI start-up.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴领投 Kimi 开发商月之暗面约 10 亿美元融资，估值约 25 亿美元，为当时中国 AI 初创公司最大单笔融资。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Intel said expected lifetime deal value across its foundry customers exceeds $15B
title_en: Microsoft chooses Intel 18A to make an in-house chip
title_zh: 微软选择英特尔 18A 工艺生产自研芯片
summary_en: At Intel Foundry Direct Connect, Intel said Microsoft plans to make a chip of its own design on Intel 18A; no contract value was given, and Intel put its foundry lifetime deal value above $15B.
summary_zh: 在英特尔代工大会上，英特尔宣布微软计划用 18A 工艺生产一款自研芯片；未披露合同金额，英特尔称其代工业务预计总合同价值超过 150 亿美元。

amount_text: $1.5B: $500M 3-year and $1B 5-year notes (day of pricing about 9 Jan 2024)
title_en: SK hynix $1.5B dollar bond sale
title_zh: SK 海力士发行 15 亿美元美元债
summary_en: SK hynix raised $1.5B in dollar bonds: $500M of three-year notes at 145 bp over Treasuries and $1B of five-year notes at 167 bp, amid strong demand.
summary_zh: SK 海力士发行 15 亿美元美元债：5 亿美元三年期（较美债利差 145 个基点）和 10 亿美元五年期（利差 167 个基点），需求旺盛。

amount_text: $8B in convertible notes: up to $4B under the Sept 2023 agreement ($1.2B Sept 2023 + $2.8B of proceeds in Mar 2024) and $4B under the Nov 2024 agreement ($1.3B Nov 2024, $1.3B May 2025, $1.4B Nov 2025). Part converted into non-voting preferred shares; ~$6.2B of non-interest rollover notes remained at 30 June 2026 because of Amazon's 12% ownership cap, converting at the IPO (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Amazon's $8B investment in Anthropic
title_zh: 亚马逊对 Anthropic 的 80 亿美元投资
summary_en: Amazon invested $8B in Anthropic through convertible notes under 2023 and 2024 agreements, the last tranche funded in November 2025; notes that could not convert under Amazon's 12% ownership cap were reissued as interest-free rollover notes (~$6.2B at 30 June 2026). AWS became Anthropic's primary cloud and training partner, using Trainium chips.
summary_zh: 亚马逊依据 2023 年和 2024 年协议，以可转换票据方式向 Anthropic 投资 80 亿美元，最后一笔于 2025 年 11 月到位；因亚马逊 12% 持股上限而无法转股的部分改为无息展期票据（2026 年 6 月 30 日约 62 亿美元）。AWS 成为 Anthropic 主要云和训练合作方，使用 Trainium 芯片。

amount_text: $2.0B of 10% convertible notes in three tranches: $500M (Sept 2023), $750M (Sept 2024), $750M (Sept 2025); all converted into non-voting preferred shares by January 2026 (Anthropic S-1). Agreement dated September 2023, day not disclosed
term: Notes due 48 months after each issue; converted
title_en: Google's $2B convertible-note investment in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌以可转换票据向 Anthropic 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Under a September 2023 note purchase agreement Google lent Anthropic $2B in convertible notes, funded in three tranches through September 2025; the notes converted into non-voting Series E and Series G-4 preferred shares, the last in January 2026. Anthropic also has a commercial agreement with Google.
summary_zh: 根据 2023 年 9 月的票据购买协议，谷歌以可转换票据形式向 Anthropic 提供 20 亿美元，分三批于 2025 年 9 月前到位；票据已转为无投票权的 E 轮及 G-4 优先股，最后一批于 2026 年 1 月转换。Anthropic 与谷歌另有商业合作协议。

amount_text: $2.3B; co-led by Magnetar and Blackstone, with Coatue, DigitalBridge, BlackRock, PIMCO, Carlyle
title_en: CoreWeave $2.3B GPU-backed loan (Magnetar, Blackstone)
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 23 亿美元 GPU 抵押贷款（Magnetar、黑石牵头）
summary_en: CoreWeave's first big GPU-backed private-credit facility, led by Magnetar and Blackstone, used to buy hardware for already-signed customer contracts.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 首笔大型 GPU 抵押私募信贷融资，由 Magnetar 和黑石牵头，用于为已签约客户合同采购硬件。

amount_text: Undisclosed; CNBC reported 'potentially billions of dollars over multiple years' in Jun 2023 (contract signed earlier in 2023); CoreWeave's 10-K puts Microsoft at ~67% of 2025 revenue of $5.1B and ~62% of 2024; day of announcement unknown (-01)
title_en: Microsoft, CoreWeave's largest customer, buys GPU cloud capacity
title_zh: 微软向 CoreWeave 采购 GPU 云算力（CoreWeave 最大客户）
summary_en: Microsoft agreed in 2023 to buy GPU cloud capacity from CoreWeave, reportedly to serve OpenAI's demand; the contract totals are undisclosed, but CoreWeave's annual report names Microsoft as its largest customer at about 67% of 2025 revenue (62% in 2024), a share management expects to fall as the OpenAI and Meta contracts ramp.
summary_zh: 微软 2023 年与 CoreWeave 签约采购 GPU 云算力，据报主要用于满足 OpenAI 的需求；合同总额未披露，但 CoreWeave 年报显示微软是其最大客户，约占 2025 年收入的 67%（2024 年为 62%），管理层预计随着 OpenAI 和 Meta 合同放量该比例将下降。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the $221M Series B led by Magnetar Capital (TechCrunch: Magnetar $111M, the rest split between Nvidia, Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross, at a ~$2B valuation); a $200M extension in May 2023 took the round to $421M
title_en: Nvidia joins CoreWeave's $221M Series B (share undisclosed)
title_zh: 英伟达参投 CoreWeave 2.21 亿美元 B 轮融资（份额未披露）
summary_en: CoreWeave's April 2023 Series B was led by Magnetar Capital with contributions from Nvidia, Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross; Nvidia's share was not disclosed (Crain's Chicago Business later put it at a reported ~$100M). It is Nvidia's first equity stake in CoreWeave, the start of the supplier-investor-customer loop.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 2023 年 4 月的 B 轮融资由 Magnetar Capital 领投，英伟达、Nat Friedman 和 Daniel Gross 参投；英伟达的出资额未披露（Crain's Chicago Business 后来报道约为 1 亿美元）。这是英伟达首次持股 CoreWeave，也是供应商、投资者与客户三重循环的起点。

amount_text: $13B total funding commitments (2019-2023); ~27% stake worth ~$135B after Oct 2025 recap
title_en: Microsoft's ~27% stake in OpenAI
title_zh: 微软持有 OpenAI 约 27% 股权
summary_en: Microsoft disclosed $13B of total funding commitments to OpenAI ($1B in 2019, then multiyear rounds from 2021 and January 2023). In the October 2025 recapitalisation this became roughly 27% of OpenAI Group PBC on an as-converted diluted basis, valued at about $135B.
summary_zh: 微软披露向 OpenAI 的累计出资承诺为 130 亿美元（2019 年 10 亿美元，2021 年及 2023 年 1 月起多年期追加）。2025 年 10 月资本重组后，这部分权益转换为 OpenAI Group PBC 约 27% 的股份（按转换后完全稀释计），价值约 1350 亿美元。
